# 1.00. INTRODUCTION: TANGENT SCIENCE FANTASY ROLE-PLAYING SYSTEM

* **Focus Statement:** The primary player-facing introduction to the **TANGENT Science Fantasy Role-Playing Engine (Tangent SF RP)**, establishing the core narrative pillars, the 150-CP Operator creation architecture, the 2d10 vs. Challenge Rating (CR) resolution curve, the complete Core System Glossary, and official publishing credits.

## Overview & Mechanical Authority Block

Role-Playing Games (RPGs) provide a unique and interactive form of entertainment where a group of **Operators (Players)** and an **Architect (Game Master)** come together to weave imaginative stories. **Tangent SF RP** invites players to explore a captivating science-fantasy universe where street-level cyberpunk, high-magic arcane orders, bio-engineered hive collectives, and Dyson-scale cosmic empires intertwine under a single deterministic rules engine. Players are empowered to create one-of-a-kind characters and embark on exciting adventures across the galaxy.

Every rule and subsystem introduced in **Volume I: The Operator's Manual** adheres to these foundational mechanical laws:

* **Core Resolution Roll:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`.

* **Advantage & Disadvantage:** Roll `+1d10` per stack of Advantage (keep the highest 2 dice) or Disadvantage (keep the lowest 2 dice). Opposing stacks cancel 1-for-1.

* **Critical Hit & Fumble Resolution:**

  * **Critical Hit (`Natural 20` / double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19`, `18`):** `Rolled Dice + 10` (e.g., `20 -> 30`, `19 -> 29`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + `Weapon/Elemental Critical Effect`.

  * **Fumble (`Natural 2` / double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3`, `4`):** `Rolled Dice becomes flat -10` (`Base Score - 10`) + `Situational Complication`.

* **Character Point (CP) Economy:** `150 CP` starting Operator budget divided into an **80-CP Archetype Chassis** and a **70-CP Customization Budget**.

* **80-CP Archetype Chassis Breakdown:**

  * **Primary Attribute at +3:** `15 CP` (`5 CP` per `+1`)

  * **Secondary Attribute at +2:** `10 CP` (`5 CP` per `+1`)

  * **4 Essential Skills at Rank 6 (Trained):** `24 CP` (`1 CP` per Rank)

  * **6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3 (Novice):** `18 CP` (`1 CP` per Rank)

  * **2 Signature Traits (1 CP each) and 3 Recommended Core Features (9 CP):** `13 CP`

* **Background Skill Ranks:** `60 Background Skill Ranks` allocated at `0 CP` as `20 SP Faction` + `20 SP Origin` + `20 SP Occupation`, alongside `4 Recommended Features` (`-1 CP` discount; `2 CP` instead of `3 CP`, minimum `1 CP`) and `4 Traits` at `0 CP` (`Extra Traits = 1 CP` each).

* **Universal Attribute & Skill Pricing:** Straight cost across all creation, species, and customization packages (`+5 CP` per `+1` Attribute, `-5 CP` refund per `-1` Attribute penalty, `1 CP` per `1` Skill Rank / `5 CP` per `5` Skill Ranks — zero package discount).

* **Vitality, Health & Structure Pools:** Biological characters start with Base `30 Vitality` and Base `30 Health`; Synthetic/Construct characters combine both into Base `60 Structure Points (SP)`. Pools scale strictly at `+5 points per 1 CP` spent (Suggested Max: `60` each / `120 SP`; **NEVER** scaled by Stamina). Stamina Modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after Armor DR.

* **Personal Hindrance Cap:** Standard personal character hindrances have a `+10 CP` maximum limit; **Species-level hindrances and cybernetic Stigmas do NOT count toward the 10-point standard hindrance limit**.

## Part II — Complete Unabridged Profiles & Rules Entries

### 1. Welcome to the Tangent Universe (The Six Pillars of Character Identity)

* *You stand at the threshold of a boundless science-fantasy galaxy—where ancient arcane lineages, hyper-capitalist megacorporations, bio-engineered hive minds, and frontier drifters collide across thousands of star systems.*

* *"Every legend in the Star Atlas started with a hundred and fifty Character Points, a battered sidearm, and a reason to leave home."* — **Captain Vaelen Thorne, Outworlds Free Trader**

#### 1.01. The Role-Playing Engine (`1.00 INTRODUCTION.md`)

Role-Playing Games (RPGs) provide a unique and interactive form of entertainment where a group of **Operators (Players)** and an **Architect (Game Master)** come together to weave imaginative stories. **Tangent SF RP** invites players to explore a captivating universe where science fiction and fantasy intertwine. Players are empowered to create one-of-a-kind characters using a deterministic **150 Character Point (CP)** creation budget and embark on exciting adventures.

* **Core Resolution Mechanics:**

  * **Standard Check:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`.

  * **Advantage / Disadvantage:** Roll `+1d10` per stack and keep the highest 2 dice (Advantage) or lowest 2 dice (Disadvantage).

  * **Critical Hit (`Natural 20`):** `Rolled Dice + 10` (`20 -> 30`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + `Weapon/Elemental Critical Effect`.

  * **Fumble (`Natural 2`):** `Rolled Dice becomes flat -10` (`Base Score - 10`) + `Situational Complication`.

#### 1.02. Species & Biological Heritage (`1.03 SPECIES.md`)

* *Your genetic or synthetic blueprint dictates how you perceive the cosmos, how your body withstands vacuum or plasma fire, and how the societies of the galaxy react when you walk through an airlock.*

* *"Aeld live six centuries and still hurry; Mekan live forever and never waste a microsecond."* — **Xenobiologist's Field Note**

Tangent offers an intricate character customization system, granting players the freedom to shape their character's destiny. The journey begins with selecting a **Species** (or Sub-Species) for your character. Will you choose to be one of the ancient **Alterians** (`1.03.Aeld.Alterian.md`), wielding potent arcane metaphysics passed down through generations across 600-year lifespans? Or perhaps you will opt for the technologically advanced **Cyberforms** (`1.03.Humans.Cyberform.md`) or **Mekan** (`1.03.Synthetics.Mekan.md`), renowned for their superior intellect and cybernetic or synthetic enhancements? Each species in Tangent possesses distinct attributes and abilities, influencing your character's strengths, weaknesses, and potential in the game world.

* **Species Mechanical Parameters:**

  * **Universal Straight CP Pricing:** Species attribute modifiers cost `+5 CP` per `+1` and refund `-5 CP` per `-1`; innate species skill allowances cost `1 CP` per `1 Rank` (`5 CP` per `5 Ranks`) with zero package discount.

  * **Recommended Features:** Each species provides a curated list of **Recommended Features** eligible for the `-1 CP` discount (`2 CP` instead of `3 CP`, minimum `1 CP`).

  * **Species Hindrance Exemption:** Innate species-level hindrances and cultural Stigmas do **not** count toward the `+10 CP` personal hindrance cap.

#### 1.03. Origins & Upbringing (`1.05 ORIGINS.md`)

* *Before you ever joined a faction or learned a trade, the gravity, atmosphere, and social order of your homeworld forged your earliest survival instincts.*

* *"Show me how someone treats clean water and open sky, and I will tell you which world raised them."* — **Coalition Colonial Administrator**

Beyond species selection, Tangent delves into the rich tapestry of your character's **Origins**. Your background and planetary or habitat upbringing play a significant role in shaping who you are. Were you raised in the humble surroundings of a rural **Agricultural** (`1.05.Agricultural.md`) or **Colony** (`1.05.Colony.md`) planet, learning the value of community and resourcefulness? Or did you experience a privileged childhood in a sprawling **Urban** (`1.05.Urban.md`) or **Leisure** (`1.05.Leisure.md`) metropolis, surrounded by advanced technology and political intrigue? Your Origin will not only influence your character's skills and abilities, but also contribute to their personality, starting Technology Level (`TL`), Metafocus Level (`ML`), and worldview.

* **Origin Mechanical Allocation (`0 CP` Baseline):**

  * **Background Skill Points:** Grants **`20 Skill Points (SP)`** distributed across core upbringing skills.

  * **Origin Feature & Trait:** Grants **`1 Origin Recommended Feature`** and **`1 Origin Trait`** at `0 CP`.

#### 1.04. Factions & Galactic Polities (`1.04 FACTIONS.md`)

* *Great powers carve the stars into spheres of influence, offering doctrine, patronage, and high-technology arsenals to those who carry their banner.*

* *"In the Core Worlds, allegiance is currency. On the Rim, allegiance is who shows up when your distress beacon fires."* — **Dracon Dynasty Envoy**

**Factions** represent powerful groups, civilizations, megacorporations, religious orders, or organizations that hold sway over the game world. Aligning with a faction can grant your character access to valuable resources, specialized training, and unique missions that shape their path. Choosing a faction that resonates with your character's beliefs and aspirations adds depth to their identity and opens doors to exciting opportunities. Whether you are drawn to the mystical **Alterian Enclave** (`1.04.AeldProvidence.AlterianEnclave.md`), the technologically advanced and hyper-capitalist **Syndicate** (`1.04.Major.Syndicate.md`), the politically influential noble houses of the **Dracon Dynasty** (`1.04.Major.DraconDynasty.md`), the psionic **Radiant Impyrium** (`1.04.Impyrium.Radiant.md`), or the fiercely independent **Coalition** (`1.04.Major.Coalition.md`) and **Outworlds** (`1.04.Major.Outworlds.md`), your choice of faction will significantly impact your character's journey and the challenges they face. Careful consideration of each faction's values, goals, and resources will ensure that your character finds their place in the intricate tapestry of Tangent's universe.

* **Faction Mechanical Allocation (`0 CP` Baseline):**

  * **Background Skill Points:** Grants **`20 Skill Points (SP)`** in culturally favored skills.

  * **Faction Feature & Trait:** Grants **`1 Faction Recommended Feature`** and **`1 Faction Trait`** at `0 CP`, plus access to factional CRISP visual skins and equipment lists.

#### 1.05. Occupations & Careers (`1.06 OCCUPATIONS.md`)

* *Your profession is how you earned your living, sharpened your expertise, and established your credit standing before stepping onto the galactic stage.*

* *"A title on a dossier means nothing. What matters is what your hands know how to do when the lights go out."* — **Specialist Guildmaster**

Your character's **Occupation** represents their chosen profession and area of expertise. This choice not only adds flavor and depth to their identity, but also grants them specific skills and abilities that reflect their training and experience. Whether you envision your character as a brave **Soldier** (`1.06.Soldier.md`), a wise **Scholar** (`1.06.Scholar.md`), a covert **Agent** (`1.06.Agent.md`), a cunning **Criminal** (`1.06.Criminal.md`), or a resourceful **Drifter** (`1.06.Drifter.md`), selecting an occupation that aligns with their personality and aspirations is crucial. Each of the 13 canonical Occupations in Tangent offers a unique set of skills, traits, Wealth Score modifiers, and **Recommended Features** that help define your character's capabilities and playstyle. By carefully considering the advantages and trade-offs of each occupation, you can create a character that is not only well-suited to their chosen path, but also capable of overcoming the challenges they will face in the game world.

* **Occupation Mechanical Allocation (`0 CP` Baseline):**

  * **Background Skill Points:** Grants **`20 Skill Points (SP)`** in vocational and career skills (completing the **`60 SP` total background skill allocation**: `20 SP Faction + 20 SP Origin + 20 SP Occupation`).

  * **Occupation Features & Traits:** Grants **`2 Occupation Recommended Features`** and **`2 Occupation Traits`** at `0 CP` (completing the **`4 Recommended Features` and `4 Traits` foundational background package**).

#### 1.06. Archetypes, Personality, Bonds & Progression (`1.01` & `1.02`)

* *Statistics measure what an Operator can accomplish; personality traits, flaws, and bonds reveal who they are when tested by the void.*

* *"Numbers build a chassis. Scars and promises build a person."* — **Architect's Matrix Commentary**

To bridge abstract Character Points and immediate table playability, Operators may select a pre-calculated **80-CP Archetype Chassis** (`1.02 ARCHETYPES.md`)—defining their Primary Attribute at `+3` (`15 CP`), Secondary Attribute at `+2` (`10 CP`), 4 Essential Skills at Rank 6 (`24 CP`), 6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3 (`18 CP`), 2 Signature Traits (`2 CP`), and 3 Recommended Core Features (`9 CP`, totaling `13 CP`)—and spend their remaining **70 CP** to select their Species, customize their Saving Throws (`Active Save = 2d10 + 2 + [2 * Attribute] + Feature Bonus`), expand their **Vitality** and **Health** pools (`Base 30` each, increased strictly by `+5 points per 1 CP spent` with zero Stamina scaling), and acquire gear via the **Economic Unified Field Theory (EUFT)** (`2.00 ECONOMATRIX.md`).

The character creation system in Tangent empowers you to build characters that are not merely collections of stats and abilities, but also possess intriguing personalities and captivating backstories. You can select from a variety of personality traits, personal hindrances (up to `+10 CP`), and bonds (`1.01.PipelineIdentity.md`), adding layers of depth and complexity to your character. These choices will not only make your character feel more alive and relatable, but also influence their interactions with other characters and the world around them.

As you embark on your adventures, your character will face numerous challenges and opportunities that will test their mettle. The decisions you make in response to these situations will shape the course of the story and determine your character's ultimate fate. Will you rise to become a hero, using your abilities to protect the innocent and fight for justice? Or will you succumb to temptation, using your powers for personal gain and domination? The choice is yours.

Whether you are a seasoned enthusiast or a newcomer to the RPG genre, Tangent offers an immersive and engaging experience that encourages you to unleash your creativity and strategic thinking. Gather your friends, roll the `2d10` dice, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure in the boundless universe.

### 2. Core System Glossary (`./introduction/1.00.Glossary.md`)

* *Every Operator and Architect relies on a shared deterministic lexicon to adjudicate resolution rolls, displacement units, wound thresholds, metaphysical channeling, and interstellar trade.*

* *"Define your terms before you draw your weapon."* — **Kovian Tribunal Legal Code**

#### I. Core Metrics (The Math)

These terms define the fundamental mathematics of the **Tangent SF RP** engine:

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Range / Formula | 
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | 
| **Core Roll** | Resolution | The universal resolution roll for skill checks, attacks, and active saves. | `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Mod + Modifiers vs. CR` | 
| **Advantage** | Resolution | Roll an extra `+1d10` per stack of Advantage and keep the **highest 2 dice**. | Cancels 1-for-1 with Disadvantage | 
| **Disadvantage** | Resolution | Roll an extra `+1d10` per stack of Disadvantage and keep the **lowest 2 dice**. | Cancels 1-for-1 with Advantage | 
| **Critical Hit** | Resolution | **Natural 20** (double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19`, `18`). | `Rolled Dice + 10` (e.g., `20 -> 30`, `19 -> 29`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + `Critical Effect` | 
| **Fumble** | Resolution | **Natural 2** (double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3`, `4`). | `Rolled Dice becomes flat -10` (`Base Score - 10`) + `Situational Complication` | 
| **Rank** | Skills | The numerical value assigned to a Skill, representing formal training and practice. | `0` (Untrained) to `30+` (Pinnacle) | 
| **Score** | Attributes | The raw modifier of one of the 6 Primary Attributes (`STR`, `AGI`, `STA`, `INT`, `WIS`, `CHA`). | `-5` to `+10` (Caps vary by Species/Tier; `+5 CP` per `+1`) | 
| **CP** | Creation | **Character Points**. The universal currency used for Character Creation. | Standard Starting Budget: **`150 CP`** (`80 CP` Chassis + `70 CP` Custom) | 
| **AP / XP** | Progression | **Award Points / Experience Points**. Post-creation advancement points spent 1-for-1 like CP. | Tier 1: `150–199 CP`, Tier 2: `200–299 CP`, Tier 3: `300–449 CP`, Tier 4: `450+ CP` | 
| **CR** | Mechanics | **Challenge Rating**. The target difficulty number a `2d10` check must meet or exceed. | `CR 0` (Scrap/Simple) to `CR 50+` (Transcendent) | 
| **Active Save** | Defense | Dynamic saving throw rolled against hazards, toxins, or invocations. | `2d10 + 2 + (2 * Attribute) + Feature Bonus` | 
| **Passive Save CR** | Defense | Static threshold an attacker's check must meet when targeting a character passively. | `12 + (2 * Attribute) + Feature Bonus` | 
| **Karma (KP)** | Resources | Meta-currency pool used to roll with Advantage, seize initiative, or trigger Karma Features. | Base `3 KP` (Refreshes per Session; `1 CP = +1 Max KP`) | 
| **Tier** | Scale | Broad category of power or complexity for Characters, Threat Templates, and Infrastructure. | Tier 0 (Civilian) to Tier 5 (Cosmic / Post-Scarcity) | 

#### II. Physics & Capacity (The UDU System)

* **Canonical 10:1 UDU Ratio:** `1 Module (10 Tons) = 10 Mounts (1,000 kg) = 100 Sockets (100 kg) = 1,000 Usable Nodes (10 kg)`

| Term | Domain | Definition | Mass & Capacity Equivalence | 
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | 
| **UDU** | Physics | **Universal Displacement Unit**. The master logarithmic hierarchy governing mass, volume, and slot capacity across augmentations, personal gear, mecha, and architecture. | `10 Nodes = 1 Socket` | `10 Sockets = 1 Mount` | `10 Mounts = 1 Module` | 
| **Node (Tier 0)** | Augmentations | Microscale installation slot for biological, cybernetic, and nanofiber augmentations. | `1 Usable Node (< 10 g) = 0.1 Socket` (`10 Nodes = 1 Socket`) | 
| **Socket (Tier 1)** | Equipment | Personal-scale customization slot for weapons, armor suits, and portable drones. | `1 Socket (< 1 kg) = 10 Usable Nodes` | 
| **Mount (Tier 2)** | Mecha & Vehicles | Vehicular/Mecha hardpoint slot for heavy weapons, engines, and tactical subsystems. | `1 Mount (< 100 kg) = 10 Sockets` *(Garaging: `1 Mount = 1 Scale Multiplier`)* | 
| **Module (Tier 3)** | Architecture | Macroscale pre-fabricated room, starship bay, or facility block (`20x20 ft`). | `1 Module (< 10 Tons) = 10 Mounts = 100 Sockets` | 

#### III. Survival & Combat Integrity

Defining the states of life, structural resilience, and damage mitigation:

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Formula / Limit | 
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | 
| **Vitality** | Integrity | Physical stamina, luck, and glancing-blow avoidance. Absorbs initial/non-lethal damage before Health. | **Base `30`**; increased strictly by **`+5 per 1 CP`** (Suggested Max: `60`). **Never scaled by Stamina.** | 
| **Health** | Integrity | Biological structural integrity and life force. Damage here represents physical wounds and trauma. | **Base `30`**; increased strictly by **`+5 per 1 CP`** (Suggested Max: `60`). **Never scaled by Stamina.** | 
| **Structure (SP)** | Integrity | Combined integrity pool (`Vitality + Health`) for Synthetics, Constructs, Vehicles, Mecha, and Buildings. | **Base `60 SP`** for Synthetics (`+5 SP per 1 CP`; Suggested Max: `120 SP`). | 
| **Base Toughness** | Mitigation | Point-for-point damage reduction granted by a character's **Stamina (STA) Modifier**. | Subtracts `STA Mod` from incoming damage *after* Armor DR. | 
| **DR** | Mitigation | **Damage Resistance / Reduction**. Flat value subtracted from incoming damage before Base Toughness and Vitality. | `0` (Clothing) to `60+` (Capital Ship). **Armor Layering Cap:** Only the single highest DR across bio, cyber, and worn armor applies. | 
| **Penetration** | Mitigation | Weapon armor-piercing rating that reduces the target's effective Armor DR on that strike. | `Effective DR = max(0, Highest Single Domain DR - Weapon Penetration)` | 
| **Defense** | Combat | Static target number an attacker's `2d10` Strike roll must meet or exceed to hit. | `10 + Agility + Defense Skill Rank + Shield/Size/Cover Modifiers` | 
| **Mortality State** | Survival | Triggered at `0 Health`. Character gains **Stability Points = `Stamina Score + 5`** and loses `1` per turn until stabilized (`CR 15 Medicine` or `CR 15 Fortitude Save`). | Death occurs at `0 Stability Points` or `-Stamina Score` Health; revivification inflicts `-5 XP Debt` and drains Karma to `0`. | 
| **Stigma** | Social | Social prejudice and Alien Mind Factor penalty resulting from species, synthetic, or cultural bias. | `-1` (Minor), `-2` (Typical), `-4` to `-8` (Severe/Monstrous) to Social checks with biased groups (exempt from `+10 CP` personal hindrance cap). | 

#### IV. Metaphysics & Technology

The intersection of Resonance Manipulation (Magic/Psionics) and Scientific Engineering:

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Range / Formula | 
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | 
| **TL** | Technology | **Technology Level**. The sophistication of scientific engineering and manufacturing. | `TL 0` (Stone/Primitive) to `TL 5` (Polymatter / Post-Scarcity) | 
| **ML** | Metaphysics | **Metafocus Level**. The societal integration and sophistication of Resonance manipulation. | `ML 0` (Unawakened/Null) to `ML 6` (Deific / Progenitor) | 
| **Attune** | Metaphysics | The universal conduit skill for channeling Resonance energy. Sets target Save CRs and attack accuracy. | Active Check = `2d10 + Attune Rank + Key Attribute Mod` (`Passive CR = 10 + Attune + Key Mod`) | 
| **Discipline** | Metaphysics | One of the **6 Primary Metaphysic Schools** (`Dimension`, `Energy`, `Entropy`, `Illusion`, `Matter`, `Mental`), each split into **2 Focus Skills** (`12 Foci` total). | Determines Range, Area, Duration, and Base Stage Dice (`+1d6` to `+4d6`). | 
| **Invocation** | Metaphysics | A specific spell, psionic power, or technique learned within a Discipline (`1 CP` per Rank). | Adds `+1 Effect Die` per Invocation Rank to Base Discipline Stage Dice. | 
| **Essence** | Metaphysics | Internal bio-spiritual energy reserve used to empower high-strain invocations or Meta-Tech. | `Essence Pool = Sum of All 6 Attribute Scores (STR + AGI + STA + INT + WIS + CHA) + Attune Rank` | 

#### V. Economy & Wealth (EUFT)

Bridging abstract Wealth Scores (`WS`), Crafting Challenge Ratings (`CR`), and liquid Credits (`Cr`):

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Formula / Ratio | 
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | 
| **Wealth (WS)** | Economy | **Wealth Score**. Abstract rating of financial leverage, credit access, and auto-buy threshold (`WS 0` to `WS 80+`). | **Golden Rule:** Auto-buy any personal item where `Item CR <= Character WS`. | 
| **Credits (Cr)** | Economy | Liquid currency used to pay the **Liquidity Gap** when purchasing items where `Item CR > WS`. | `Liquidity Gap = Value(Item CR) - Value(Character WS)` | 
| **MCr** | Economy | **Mega-Credit**. Macro-economic unit used for starships, orbital stations, and planetary trade. | `1 MCr = 1,000,000 Credits` | 
| **Crafting CR** | Economy | The "Prime Mover" of item valuation (`Purchase CR = Crafting CR`). | Base intervals of 5: `Value (Cr) = 10 * 4 ^ (CR / 5)` | 
| **Micro-Modifiers** | Economy | Linear multipliers applied to the nearest base interval of 5 for intermediate CRs (`+1` to `+4` and `-1` Flaw). | `+1 CR = x1.30` | `+2 CR = x1.75` | `+3 CR = x2.30` | `+4 CR = x3.00` | `-1 CR Flaw = x0.75` | 
| **Material Ratio** | Crafting | Raw material cost required to initiate fabrication via the Productivity Engine. | **Pristine Materials:** `50%` of Credit Value | **Scavenged Scrap:** `10%` value (requires `5x` Item Credit Value in raw scrap mass) |

name: 1.00 Core System Glossary
description:
# 1.00.01. CORE SYSTEM GLOSSARY

* **Focus Statement:** The canonical alphabetical and domain-indexed terminology reference for the **TANGENT Science Fantasy Role-Playing Engine (Tangent SF RP)**, defining all core resolution metrics, Universal Displacement Units (UDU), combat integrity pools, metaphysical disciplines, and Economic Unified Field Theory (EUFT) equations.

## Overview & Mechanical Authority Block

Every term defined in this glossary governs **Volume I: The Operator's Manual** (`operator/`) and **Volume II: The Architect's Matrix** (`architect/`) under these strict mathematical invariants:

* **Core Resolution Roll:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`.
* **Advantage & Disadvantage:** Roll `+1d10` per stack of Advantage (keep the highest 2 dice) or Disadvantage (keep the lowest 2 dice). Opposing stacks cancel 1-for-1.
* **Critical Hit & Fumble Math:** Critical Hit (`Natural 20` / double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19`, `18`) equals `Rolled Dice + 10` (e.g., `20 -> 30`, `19 -> 29`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + `Weapon/Elemental Critical Effect`. Fumble (`Natural 2` / double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3`, `4`) converts the rolled dice into a flat `-10` (`Base Score - 10`) + `Situational Complication`.
* **Character Point (CP) Economy:** `150 CP` starting Operator budget divided into an **80-CP Archetype Chassis** (`15 CP` Primary Attribute at `+3`, `10 CP` Secondary Attribute at `+2`, `24 CP` for 4 Essential Skills at Rank 6, `18 CP` for 6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3, and `13 CP` for 2 Signature Traits at `1 CP` each plus 3 Recommended Core Features at `9 CP`) and a **70-CP Customization Budget**.
* **Background Skill Ranks:** `60 Background Skill Ranks` allocated at `0 CP` as `20 SP Faction` + `20 SP Origin` + `20 SP Occupation`, alongside `4 Recommended Features` (`-1 CP` discount) and `4 Traits` at `0 CP` (`Extra Traits = 1 CP` each).
* **Universal Straight Pricing:** `+5 CP` per `+1` Attribute, `-5 CP` refund per `-1` Attribute penalty, and `1 CP` per `1` Skill Rank (`5 CP` per `5` Skill Ranks) across all creation, species, companion, and bestiary modules.
* **Vitality, Health & Structure Pools:** Biological characters start with Base `30 Vitality` and Base `30 Health`; Synthetic/Construct entities combine both into Base `60 Structure Points (SP)`. Pools scale strictly at `+5 points per 1 CP` spent (Suggested Max: `60` each / `120 SP`; **NEVER** scaled by Stamina). Stamina Modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after Armor DR.
* **Personal Hindrance Cap:** Standard personal character hindrances have a `+10 CP` maximum limit; **Species-level hindrances and cybernetic Stigmas do NOT count toward the 10-point standard hindrance limit**.

---

## Part I — Alignment & Summary Matrix Table

| Glossary Section | Domain Scope | Indexed Term Count | Primary Mechanical & Formula Coverage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section I** | **Core Metrics (The Math)** | 14 Terms | `Core Roll`, `Advantage`, `Disadvantage`, `Critical Hit`, `Fumble`, `Rank`, `Score`, `CP`, `AP/XP`, `CR`, `Active Save`, `Passive Save CR`, `Karma`, `Tier`. |
| **Section II** | **Physics & Capacity (UDU)** | 5 Terms | `UDU`, `Node (Tier 0)`, `Socket (Tier 1)`, `Mount (Tier 2)`, `Module (Tier 3)` across the `10:1` logarithmic capacity hierarchy. |
| **Section III** | **Survival & Combat Integrity** | 10 Terms | `Vitality`, `Health`, `Structure (SP)`, `Base Toughness`, `DR`, `Penetration`, `Precision Strike`, `Defense`, `Mortality State`, `Stigma`. |
| **Section IV** | **Metaphysics & Technology** | 6 Terms | `TL (Tech Level)`, `ML (Metafocus Level)`, `Attune`, `Discipline`, `Invocation`, `Essence`. |
| **Section V** | **Economy & Wealth (EUFT)** | 8 Terms | `Wealth Score (WS)`, `Credits (Cr)`, `Mega-Credit (MCr)`, `Crafting CR`, `Linear Micro-Modifiers`, `Material Ratio`, `Productivity Points (PP)`, `Fence Rate`. |

---

## Part II — Complete Unabridged Profiles & Rules Entries

### I. Core Metrics (The Math)

* *Every action in the Tangent universe is adjudicated through a unified bell-curve engine where training and attributes shift the center of probability against a deterministic Challenge Rating.*
* *"Do not ask the Arbiter for mercy; ask what the Challenge Rating is and count your ranks."* — **Vanguard Tactical Primer**

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Range / Formula |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Core Roll** | Resolution | The universal resolution roll for skill checks, attacks, and active saves. | `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Mod + Modifiers vs. CR` |
| **Advantage** | Resolution | Roll an extra `+1d10` per stack of Advantage and keep the **highest 2 dice**. | Cancels 1-for-1 with Disadvantage |
| **Disadvantage** | Resolution | Roll an extra `+1d10` per stack of Disadvantage and keep the **lowest 2 dice**. | Cancels 1-for-1 with Advantage |
| **Critical Hit** | Resolution | **Natural 20** (double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19`, `18`). | `Rolled Dice + 10` (e.g., `20 -> 30`, `19 -> 29`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + `Critical Effect` |
| **Fumble** | Resolution | **Natural 2** (double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3`, `4`). | `Rolled Dice becomes flat -10` (`Base Score - 10`) + `Situational Complication` |
| **Rank** | Skills | The numerical value assigned to a Skill, representing formal training and practice. | `0` (Untrained) to `30+` (Pinnacle) |
| **Score** | Attributes | The raw modifier of one of the 6 Primary Attributes (`STR`, `AGI`, `STA`, `INT`, `WIS`, `CHA`). | `-5` to `+10` (Caps vary by Species/Tier; `+5 CP` per `+1`) |
| **CP** | Creation | **Character Points**. The universal currency used for Character Creation. | Standard Starting Budget: **`150 CP`** (`80 CP` Chassis + `70 CP` Custom) |
| **AP / XP** | Progression | **Award Points / Experience Points**. Post-creation advancement points spent 1-for-1 like CP. | Tier 1: `150–199 CP`, Tier 2: `200–299 CP`, Tier 3: `300–449 CP`, Tier 4: `450+ CP` |
| **CR** | Mechanics | **Challenge Rating**. The target difficulty number a `2d10` check must meet or exceed. | `CR 0` (Scrap/Simple) to `CR 50+` (Transcendent) |
| **Active Save** | Defense | Dynamic saving throw rolled against hazards, toxins, or invocations. | `2d10 + 2 + (2 * Attribute) + Feature Bonus` |
| **Passive Save CR** | Defense | Static threshold an attacker's check must meet when targeting a character passively. | `12 + (2 * Attribute) + Feature Bonus` |
| **Karma (KP)** | Resources | Meta-currency pool used to roll with Advantage, seize initiative, or trigger Karma Features. | Base `3 KP` (Refreshes per Session; `1 CP = +1 Max KP`) |
| **Tier** | Scale | Broad category of power or complexity for Characters, Threat Templates, and Infrastructure. | Tier 0 (Civilian) to Tier 5 (Cosmic / Post-Scarcity) |

---

### II. Physics & Capacity (The UDU System)

* *The Universal Displacement Unit (UDU) locks sub-dermal bioware, personal sidearms, mechanized walkers, and orbital habitats into a single logarithmic 10:1 capacity scale.*
* *"If it has mass and volume, it has a displacement tier."* — **Entari Combine Engineering Standard 10.1**

* **Canonical UDU Ratio:** `1 Module (10 Tons) = 10 Mounts (1,000 kg) = 100 Sockets (100 kg) = 1,000 Usable Nodes (10 kg)`

| Term | Domain | Definition | Mass & Capacity Equivalence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **UDU** | Physics | **Universal Displacement Unit**. The master logarithmic hierarchy governing mass, volume, and slot capacity across augmentations, personal gear, mecha, and architecture. | `10 Nodes = 1 Socket` \| `10 Sockets = 1 Mount` \| `10 Mounts = 1 Module` |
| **Node (Tier 0)** | Augmentations | Microscale installation slot for biological, cybernetic, and nanofiber augmentations. | `1 Usable Node (< 10 g) = 0.1 Socket` (`10 Nodes = 1 Socket`) |
| **Socket (Tier 1)** | Equipment | Personal-scale customization slot for weapons, armor suits, and portable drones. | `1 Socket (< 1 kg) = 10 Usable Nodes` |
| **Mount (Tier 2)** | Mecha & Vehicles | Vehicular/Mecha hardpoint slot for heavy weapons, engines, and tactical subsystems. | `1 Mount (< 100 kg) = 10 Sockets` *(Garaging: `1 Mount = 1 Scale Multiplier`)* |
| **Module (Tier 3)** | Architecture | Macroscale pre-fabricated room, starship bay, or facility block (`20x20 ft`). | `1 Module (< 10 Tons) = 10 Mounts = 100 Sockets` |

---

### III. Survival & Combat Integrity

* *Combat integrity separates glancing exhaustion from lethal structural trauma, applying single-domain Armor DR and Stamina Base Toughness to every incoming strike.*
* *"Armor stops the shrapnel. Stamina keeps your ribs from caving in. Vitality is just how many times you can duck before both are tested."* — **Drop Marine Field Manual**

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Formula / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Vitality** | Integrity | Physical stamina, luck, and glancing-blow avoidance. Absorbs initial/non-lethal damage before Health. | **Base `30`**; increased strictly by **`+5 per 1 CP`** (Suggested Max: `60`). **Never scaled by Stamina.** |
| **Health** | Integrity | Biological structural integrity and life force. Damage here represents physical wounds and trauma. | **Base `30`**; increased strictly by **`+5 per 1 CP`** (Suggested Max: `60`). **Never scaled by Stamina.** |
| **Structure (SP)** | Integrity | Combined integrity pool (`Vitality + Health`) for Synthetics, Constructs, Vehicles, Mecha, and Buildings. | **Base `60 SP`** for Synthetics (`+5 SP per 1 CP`; Suggested Max: `120 SP`). |
| **Base Toughness** | Mitigation | Point-for-point damage reduction granted by a character's **Stamina (STA) Modifier**. | Subtracts `STA Mod` from incoming damage *after* Armor DR. |
| **DR** | Mitigation | **Damage Resistance / Reduction**. Flat value subtracted from incoming damage before Base Toughness and Vitality. | `0` (Clothing) to `60+` (Capital Ship). **Armor Layering Cap:** Only the single highest DR across bio, cyber, and worn armor applies. |
| **Penetration** | Mitigation | Weapon armor-piercing rating that reduces the target's effective Armor DR against that attack. | `Effective DR = max(0, Highest Single Domain DR - Weapon Penetration)` |
| **Precision Strike** | Combat | Feature-gated Standard Action strike consolidation chain (`1.08.CombatFeatures.md`). | `Precision Strike` (`Skill 6`) = `2x` Base Weapon Dice; `Improved` (`Skill 11`) = `3x`; `Greater` (`Skill 16`) = `4x`. |
| **Defense** | Combat | Static target number an attacker's `2d10` Strike roll must meet or exceed to hit. | `10 + Agility + Defense Skill Rank + Shield/Size/Cover Modifiers` |
| **Mortality State** | Survival | Triggered at `0 Health`. Character gains **Stability Points = `Stamina Score + 5`** and loses `1` per turn until stabilized (`CR 15 Medicine` or `CR 15 Fortitude Save`). | Death occurs at `0 Stability Points` or `-Stamina Score` Health; revivification inflicts `-5 XP Debt` and drains Karma to `0`. |
| **Stigma** | Social | Social prejudice and Alien Mind Factor penalty resulting from species, synthetic, or cultural bias. | `-1` (Minor), `-2` (Typical), `-4` to `-8` (Severe/Monstrous) to Social checks with biased groups (exempt from `+10 CP` personal hindrance cap). |

---

### IV. Metaphysics & Technology

* *Whether forged on an industrial nanoforge or woven from the raw threads of the Resonance, advanced capabilities obey strict tier and focus thresholds.*
* *"At sufficiently high Challenge Ratings, engineering and invocation become indistinguishable."* — **Alterian Technomancer**

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Range / Formula |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TL** | Technology | **Technology Level**. The sophistication of scientific engineering and manufacturing. | `TL 0` (Stone/Primitive) to `TL 5` (Polymatter / Post-Scarcity) |
| **ML** | Metaphysics | **Metafocus Level**. The societal integration and sophistication of Resonance manipulation. | `ML 0` (Unawakened/Null) to `ML 6` (Deific / Progenitor) |
| **Attune** | Metaphysics | The universal conduit skill for channeling Resonance energy. Sets target Save CRs and attack accuracy. | Active Check = `2d10 + Attune Rank + Key Attribute Mod` (`Passive CR = 10 + Attune + Key Mod`) |
| **Discipline** | Metaphysics | One of the **6 Primary Metaphysic Schools** (`Dimension`, `Energy`, `Entropy`, `Illusion`, `Matter`, `Mental`), each split into **2 Focus Skills** (`12 Foci` total). | Determines Range, Area, Duration, and Base Stage Dice (`+1d6` to `+4d6`). |
| **Invocation** | Metaphysics | A specific spell, psionic power, or technique learned within a Discipline (`1 CP` per Rank). | Adds `+1 Effect Die` per Invocation Rank to Base Discipline Stage Dice. |
| **Essence** | Metaphysics | Internal bio-spiritual energy reserve used to empower high-strain invocations or Meta-Tech. | `Essence Pool = Sum of All 6 Attribute Scores (STR + AGI + STA + INT + WIS + CHA) + Attune Rank` |

---

### V. Economy & Wealth (EUFT)

* *The Economic Unified Field Theory binds abstract character status, liquid Credits, salvage mass, and industrial fabrication speed to a single exponential curve.*
* *"Complexity sets the price; infrastructure sets the schedule."* — **Syndicate Commerce Code**

| Term | Domain | Definition | Canonical Formula / Ratio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wealth (WS)** | Economy | **Wealth Score**. Abstract rating of financial leverage, credit access, and auto-buy threshold (`WS 0` to `WS 80+`). | **Golden Rule:** Auto-buy any personal item where `Item CR <= Character WS`. |
| **Credits (Cr)** | Economy | Liquid currency used to pay the **Liquidity Gap** when purchasing items where `Item CR > WS`. | `Liquidity Gap = Value(Item CR) - Value(Character WS)` |
| **MCr** | Economy | **Mega-Credit**. Macro-economic unit used for starships, orbital stations, and planetary trade. | `1 MCr = 1,000,000 Credits` |
| **Crafting CR** | Economy | The "Prime Mover" of item valuation (`Purchase CR = Crafting CR`). | Base intervals of 5: `Value (Cr) = 10 * 4 ^ (CR / 5)` |
| **Micro-Modifiers** | Economy | Linear multipliers applied to the nearest base interval of 5 for intermediate CRs (`+1` to `+4` and `-1` Flaw). | `+1 CR = x1.30` \| `+2 CR = x1.75` \| `+3 CR = x2.30` \| `+4 CR = x3.00` \| `-1 CR Flaw = x0.75` |
| **Material Ratio** | Crafting | Raw material cost required to initiate fabrication via the Productivity Engine. | **Pristine Materials:** `50%` of Credit Value \| **Scavenged Scrap:** `10%` value (requires `5x` Item Credit Value in raw scrap mass) |
| **Productivity Points (PP)** | Crafting | Unit of fabrication progress accumulated daily toward `Target PP = Item Credit Value`. | `Daily PP = (Craft Check Result - 10) * Tool Tier Multiplier * Crew Size` |
| **Fence Rate** | Economy | Liquidity Drag applied when reselling goods on the open or black market. | `Legal Goods = 50% Value` \| `Black Market / Stolen = 20%–25% Value` \| `Scrap = 10% Value` |

---

## Part III — Discrepancy & Restoration Ledger

* **DISC-302 (Glossary Vitality Stamina Bug Purge):** Replaced the legacy `Base 30 + (5 per CP/Sta)` entry in `1.00.Glossary.md` with the canonical Zero-Stamina-Scaling rule (`Base 30 + 5 per 1 CP; NEVER scaled by Stamina`) and added **Base Toughness** (`Stamina Modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage after Armor DR`).
* **DISC-303 (UDU Header, Combat & EUFT Expansion):** Fixed the legacy `1 Module = 100 Mounts = 10,000 Sockets` header typo to match the canonical `1 Module = 10 Mounts = 100 Sockets = 1,000 Usable Nodes` ratio, removed ellipsis characters (ellipses) in the Critical Hit and Fumble rows, added `Penetration`, `Precision Strike`, `Productivity Points (PP)`, and `Fence Rate` definitions, and added the Document Header & Mechanical Authority Block and Part I Alignment & Summary Matrix Table.

# 1.01 CHARACTER CREATION

* **Focus Statement:** The master index and foundational overview of the **Tangent SF RP** Operator creation pipeline, establishing the three-part Character Concept framework, the **150 Character Point (CP)** starting budget (`80-CP Archetype Chassis + 70-CP Customization Budget`), the **60 Background Skill Ranks** (`20 SP Faction + 20 SP Origin + 20 SP Occupation`), and the complete directory index for `./character_creation/`.

## Overview & Mechanical Authority Block

Every rule, formula, and character creation procedure in **Volume I: The Operator's Manual** (`operator/`) is governed by these canonical mechanical invariants:

* **Core Resolution Roll:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`.
* **Advantage & Disadvantage:** Roll `+1d10` per stack of Advantage (keep the highest 2 dice) or Disadvantage (keep the lowest 2 dice). Opposing stacks cancel 1-for-1.
* **Critical Hit & Fumble Resolution:**
  * **Critical Hit (`Natural 20` / double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19`, `18`):** `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice + 30 to Attack Score + Weapon/Elemental Critical Effect`.
  * **Fumble (`Natural 2` / double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3`, `4`):** `-10 to Attack/Check Score + Situational Complication`.
* **Character Point (CP) Economy (`150 CP` Starting Budget):** Starting Operators receive **150 Character Points (CP)**, structured as an **80-CP Archetype Chassis** plus a **70-CP Customization Budget** (or allocated via full custom point-buy):
  * **Primary Attribute at `+3`:** `15 CP` (`+5 CP` per `+1`)
  * **Secondary Attribute at `+2`:** `10 CP` (`+5 CP` per `+1`)
  * **4 Essential Skills at Rank 6 (Trained):** `24 CP` (`1 CP` per Rank)
  * **6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3 (Novice):** `18 CP` (`1 CP` per Rank)
  * **2 Signature Traits (`1 CP` each) + 3 Recommended Core Features (`9 CP`):** `13 CP`
  * **Customization Budget:** `70 CP`
* **Background Allocations (`60 SP` at `0 CP`):** `20 SP Faction + 20 SP Origin + 20 SP Occupation = 60 Skill Ranks`, `4 Recommended Features`, and `4 Traits` at `0 CP` (`Extra Traits = 1 CP` each).
* **Universal Straight Pricing:** `+5 CP` per `+1` Attribute, `-5 CP` refund per `-1` Attribute penalty, and `1 CP` per `1` Skill Rank (`5 CP` per `5` Skill Ranks) across both Species Packages and post-species customization (zero package discount).
* **Vitality, Health & Structure Pools (Zero Stamina Scaling):** Biological characters start with **Base 30 Vitality** and **Base 30 Health**; Synthetic/Construct characters combine both into **Base 60 Structure Points (SP)**. Pools scale strictly at **`+5 points per 1 CP`** spent (Suggested Max: `60` each / `120 SP`; **NEVER scaled by Stamina**). The **Stamina Modifier** serves as **Base Toughness**, subtracting point-for-point from incoming wound damage after Armor DR.
* **Personal Hindrance Cap (`+10 CP` Maximum):** Personal character Hindrances grant at most **`+10 CP`** during creation. **Species-level hindrances and cybernetic/xeno Stigmas are exempt from this 10-point cap.**

## Part I — Alignment & Summary Matrix Table

| Pipeline Stage / Subsystem | Canonical Module Reference | Core Allocation / Formula | Primary Role in Operator Creation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. Concept & Identity** | `operator/1.01 CHARACTER CREATION.md` | Narrative Background, Personality, and Operational Role | Defines the Operator's dramatic premise, squad niche, and factional anchor. |
| **2. Character Points (CP)** | `operator/1.01 CHARACTER CREATION.md` | `150 CP` (`80-CP Chassis` + `70-CP Customization`) | Establishes the universal point-buy currency across all creation stages. |
| **3. Pipeline I: Identity** | `character_creation/1.01.PipelineIdentity.md` | `Ability Scores` (`5 CP/+1`), `Species`, `Faction (20 SP)`, `Origin (20 SP)`, `Occupation (20 SP)` | Locks in biological heritage and grants `60 SP`, `4 Features`, and `4 Traits` at `0 CP`. |
| **4. Pipeline II: Capabilities** | `character_creation/1.01.PipelineCapabilities.md` | `Tech Level (TL 3 = 0 CP)`, `Pools (+5/CP)`, `Hindrances (+10 CP cap)`, `Features (3/2 CP)`, `Skills (1 CP/Rank)`, `Augmentations` | Configures technological era, survivability buffers, flaws, talents, and cybernetics. |
| **5. Pipeline III: Wealth & Meta** | `character_creation/1.01.StartingWealthAndMeta.md` | `Starting WS`, `Golden Rule (CR <= WS)`, `Liquidity Gap`, `Awakened & Invocations` | Equips the Operator via EUFT Wealth leverage and unlocks Metaphysic Disciplines. |
| **6. Attributes & Saves** | `character_creation/1.01.Attributes.md` | `STR (Might)`, `AGI (Reflex)`, `STA (Fortitude)`, `INT (Reason)`, `WIS (Willpower)`, `CHA (Etiquette)` | Governs raw capability checks, active/passive Saving Throws (`2d10 + 2 + 2*Attr`), and Skill Synergy. |
| **7. Perception & Detection** | `character_creation/1.01.Perception.md` | `Perception Base = INT + WIS` + `Alertness / Attune / Insight / Knowledge (Tech)` | Resolves environmental awareness, metaphysical sensing, social reading, and technical scanning. |
| **8. Vitality, Health & Structure** | `character_creation/1.01.VitalityHealthStructure.md` | `Base 30 Vitality / 30 Health` (`60 SP`) + `5 per 1 CP`; `STA = Base Toughness` | Separates non-lethal grazing/fatigue from lethal trauma with zero Stamina pool scaling. |
| **9. Karma & Plot Points** | `character_creation/1.01.Karma.md` | `Base 3 Karma Points` (Session Reset) \| `Negative Karma Limit = CHA + 1` | Provides meta-currency for Advantage (`I Got This`), rerolls, condition relief, and heroic feats. |
| **10. Movement Modes** | `character_creation/1.01.Movement.md` | `Ground (30 ft)`, `Flying (2x)`, `Swimming (1/2x)`, `Climbing`, `Burrowing`, `Flicker` | Standardizes tactical paces, subtlety penalties, aerial maneuverability, and fatigue checks. |
| **11. Rest, Death & Dying** | `character_creation/1.01.RestAndDying.md` | `Full Rest (6–8 hrs)`, `Light Rest (1–3 hrs)`, `Stability = STA + 5`, `Revivification (-5 AP Debt)` | Manages resource recovery, the Unified Mortality State at `0 Health`, and resuscitation penalties. |
| **12. Experience & Tiers** | `character_creation/1.01.Experience.md` | `1 AP = 1 CP` (`+1 Increment Rule`) \| `Tier 1 (150 CP)` to `Tier 4 (450+ CP)` | Tracks Session/Story Awards and long-term progression across the four Power Scale Tiers. |

## Part II — Complete Unabridged Profiles & Rules Entries

### 1. Introduction to Character Creation

Players embark on a thrilling, customizable adventure across the Tangent universe where they hold the power to shape their character's capabilities, allegiances, and destiny. This customization system grants players the freedom to craft unique and unforgettable characters that resonate with their playstyles and preferences.

A diverse range of species awaits players, each possessing distinct attributes and abilities that influence the course of their journey. From Humans, known for their adaptability and resilience, to mystical Alterian Elves with an innate affinity for magic and the Resonance, the choice of species sets the biological and cultural foundation for a character's strengths and weaknesses.

Furthermore, players can delve into a rich array of planetary and habitat origins, uncovering the profound impact of their character's past on their present and guiding their future. Whether raised in a bustling urban metropolis, a serene agricultural village, a nomadic spacer flotilla, or an enlightened enclave, each origin bestows unique advantages, formative traits, recommended features, and skills that shape a character's journey.

The game further immerses players in a vibrant galaxy populated by various competing factions and diverse occupations. Aligning with a faction grants access to exclusive resources, cultural aesthetics, training, and missions, allowing players to forge alliances and shape the interstellar political landscape. Additionally, choosing an occupation provides specialized skills, career traits, and baseline wealth tailored to specific playstyles. From skilled warriors to cunning covert operatives and wise scholars, each occupation offers a distinct path toward character development.

Players have the ability to create characters that are not only powerful and effective in the field but also possess intriguing personalities and captivating backstories. Every decision made during character creation has a lasting mechanical and narrative impact, ensuring that each character is truly unique and memorable. Every character is a reflection of the player's creativity and strategic thinking, making the journey through this immersive world a truly personal and unforgettable experience.

### 2. Concept

To start the character creation process, players should first envision a general concept for their character. This involves thinking about several key aspects that will shape their character's identity and operational role in the game:

* **Background:** What is the character's background and upbringing? This includes their family, social status, education, and life experiences. Background will shape the character's personality, skills, and worldview.
* **Personality:** What kind of person is the character? Are they brave, analytical, cunning, compassionate, or something else entirely? Personality traits will guide the character's decisions and interactions with others.
* **Role:** What role will the character play in the game world and within their squad? Will they be a hero, a villain, a supporting specialist, a diplomat, a front-line vanguard, a technomancer, or something else? This will influence the character's goals, motivations, and the types of challenges they will face.

* **Walkthrough Example (Concept):**
  > *Xy'larra is from a merchant clan of Alterian Elves; she is a seasoned diplomat with a thirst for exploration. She is driven by a deep curiosity about the vastness of the galaxy and a desire to forge connections with newly contacted cultures.*

### 3. Character Points (`150 CP` Starting Budget)

Players are given **150 Character Points (CP)** at the start of character creation—which may be allocated freely via custom point-buy or structured via an **80-CP Playable Archetype Chassis (`1.02 ARCHETYPES.md`) + 70-CP Customization Budget**—in addition to the foundational **60 Skill Ranks, 4 Recommended Features, and 4 Traits** gained at **0 CP** from the character's Faction, Origin, and Occupation packages. These points are used to purchase various aspects of their character from any section they choose, including:

* **Ability Scores (`5 CP` per `+1` / `-5 CP` per `-1`):** The six basic ability scores (*Strength, Agility, Stamina, Intellect, Wisdom, Charisma*), with human averages of `+0`. Both inside a **Species Package** (`1.03 SPECIES.md`) and during post-species customization, raising an Ability Score costs a straight **5 CP per +1** and penalties refund **-5 CP per -1** (zero package discount; maximum starting raw score of `+4` before species or augmentation modifiers; racial paragon ceiling is `5 + Species Modifier`).
* **Vitality, Health & Structure (`1 CP` per `+5` Points — Zero Stamina Scaling):** Biological characters begin with a flat base of **30 Vitality** and **30 Health** (Synthetics and Constructs combine both into **Base 60 Structure Points [SP]**), increased strictly at a rate of **+5 points per 1 CP spent** (Suggested Starting Maximum: **60 Vitality / 60 Health**, or **120 SP**). **Stamina NEVER increases Vitality or Health pools;** instead, the Stamina Modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming wound damage as **Base Toughness** after Armor DR.
* **Species Package (`Variable CP`):** This includes the base species and any associated biological abilities, traits, attribute adjustments (`+5 CP` per `+1` / `-5 CP` per `-1`), and species skill ranks (`1 CP` per `1 Rank` / `5 CP` per `5 Ranks`) (`1.03 SPECIES.md`). CP cost of a Species package is variable.
* **Faction, Origin and Occupation (`0 CP`):** These do not cost Character Points, but grant foundational skills, features, and traits. In total, they grant **60 Skill Ranks** (`20 SP Faction + 20 SP Origin + 20 SP Occupation`), **4 Recommended Features**, and **4 Traits** at **0 CP** to ground the character with baseline competencies; these are not "bonus" features, but foundational capabilities the character has gained from being established in the galaxy. Extra traits beyond the four free selections cost **1 CP each**.
* **Technology (`0 CP` at `TL 3`):** No CP cost at the galactic baseline of **Tech Level 3 (Space Age)**; costs more to hail from a more advanced era (**+10 CP for TL 4**, **+20 CP for TL 5**) or grants **+10 CP per Tech Level under 3** (`-10 CP` at TL 2, `-20 CP` at TL 1, `-30 CP` at TL 0).
* **Skills (`1 CP` per `1 Rank` / `5 CP` per `5 Ranks`):** These represent a character's learned abilities and expertise (`1.07 SKILLS.md`). Skills cost a straight **1 CP per 1 Skill Rank** (`5 CP` per `5 Ranks` — zero package discount; maximum starting rank at creation is **Rank 11 [Expert]**).
* **Features (`3 CP` Standard / `2 CP` Recommended):** These are special abilities, talents, or enhancements that can be acquired through various means (`1.08 FEATURES.md`). Features have a base cost of **3 CP**, adjusted by `-1 CP` (to **2 CP**) when listed as a **Recommended Feature** by the character's Species, Faction, Origin, Occupation, or Archetype (minimum cost of **1 CP** per feature).
* **Hindrances (`Up to +10 CP Maximum`):** Personal flaws and drawbacks of a character (`1.09 HINDRANCES.md`) taken to gain bonus Character Points, up to a strict maximum of **+10 CP** during creation. **Species-level hindrances and Xeno/Cybernetic Stigmas are exempt from this 10-point cap.**
* **Augmentations (`3 CP` Augmented Feature + CP/Node Costs):** Enhanced with permanent cybernetic, bioware, or meta-tech modifications (`2.00.Augmentations.md`). The **Augmented** Feature (*Augmented, Heavy, Extreme*) is required depending on the stage of invasive augmentation (3 CP per tier, granting a 6 CP augmentation credit per tier) alongside anatomical **Node** capacity (while commonplace civilian implants cost `0 CP` and `0 Nodes`).
* **Meta Discipline (`Awakened` Feature + Skill/Invocation CP):** Developing metaphysical capabilities, such as magic or psychic powers (`4.00 METAPHYSICS.md`). The **Awakened** Feature is required to access **Attune** and the Metafocus Disciplines, while the **Special Ability** Feature allows a character to use specific invocation effects without deep discipline training (regardless of the source).
* **Property (`Wealth Score`, `Credits`, `Crafting`, `Conjuration`, or `Benefit`):** Equipped with essential tools and belongings (`2.00 ECONOMATRIX.md`). Property is obtained via the **Wealth Score (WS)** (secured auto-buy transaction against the character's worth when `Item CR <= WS`), **Credits** (in-game liquid currency for paying the `Liquidity Gap = Value[Item CR] - Value[WS]`), **Crafting** items with the character's or allies' skills and materials via the Productivity Engine, **Conjuration** using Metafocus arts to create a temporary or permanent item (if temporary, there is `0 CP` cost and it fades away at the end of the scene or sooner; permanent conjured items kept on the character folio require CP purchase), or the **Benefit** Feature.

* **Walkthrough Example (Character Points):**
  > *Xy'larra has **150 CP** to spend throughout the character creation pipeline, alongside her 60 free Background Skill Ranks, 4 Recommended Features, and 4 Background Traits.*

### 4. Character Creation & Core Stats Directory Index

* **[Pipeline Part I: Identity & Background](./character_creation/1.01.PipelineIdentity.md)** — *Ability Scores, Species Package, Faction (`20 SP`), Origin (`20 SP`), and Occupation (`20 SP`) Selection (with full Xy'larra walkthrough)*
* **[Pipeline Part II: Capabilities, Vitality & Loadout](./character_creation/1.01.PipelineCapabilities.md)** — *Technology Level, CP-Scaled Vitality/Health/Structure Pools (`Base 30 + 5/CP`), Personal Hindrances (`+10 CP` cap), Recommended Features, Skills, and Augmentations*
* **[Pipeline Part III: Property, Starting Wealth & Meta](./character_creation/1.01.StartingWealthAndMeta.md)** — *Property Acquisition, Starting Wealth Score, The Golden Rule, Liquidity Gap, Financial Status Hierarchy, and Meta Awakening*

Detailed rules and reference tables for Attributes, Saving Throws, Perception, Vitality/Health/Structure, Karma, Movement Modes, Rest/Dying, and Experience Advancement are organized in `./character_creation/`:

* **[Attributes & Saving Throws](./character_creation/1.01.Attributes.md)** — *Attribute costs (`5 CP` per `+1`), general checks, active/passive saving throws (`2d10 + 2 + 2*Attr` / `CR 12 + 2*Attr`), all 5 Skill Synergy examples (`+1` per `5` points over `CR 10`), and full unabridged profiles for Strength (Might), Agility (Reflex), Stamina (Fortitude), Intellect (Reason), Wisdom (Willpower), and Charisma (Etiquette)*
* **[Perception & Detection](./character_creation/1.01.Perception.md)** — *Derived Perception base (`INT + WIS`), default `Alertness` detection checks, focused sensory types (`Attune`, `Insight`, `Knowledge [Technology]`), and environmental modifiers*
* **[Vitality, Health & Structure](./character_creation/1.01.VitalityHealthStructure.md)** — *CP-scaled pools (`Base 30 Vitality / 30 Health / 60 SP`, `+5` per `1 CP`, suggested max `60/120`, zero Stamina pool scaling), Stamina point-for-point Base Toughness reduction, and 50/50 Concussive damage splitting*
* **[Karma & Plot Points](./character_creation/1.01.Karma.md)** — *Karma Pool basics, session reset, spending Karma (`I Got This`, `Not What I Meant`, `Shake it Off`, `Second Wind`, `So Mote it Be`, `By Will Alone`), Plot Points, and Negative Karma (`CHA + 1` debt limit)*
* **[Movement Modes](./character_creation/1.01.Movement.md)** — *Ground (`Walk`, `Jog`, `Running`, `Sprinting`, `Crawl`, `Slow Crawl`), Flying (`Flight`, `Sail`, `Surge`, `Diving`, `Gliding`, `Hover`), Swimming (`Swimming`, `Glide`, `Stroke`, `Treading`), Climbing (`Climbing`, `Scaling`, `Fast Ascent`, `Fast Descent`), Burrowing, Flicker, and Movement Fatigue rules*
* **[Rest, Death & Dying](./character_creation/1.01.RestAndDying.md)** — *Full Rest, Light Rest tiers (`Nap`, `Lounging`, `Light Duty`), The Unified Mortality State (`Stability Points = STA + 5`, losing 1 per turn at `0 Health`), Stabilization (`CR 15 Medicine`), and The High Cost of Dying (`-5 AP Debt` and loss of all Karma)*
* **[Experience & Advancement](./character_creation/1.01.Experience.md)** — *Story Awards, Session Awards, Epic Actions, Award Points (`1 AP = 1 CP`), the `+1` Increment Rule, and The Power Scale Table (Tiers 1–4)*

## DISCREPANCY & RESTORATION LEDGER

* **DISC-101 (Introductory Prose & Directory Index Restoration):** Restored all 5 narrative introduction paragraphs, the 3-pillar Concept section, and the complete Character Points overview from Codex `1.01 CHARACTER CREATION` (`1Uk0LzvpBhTSr0X4o4sFMGFbK7c90y8C4RxBlbyTdmTQ`), integrated with the canonical `./character_creation/` directory index.
* **DISC-102 (Mechanical Normalization & Zero Stamina Scaling):** Enforced the `150 CP` starting budget (`80-CP Archetype Chassis + 70-CP Customization Budget`), `60 Background SP` (`20 SP Faction + 20 SP Origin + 20 SP Occupation`), straight attribute (`+5 CP` per `+1`, `-5 CP` per `-1`) and skill (`1 CP` per `1 Rank`) pricing, `Base 30 Vitality / 30 Health` (`+5` per `1 CP`, never scaled by Stamina; `Stamina Mod = Base Toughness`), `+10 CP` Personal Hindrance Cap, and replaced all occurrences of "Recommended Features" with "Recommended Features".
