# **3.00.04 DAMAGE TYPES & CRITICAL INJURY MATRIX**

> **Module Scope:** 23-Type Master Damage Classification Matrix across Energy (8), Kinetic (5), Elemental (6) & Planar/Psychic (4)

## **DOCUMENT HEADER & MECHANICAL AUTHORITY BLOCK**

* **Mechanical Authority (`/game_rules` Wins):** Core Resolution `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`; Advantage/Disadvantage `+1d10` per stack (keep highest 2 / lowest 2); Critical Hit (`Natural 20` / double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19, 18, and lower`) = `Rolled Dice + 10` (e.g., `20 -> 30`, `19 -> 29`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + Critical Effect; Fumble (`Natural 2` / double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3, 4, and higher`) = `Rolled Dice becomes flat -10` + Situational Complication.
* **Character & Pool Axioms:** `150 CP` starting budget (`80 CP` Archetype Chassis + `70 CP` Customization); `60 SP` free Background skills (`20 SP` Faction + `20 SP` Origin + `20 SP` Occupation + `4 Recommended Features` + `4 Traits` at `0 CP`); Universal Straight Pricing (`+5 CP` per `+1` Attribute, `-5 CP` per `-1`, `1 CP` per `1` Skill Rank); Personal Hindrance Cap `+10 CP` (Species-level disadvantages and Stigmas exempt); `Base 30 Vitality` and `Base 30 Health` (`Base 60 Structure Points [SP]` for Synthetics/Constructs), scaled strictly at `+5 points per 1 CP` spent with **zero Stamina scaling**; Stamina Modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after highest single-domain **Armor DR** (**Armor Layering Cap**: biological, cybernetic, and wearable DR never stack).

## **PART II: COMPLETE UNABRIDGED PROFILES & RULES ENTRIES**

Tangent categorizes all offensive trauma into three overarching families—**Energy**, **Kinetic**, and **Variative (Elemental, Planar & Psychic)**—comprising **23 distinct Damage Types**. Each damage type interacts uniquely with armor resistances, environmental conditions, and anatomical hit locations.

---

## **1. MASTER DAMAGE TYPE CLASSIFICATION TABLE**

| Damage Family | Damage Type | Primary Trauma & Critical Effect | Typical Weapon / Environmental Sources |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Energy** | **Pyro / Fire** | Thermal combustion & blistering; **Ignites** (`1/2` dmg for 2 rnds) on Crit. | Flamethrowers, plasma weapons, incendiary rounds, *Energy: Elemental*. |
| **Energy** | **Cryo / Cold** | Cellular freezing & frostbite; **Slows / Freezes** (`Speed 0`, brittle) on Crit. | Cryo-jets, endothermic grenades, cryo-blades, deep space exposure. |
| **Energy** | **Spectral / Phase** | Dimensional phase disruption; **bypasses physical cover & Armor DR**. | Phase blades, tachyon lances, spirit weapons, rift anomalies. |
| **Energy** | **Sonic / Sound** | Acoustic resonance & rupture; **ignores physical Armor DR & Stuns** on Crit. | Sonic blasters, concussive screamers, Lapis dragon breath. |
| **Energy** | **Voltic / Electrical** | Neural/electronic surge; **`x2` vs. drones/shields & Stuns** on Crit. | Arc rifles, shock batons, railguns, EMPs, Cuprum breath. |
| **Energy** | **Corrosive / Disintegration** | Molecular dissolution; **`1/2` dmg for 2 rnds & degrades Armor `-2 DR`**. | Acid sprayers, disintegrator beams, nanite swarms, Verdant breath. |
| **Energy** | **Ra-D / Radiation** | Ionizing cellular necrosis; **Fortitude Save or `-1 STA` drain**. | Particle beams, neutron weapons, breached fission cores, solar flares. |
| **Energy** | **Force Pulse / Disruption** | Pure kinetic-field repulsion; **ignores `1/2` Armor DR + Knockback**. | Repulsor cannons, disruptor rifles, *Energy: Force* invocations. |
| **Kinetic** | **Blunt** | Crushing impact & bone fracture; **`+1` Stun CR** on Weapon Focus. | Hammers, clubs, maces, power fists, unarmed strikes. |
| **Kinetic** | **Slashing** | Laceration & limb severing; **inflicts `Bleed 1+`** on Crit. | Swords, axes, machetes, vibro-blades, monomolecular blades, claws. |
| **Kinetic** | **Piercing** | Deep armor perforation; **`+1` Penetration (AP)** & vital organ strikes. | Spears, arrows, flechettes, gauss rifles, railguns, sniper rounds. |
| **Kinetic** | **Concussive / Impact** | High-velocity shockwave; **splits 50/50 between Vitality and Health**. | Explosives, artillery shells, falling damage, vehicular crashes, siege weapons. |
| **Kinetic** | **Bleed** | Ongoing circulatory depletion; **bypasses Armor DR and Stamina Toughness**. | Serrated blades, shrapnel, critical slashing/piercing wounds. |
| **Variative (Elemental)** | **Radiant / Light** | Photonic searing; **Blinds optics/eyes (`1d4` rnds)** on Crit. | Lasers, flashbangs, *Sunburst*, photokinesis, solar invocations. |
| **Variative (Elemental)** | **Umbral / Shadow** | Entropic light-draining cold; **Entangles in clinging shadow** on Crit. | Dark energy weapons, Kovian shadow-tech, *Illusion: Shadow*. |
| **Variative (Elemental)** | **Air Elemental** | Barometric shear & **gale knockback (`10 ft` per Stage)**. | Compressed air cannons, vortex generators, aerokinesis. |
| **Variative (Elemental)** | **Fire Elemental** | Living primordial flame; **bypasses mundane fire resistance**. | Pyromancy, fire elemental evocation, primordial dragonfire. |
| **Variative (Elemental)** | **Earth Elemental** | Tectonic crushing, tremors & **knockdown (Prone)**. | Seismic weapons, gravity crushers, geokinesis, earth elementals. |
| **Variative (Elemental)** | **Water Elemental** | Hydrostatic crushing, **knockback & drowning pressure**. | High-pressure water cannons, water vortex generators, hydrokinesis. |
| **Variative (Planar/Mind)** | **Celestial** | Empyreal Syntropic judgment; **`x2` damage vs. Undead/Fiends & Banishes**. | Consecrated relics, holy water, divine light invocations. |
| **Variative (Planar/Mind)** | **Infernal** | Cthonic Dissonant hellfire; **corrupts healing until cleansed**. | Infernal pacts, cthonic relics, Stygian corruption. |
| **Variative (Planar/Mind)** | **Dimensional** | Spatial shearing & warp displacement; **ignores all physical Armor DR**. | Interdimensional cannons, reality anchors, rift tears, *Dimension* phase-strikes. |
| **Variative (Planar/Mind)** | **Psyche / Mental** | Direct synaptic trauma; **bypasses physical Armor DR** *(mitigated by Willpower)*. | Neural disruptors, psychic amplifiers, *Mental: Projection*, psionic blasts. |

---

## **2. ENERGY DAMAGE TYPES**

### **1. Pyro / Fire Damage**

This damage type focuses on burning and incinerating targets, causing immediate pain and potential long-term thermal trauma. It is particularly effective against flammable materials and creatures vulnerable to heat. Fire damage often inflicts ongoing **Burning** damage, and critical hits ignite the target, causing additional damage over time (`1/2` initial damage for 2 rounds).

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Pyrokinesis:* The ability to create and control fire with the mind—including conjuring flames, shaping them into walls or projectiles, and directing their intensity.
  * *Fire Evocation:* Summoning fire elementals or spirits to fight on your behalf, unleashing fire attacks while remaining resistant or immune to thermal damage.
  * *Fire Enchantments:* Imbuing weapons or objects with fire magic to ignite targets on contact, deal bonus Pyro damage, or grant thermal protection.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Torches, Arrows, and Grenades:* Torches for melee, flammable-tipped arrows for ranged strikes, and clay grenades filled with incendiary pitch.
  * *Primitive Flamethrowers:* Project a stream of ignited fuel in a cone or line, effective at close range and causing widespread panic.
  * *Fire Traps:* Pits filled with flammable oil or mechanisms that ignite when triggered.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Flamethrowers:* Infantry or vehicle-mounted units with greater range, accuracy, and fuel compression for area denial.
  * *Incendiary Rounds:* Firearm ammunition designed to ignite upon impact, setting targets ablaze.
  * *Fire Bombs:* Explosive devices filled with incendiary gel to damage structures and clear bunkers.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Laser Weapons:* High-energy coherent light beams focused to ignite targets with pinpoint precision and range.
  * *Plasma Weapons:* Project superheated ionized plasma, dealing devastating Pyro damage and melting through armor (often with shorter ranges or cooling cycles).
  * *Energy Pulse Weapons:* Emit pulses of intense thermal energy across single, burst, or spray firing modes.
* **Additional Notes:** Characters can use Pyro weapons to target vulnerable fuel cells or create environmental fire hazards that control battlefield movement.

### **2. Cryo / Cold Damage**

This damage type focuses on freezing and chilling targets—causing immediate pain, slowing movement, and inducing frostbite, hypothermia, or structural embrittlement. Critical hits can **Freeze** the target (`Speed 0`, vulnerable to Blunt and Sonic shattering).

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Cryokinesis:* Creating and controlling cold and ice with the mind—conjuring chilling blasts, forming ice barriers, or coating surfaces in slick frost.
  * *Ice Evocation:* Summoning ice elementals or spirits resistant to cold that unleash freezing attacks.
  * *Cold Enchantments:* Imbuing weapons or armor with cryo-magic to freeze targets on contact or shield against extreme cold.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Alchemical Cold Grenades:* Vessels filled with endothermic reagents that release intense localized cold upon shattering.
  * *Environmental Ice and Snow:* Utilizing natural blizzards, avalanches, and ice hazards.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Cryo-Grenades and Mines:* Release blasts of supercooled gas or shrapnel to disable vehicles, freeze mechanisms, or incapacitate infantry.
  * *Cryo-Guns:* Fire projectiles filled with cryogenic agents, causing structural embrittlement on impact.
  * *Cryo-Sprayers:* Project a continuous stream of liquid nitrogen/helium to create frozen barriers or slow enemy waves.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Cryo-Lasers:* High-energy endothermic beams that rapidly extract thermal energy, inducing structural failure in mechanical or biological systems.
  * *Cryo-Blades:* Melee weapons with supercooled edges or cryogenic chambers that weaken and shatter metal armor on contact.
  * *Cryo-Mines:* Proximity devices that flash-freeze targets in choke points.

### **3. Spectral / Phase Damage**

Also known as incorporeal or ghost damage, **Spectral / Phase Damage** bypasses physical armor and directly affects the target's essence or internal life force. It is uniquely effective against incorporeal entities (ghosts, spirits, phased creatures) while also harming corporeal beings by disrupting internal bio-energies and **ignoring physical Armor Damage Resistance (DR)**.

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Phasing:* Shifting between corporeal and incorporeal states to pass through solid matter, avoid physical strikes, and attack a target's internal form.
  * *Ghostly Touch:* Attacks that pass unimpeded through armor to drain life force, induce terror, or disrupt concentration.
  * *Spirit Weapons:* Conjuring blades or blasts of pure spiritual energy that strike directly at the target's essence.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Blessed Weapons:* Arms imbued via sacred rituals to harm incorporeal beings and bypass mundane armor.
  * *Ghost-Banishing Artifacts:* Wards and relics that weaken or repel phased entities.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Phase Disruptors:* Emit fields or projectiles that destabilize phase states, forcing incorporeal beings into corporeal vulnerability.
  * *Ghost-Detecting Equipment:* Resonance sensors capable of tracking non-corporeal signatures.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Phase Rifles:* Fire projectiles that shift out of phase to bypass external armor before re-materializing inside the target.
  * *Phase Blades:* Melee weapons whose edges flicker across dimensional phases, passing through plate armor to strike vital organs or internal circuitry.
  * *Phase Fields:* Personal or vehicular generators that phase the user through solid obstacles or disrupt enemy phase-tech.

### **4. Sonic / Sound Damage**

Utilizes high-decibel acoustic waves and resonant vibrations to harm targets—causing mild disorientation, ruptured eardrums, severe internal organ trauma, or molecular shattering of rigid materials. Sonic damage **ignores most physical Armor DR** and disrupts delicate electronics and communications.

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Sonokinesis:* Generating focused sonic blasts, subtle auditory disorientation, or complex acoustic constructs with the mind.
  * *Sound Evocation:* Summoning acoustic elementals or constructs of pure resonant sound.
  * *Sonic Enchantments:* Imbuing weapons to emit shattering vibrations on impact or erecting acoustic barriers.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *War Horns and Drums:* Produce disorienting low-frequency booms that demoralize foes and disrupt formation coordination.
  * *Whistling Projectiles:* Arrows and bolts carved to emit piercing shrieks that distract and disorient targets.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Sonic Grenades and Mines:* Release concussive acoustic bursts that rupture eardrums, induce vertigo, and stun targets.
  * *Sonic Cannons and Blasters:* Emit focused acoustic beams capable of incapacitating or killing targets via internal cavitation trauma.
  * *Sonic Emitters and Disruptors:* Generate continuous frequencies that jam communications and induce severe nausea.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Sonic Lasers (Masers / Grasers):* Coherent acoustic/microwave beams that sever molecular bonds with surgical precision.
  * *Sonic Shields and Barriers:* Standing-wave acoustic fields that deflect projectiles and absorb kinetic shock.
  * *Sonic Cloaking and Stealth Devices:* Active phase-cancellation arrays that silence footsteps, thrusters, and gunfire completely.

### **5. Voltic / Electrical Damage**

Delivers high-voltage electrical shocks and plasma arcs—causing immediate pain, disrupting biological nervous systems (**Stunned** condition), and overloading electronic circuits and energy shields (`x2` damage against unhardened drones, shields, and electronics).

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Electrokinesis:* Generating lightning arcs, manipulating electrical currents, disable electronic locks, or powering devices mentally.
  * *Electricity Evocation:* Summoning storm elementals or living lightning constructs.
  * *Electrical Enchantments:* Imbuing weapons to shock targets on contact or shield against electrical discharges.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Leyden Jars:* Early electrostatic capacitors capable of discharging a localized shock on contact.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Stun Guns and Tasers:* Deliver high-voltage, low-amperage shocks to incapacitate nervous systems non-lethally.
  * *Electrical Projectiles:* Taser rounds and electro-flechettes effective against cybernetically augmented foes or powered armor.
  * *Electrical Traps and Mines:* Electrified grids and proximity mines used for perimeter security.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Railguns:* Use electromagnetic Lorentz forces to accelerate slugs to hypersonic speeds while delivering a residual Voltic surge on impact.
  * *Electrical Cannons and Arc Blasters:* Project sustained lightning arcs that chain between conductive targets and overload internal power plants.
  * *Electrical Fields and Barriers:* High-voltage plasma screens that vaporize incoming ordnance.
  * *EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse) Devices:* Wide-area bursts that disable unshielded electronics, cybernetics, and vehicles across a battlefield.

### **6. Corrosive / Disintegration Damage**

Breaks down and dissolves a target's physical structure at the chemical or molecular level. Highly effective against armor, flesh, and fortifications, Corrosive damage **degrades Target Armor DR (`-2 DR` per hit)** and inflicts ongoing dissolution damage (`1/2` damage for 2 rounds), with critical hits causing structural collapse or total disintegration.

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Acid Manipulation:* Conjuring and shaping corrosive fluids or entropy fields to dissolve locks, armor, or barriers.
  * *Acid Evocation:* Summoning corrosive oozes or elemental entities.
  * *Corrosive Enchantments:* Imbuing blades or projectiles to eat through armor on contact.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Alchemical Acids:* Thrown glass flasks of vitriol or caustic bases that splash across armor and flesh.
  * *Natural Acids:* Monster bile, digestive enzymes, and venomous plant extracts applied to weapons.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Acid Grenades and Bombs:* Detonate into pressurized caustic mist that melts armor plating and organic tissue.
  * *Acid Guns and Launchers:* Fire capsules of concentrated fluoroantimonic/industrial acid to weaken structural weak points.
  * *Acid Sprayers and Projectors:* Heavy chemical hoses that dissolve fortifications and deny corridors.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Molecular Acid Weapons:* Hyper-reactive compounds that sever molecular bonds instantaneously, bypassing conventional DR.
  * *Corrosive Energy (Disintegrator) Weapons:* Directed beams that strip atomic electrons, reducing targets to fine ash.
  * *Nanite-Based Corrosive Swarms:* Programmable grey-goo micro-swarms that infiltrate armor seams and consume target materials from within.

### **7. Ra-D / Radiation Damage**

Harnesses ionizing radiation (alpha, beta, gamma, and neutron emissions) to shred cellular DNA and induce lattice defects in electronics. Causes immediate cellular necrosis alongside long-term **Radiation Sickness (`-1 Stamina` drain on a failed Fortitude Save)**. Particularly lethal against unshielded biological targets and unhardened processors.

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Radiokinesis:* Mentally generating ionizing rays, sensing fissile materials, or accelerating radioactive decay and transmutation.
  * *Radiation Evocation:* Summoning stellar or nuclear elemental entities that project radioactive auras.
  * *Radiation Enchantments:* Imbuing weapons with necrotic isotope energy or warding suits against cosmic radiation.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Crude Radioactive Materials:* Unrefined pitchblende or meteoric isotopes used in poison traps (carrying severe self-exposure risk).
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Radiological Weapons:* Area-denial devices dispersing radioactive isotopes.
  * *Radiation Guns & Grenades:* Emit focused ionizing bursts that create contaminated hazard zones and weaken defenders over time.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Neutron Weapons:* High-energy particle beams that penetrate thick hull plating to kill biological crews while leaving structures intact.
  * *Gamma-Ray Lasers (Grasers):* Coherent gamma beams causing instantaneous cellular breakdown and acute radiation trauma.
  * *Radiation Emitters:* Continuous field generators used to sterilize boarding corridors or weaken entrenched forces.

### **8. Force Pulse / Disruption Damage**

Disrupts the fundamental kinetic and molecular forces holding matter together, delivering pure concussive repulsion or destabilizing atomic lattices. Force Pulse damage **ignores `1/2` of the Target's Armor DR** and frequently inflicts knockback or structural shattering on critical hits.

* **Metaphysical:**
  * *Disruption Field:* Creating localized fields that weaken molecular bonds to breach walls or shatter weapons.
  * *Force Manipulation (*Energy: Force*):* Directing gravity, inertia, and telekinetic repulsion to hurl enemies or deflect ordnance.
  * *Disruptive Enchantments:* Imbuing weapons with kinetic-field amplifiers that bypass half of physical armor.
* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Crude Disruption Devices:* Unstable alchemical/resonance catalysts that release erratic kinetic shockwaves.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Disruptor Pistols and Rifles:* Fire bolts of cohesive force energy that weaken molecular integrity and make armor brittle.
  * *Disruption Grenades and Mines:* Release concentrated force waves to breach bulkheads and scatter formations.
  * *Disruption Fields:* Localized barriers that disintegrate incoming physical matter.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Disruptor Cannons and Beam Weapons:* Capital and vehicular mounts capable of tearing apart hulls and fortifications.
  * *Disruptor Shields:* Defensive fields that destabilize and shatter incoming kinetic slugs and missiles.
  * *Molecular Disruptors:* Precision arrays tuned to the resonant frequency of specific alloys, crumbling enemy weapons or armor without harming surrounding matter.

---

## **3. KINETIC DAMAGE TYPES**

### **9. Blunt Damage**

Focuses on crushing and bruising targets through high-mass impact—causing widespread trauma, fractured bones, internal bleeding, and concussions. Blunt weapons gain **+1 to Stun CR** with *Weapon Focus* and excel at buckling rigid plate armor and smashing machinery.

* **Archaic Tech:** *Clubs and Staves* (wood, bone, or iron-shod), *Maces and Flails* (hinged or flanged metal heads designed to crush armor), and *Hammers and War Picks*.
* **Modern Tech:** *Shock Batons and Truncheons*, *Telescopic Batons*, and weighted *Impact Weapons*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *Power Fists and Augmented Gauntlets* (hydraulic/servo-assisted), *Force Hammers and Kinetic Mallets* (amplified by micro-thrusters or repulsor fields), and *Gravity Weapons* that crush targets under localized G-loads.

### **10. Slashing Damage**

Focuses on cutting, hacking, and shearing targets—causing wide lacerations, severe **Bleed** trauma on critical hits, and potential limb severing. Particularly devastating against unarmored or lightly armored targets and exposed joints.

* **Archaic Tech:** *Axes and Hatchets* (heavy chopping power), *Swords* (curved scimitars/katanas for slicing; longswords/greatswords for cleaving), and *Sickles and Scythes* (sweeping hooks).
* **Modern Tech:** *Machetes and Kukris*, *Chain Weapons* (segmented chain-whips, kusarigama, and motorized chainswords), and *Vibroblades* (high-frequency ultrasonic blades that slice through ballistic weave and plating).
* **Advanced Tech:** *Monomolecular Blades* (single-atom-thick edges that slice through heavy armor with surgical precision), *Energy Swords* (contained blades of pure photonic/force energy that cauterize wounds), and *Plasma Swords* (superheated magnetic loops that melt through bulkhead steel).

### **11. Piercing Damage**

Focuses on puncturing and perforating targets—concentrating kinetic energy into a narrow point to punch deep into vital organs or exploit seams in heavy armor (`+1 Penetration` bonus).

* **Archaic Tech:** *Arrows and Crossbow Bolts* (bodkin and broadhead), *Spears and Lances* (infantry reach and mounted couched charges), and *Daggers and Stilettos* (concealable blades for armor gaps).
* **Modern Tech:** *Rifle Bayonets*, *Flechettes* (fin-stabilized sub-caliber darts), and *Armor-Piercing (AP) Ammunition* (tungsten-carbide or depleted-uranium cores).
* **Advanced Tech:** *Gauss Rifles and Coilguns* (electromagnetic induction accelerators), *Needle Guns* (silent high-velocity micro-darts delivering neurotoxins), and *Railguns* (conductive-armature hyper-velocity penetrators).

### **12. Concussive / Impact Damage**

Represents massive, full-body kinetic shockwaves from sources larger than the target's body—such as high falls, vehicular collisions, and high-explosive blast waves. **Concussive Damage is divided equally (50/50) between Vitality and Health** whenever the character attempts to mitigate or evade the impact (regardless of whether the check succeeds), and typically **ignores half or all of physical Armor DR**:

* **Archaic Tech:**
  * *Crashing:* High-impact collisions with large objects or mounts *(Half DR if wearing Hard Armor without a Crash Suit option; Force Field DR is half effective)*.
  * *Falling Damage:* Inflicted when falling from beyond one's own height *(Ignores DR of physical armor and force fields; mitigated only by Acrobatics, Grav-Chutes, or flight)*.
  * *Siege Weapons:* Catapults, trebuchets, and battering rams *(Half DR if Hard Armor; Force Field DR is half effective)*.
* **Modern Tech:**
  * *Explosives:* Fragmentation/HE grenades, demolition charges, artillery shells, and landmines *(Half DR of Hard Armor without a Blast Suit option; Force Field DR is half effective)*.
* **Advanced Tech:**
  * *Gravity Weapons:* Localized gravitic implosion projectors *(Ignores physical Armor DR; Force Field DR is half effective)*.
  * *Weaponized Force Fields:* Repulsor rams and kinetic crushers *(Ignores solid physical Armor DR; Force Field DR is fully effective)*.

### **13. Bleed Damage**

**Bleed** is an ongoing circulatory trauma effect triggered by critical hits or specialized serrated/shrapnel weapons (primarily Slashing and Piercing). A bleeding target suffers **`1d4` (or weapon-rated `Bleed X`) direct Health/Vitality damage at the start of each of their turns**, completely **bypassing Armor DR and Stamina Base Toughness** until halted via a **Knowledge (Medicine) Check (`CR 10–15`)**, a trauma patch, or metaphysical healing.

---

## **4. VARIATIVE I: ELEMENTAL DAMAGE TYPES**

### **14. Radiant / Light Damage**

Harnesses coherent photonic energy and solar radiance to sear targets, induce temporary or permanent **Blindness** (`1d4` rounds on Crit), disrupt optical sensors, and dispel darkness/shadow effects. Particularly lethal to subterranean or shadow-bound entities with light sensitivity.

* **Metaphysical:** *Photokinesis* (generating blinding flashes, laser-like beams, and hard-light barriers), *Light Evocation* (summoning solar/luminous elementals), and *Light Enchantments* (weapons that blaze with searing daylight).
* **Archaic Tech:** *Polished Mirrors and Solar Reflectors* and *Alchemical Flare Lamps*.
* **Modern Tech:** *Flashbangs and Stun Grenades* and *High-Intensity Arc Searchlights*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *High-Energy Laser Arrays*, *Photonic Particle Beams*, and *Offensive Holographic Overload Projectors*.

### **15. Umbral / Shadow Damage**

Taps into primal darkness and entropic negative energy—draining warmth and vitality, obscuring vision, inducing dread, and solidifying shadows into tangible tendrils that **Entangle** targets on a critical hit.

* **Metaphysical:** *Umbrokinesis* (*Illusion: Shadow* — solidifying shadow-stuff into blades, snares, and cloaks), *Shadow Evocation* (summoning dark spirits and shadow hounds), and *Shadow Enchantments* (weapons that drink ambient light and siphon vitality).
* **Archaic Tech:** *Alchemical Darkness Powders* and *Shadow-Ward Traps*.
* **Modern Tech:** *Disorienting Strobe Arrays* and *Active Optical Camouflage*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *Dark-Energy / Kovian Umbral Projectors* and *Zero-Point Shadow Fields* that absorb all electromagnetic radiation within their radius.

### **16. Air Elemental Damage**

Harnesses barometric shear, cyclonic winds, and atmospheric pressure gradients—delivering concussive gale blasts, **knocking targets back (`10 ft` per Stage) or Prone**, disrupting flight stability, and creating localized vacuum pockets that suffocate targets.

* **Metaphysical:** *Aerokinesis* (generating wind blasts, vacuum spheres, and hurricane barriers), *Air Evocation* (summoning wind elementals and sylphs), and *Air Enchantments* (weapons that release concussive gale shockwaves on impact).
* **Archaic Tech:** *Giant Bellows* and *Canyon Wind-Funnel Traps*.
* **Modern Tech:** *Compressed Air Cannons* and *Barometric Disruptors*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *Vortex Generators* (creating localized micro-tornadoes) and *Atmospheric Pressure-Wave Emitters*.

### **17. Fire Elemental Damage**

Channels the living, primordial essence of elemental flame (*distinct from mundane thermal combustion*), burning with spiritual and resonant intensity that **bypasses standard mundane thermal insulation** and ignites targets with living fire.

* **Metaphysical:** *Primordial Pyrokinesis*, *Fire Elemental Evocation* (summoning true Salamanders and elemental fire-kin), and *Elemental Fire Enchantments*.
* **Archaic / Modern / Advanced Tech:** *Aetherite-Catalyzed Incendiaries*, *Draconic Flame Projectors*, and *Resonance-Infused Plasma Lances*.

### **18. Earth Elemental Damage**

Channels tectonic mass, seismic shockwaves, and crystalline stone—crushing targets under shifting rock, triggering localized earthquakes that **knock combatants Prone**, and pelting foes with petrifying mineral shards.

* **Metaphysical:** *Geokinesis* (causing rockslides, raising stone walls, and altering ground density), *Earth Evocation* (summoning earth elementals and stone golems), and *Earth Enchantments* (weapons weighted with tectonic density).
* **Archaic Tech:** *Stone-Hurling Siege Engines (Catapults/Trebuchets)* and *Deadfall Rock Traps*.
* **Modern Tech:** *Pattern-Detonated Seismic Charges* and *Heavy Excavation Rams*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *Tectonic Resonance Inducers (Seismic Weapons)* and *High-G Mass Drivers*.

### **19. Water Elemental Damage**

Harnesses hydrostatic pressure, crashing tidal surges, and abyssal currents—bludgeoning targets with high-pressure water jets, sweeping combatants off their feet, and inducing **drowning / hydrostatic crush** trauma.

* **Metaphysical:** *Hydrokinesis* (shaping high-pressure lances, tidal waves, and aqueous spheres), *Water Evocation* (summoning water elementals and nereids), and *Water Enchantments*.
* **Archaic Tech:** *Hydraulic Sluice Traps* and *Pressurized Water Pumps*.
* **Modern Tech:** *High-Pressure Riot/Industrial Water Cutters* and *Hydro-Acoustic Disruptors*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *Maelstrom Vortex Projectors* and *Abyssal Hydrostatic Pressure Emitters*.

---

## **5. VARIATIVE II: PLANAR & PSYCHIC DAMAGE TYPES**

### **20. Celestial Damage**

Embodies empyreal Syntropic order, divine judgment, and the pure radiance of higher planes. Celestial damage deals **double (`x2`) damage to Undead, Fiends, and Dissonant entities**, bypasses unholy Damage Reduction, and frequently carries secondary effects that **banish** extraplanar entities, dispel corruption, or heal allies.

* **Metaphysical:** *Divine Light Manipulation*, *Celestial Evocation* (calling archons or empyreal spirits), and *Holy Enchantments* (*Smite* and consecrated blades).
* **Archaic Tech:** *Consecrated Relics and Blessed Weapons* and *Sanctified Holy Water*.
* **Modern / Advanced Tech:** *Syntropic Resonance Projectors* and *Aetherium-Cored Sanctification Arrays* that amplify divine harmonic frequencies.

### **21. Infernal Damage**

Channels the corrupting, entropic Dissonance of the cthonic/infernal planes—blending hellfire with spiritual blight that sears both body and soul. Particularly effective against celestial/empyreal beings and those bound by infernal pacts. **Infernal wounds resist normal healing** until cleansed via *Restore* or *Exorcism*, and critical hits can inflict spiritual taint or Stygian memory erosion.

* **Metaphysical:** *Infernal Evocation* (summoning fiends and cthonic entities), *Infernal Pacts & Curses*, and *Hellfire Enchantments*.
* **Archaic Tech:** *Cthonic Relics* and *Sacrificial Ritual Implements*.
* **Modern / Advanced Tech:** *Dissonance-Core Disruptors* and *Stygian Entropy Cannons* tapping into corrupted dimensional rifts.

### **22. Dimensional Damage**

Manipulates and shears the fabric of spacetime itself—tearing at a target's physical form across dimensional boundaries, phasing subsections of matter into adjacent planes, or banishing targets into the Astral/Void. Dimensional damage **ignores all physical Armor DR** and is devastating against phase-shifting or extradimensional entities.

* **Metaphysical:** *Dimensional Rift Creation*, *Dimensional Displacement* (*Dimension: Teleport* offensive telefrag/shearing), and *Reality Manipulation*.
* **Archaic Tech:** *Precursor Dimensional Artifacts* and *Planar Binding Circles*.
* **Modern Tech:** *Phase-Lock Disruptors* and *Experimental Spatial Displacers*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *Interdimensional Rift Cannons*, *Reality Anchors* (locking local spacetime to prevent teleportation while crushing phased entities), and *Pocket-Dimension Collapse Grenades*.

### **23. Psyche / Mental Damage**

Targets the mind, ego, and synaptic pathways directly rather than the physical body. **Psyche / Mental Damage completely bypasses physical Armor DR** (mitigated instead by **Willpower Saves**, *Mind Barrier*, and psychic shielding). Inflicts confusion, terror, synaptic pain, memory loss, or unconsciousness.

* **Metaphysical:** *Psychic Assault / Mental Blast* (*Mental: Projection*), *Emotional Manipulation* (projecting overwhelming terror, despair, or rage), and *Mental Intrusion / Psychic Vampirism*.
* **Archaic Tech:** *Psychoactive Ritual Incense* and *Cursed Neural Idols*.
* **Modern Tech:** *Infrasonic/Subliminal Stress Inducers* and *Neuro-Scramblers*.
* **Advanced Tech:** *Psychic Resonance Amplifiers (Psi-Crowns)*, *Direct Neural Disruptors*, and *Hard-Wired Mind Control Arrays*.

---

# **3.00.05 VEHICULAR COMBAT**

> **Module Scope:** Vehicular Action Economy, Relative Scale Modifiers, Land/Nautical/Aerial/Space Domains & d6/d10 System Failure Tables

## **DOCUMENT HEADER & MECHANICAL AUTHORITY BLOCK**

* **Mechanical Authority (`/game_rules` Wins):** Core Resolution `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`; Advantage/Disadvantage `+1d10` per stack (keep highest 2 / lowest 2); Critical Hit (`Natural 20` / double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19, 18, and lower`) = `Rolled Dice + 10` (e.g., `20 -> 30`, `19 -> 29`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + Critical Effect; Fumble (`Natural 2` / double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3, 4, and higher`) = `Rolled Dice becomes flat -10` + Situational Complication.
* **Character & Pool Axioms:** `150 CP` starting budget (`80 CP` Archetype Chassis + `70 CP` Customization); `60 SP` free Background skills (`20 SP` Faction + `20 SP` Origin + `20 SP` Occupation + `4 Recommended Features` + `4 Traits` at `0 CP`); Universal Straight Pricing (`+5 CP` per `+1` Attribute, `-5 CP` per `-1`, `1 CP` per `1` Skill Rank); Personal Hindrance Cap `+10 CP` (Species-level disadvantages and Stigmas exempt); `Base 30 Vitality` and `Base 30 Health` (`Base 60 Structure Points [SP]` for Synthetics/Constructs), scaled strictly at `+5 points per 1 CP` spent with **zero Stamina scaling**; Stamina Modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after highest single-domain **Armor DR** (**Armor Layering Cap**: biological, cybernetic, and wearable DR never stack).
* **EUFT & UDU Invariants:** Base 5-CR Valuation `Value (Credits) = 10 * 4^(CR / 5)`; Linear Micro-Modifiers (`+1 CR = x1.30`, `+2 CR = x1.75`, `+3 CR = x2.30`, `+4 CR = x3.00`, `-1 CR Flaw = x0.75`); Pristine Materials = `50%` of Credit Value, Scavenged Scrap = `10%` value (`5x Item Credit Value` in unrefined scrap mass); `10:1` UDU Hierarchy (`10 Nodes = 1 Socket`, `10 Sockets = 1 Mount`, `10 Mounts = 1 Module`); Mecha table SP is pre-calculated (apply Scale Multiplier only to weapon damage, movement speed, and weapon range; Garaging `1 Mount = 1 Scale Multiplier`).

## **PART I: ALIGNMENT & SUMMARY MATRIX**

## **PART II: COMPLETE UNABRIDGED PROFILES & RULES ENTRIES**

In the Tangent universe, vehicular combat is not a separate minigame; it is a direct scale escalation of the core **2d10 resolution engine**. Whether piloting a nimble hover-bike through a cyberpunk undercity, striding across a battlefield in a bipedal combat walker, or commanding a gargantuan void-cruiser in orbit, the tactical loop remains identical: **Action, Reaction, Consequence**.

---

## **I. OPERATIONAL FUNDAMENTALS**

### **1. The Tactical Round & Crew Action Economy**

Vehicular combat operates on the standard **6-second Combat Round**, with all crew members acting on the **Pilot's Initiative Count** while tracking their own personal Actions (governed by their individual Skill Stages):

* **Vehicular Initiative (Determined by the Pilot):**
  > **Pilot Initiative = 2d10 + Pilot's Agility Modifier + Alertness Skill Rank + Vehicle Handling Modifier**
  * *Handling Modifier:* An intrinsic statistic of the vehicle chassis (`2.00.Mecha.md` / `99.Technology.MechaMatrix.md`)—for example, an agile Interceptor Fighter has `+4`, while a ponderous Capital Ship has `-4`.
* **The Crew Turn (Multi-Operator Platforms):**
  * **Pilot:** Controls vehicle **Movement**, **Evasive Maneuvers (Defense)**, **Ramming**, and **Fixed Forward Weapons** (firing within a 45-degree forward arc).
  * **Gunner(s):** Control **Turrets** (360-degree arc), **Pintle-mounted weapons**, and **Missile batteries** (`2d10 + Agility/Intellect + Combat [Heavy Weapons / Heavy Energy] + Targeting Computer Bonus`). Gunners act on the Pilot's Initiative count using their own Action pool.
  * **Engineer / System Operator:** Manages **Shield distribution**, **Sensor Locks** (`Computers` / `Knowledge [Technology]`), **Electronic Warfare**, and emergency **Jury-Rig repairs** (`Vocation [Mechanic / Engineer]`).
  * **Commander:** Issues tactical orders (`Leadership` / Coordinated Assist) to grant `+2` to `+4` bonuses to Pilot, Gunner, or Engineer checks.

### **2. Scale & Relative Size Modifiers (`1.10 SCALING.md`)**

The most critical factor in vehicular warfare is **Scale**. A holdout pistol cannot scratch a main battle tank, and a dreadnought's spinal battery cannot easily track a lone infantryman:

* **David vs. Goliath (Small Attacker vs. Large Vehicle):** Small targets firing at Large vehicles gain a positive **Relative Combat Modifier to Hit** (e.g., `+4` against a Huge `x5` Mecha), but personal-scale weapons must still overcome the vehicle's heavy **Damage Resistance (DR)**.
* **Goliath vs. David (Large Vehicle vs. Small Target):** Large vehicle weapons suffer the negative **Relative Combat Modifier to Hit** nimble personal targets (Tracking Penalty, unless using Area-of-Effect blast ordnance or point-defense arrays), while inflicting **Scaled Damage** (`Base Weapon Dice * Active Scale Multiplier`).
* **Mecha Scale Multiplier Rule (No Double-Dipping SP):** Structure Points (`SP`) listed in vehicle and mecha size tables (`Medium 50 SP`, `Large 100 SP`, `Huge 250 SP`, `Gargantuan 500 SP`, `Colossal 1,000 SP`) are **already pre-calculated** for their scale. Never multiply table SP by the Scale Multiplier a second time; apply the active **Scale Multiplier** strictly to **weapon damage dice, movement speed, and weapon range** during play.

---

## **II. DOMAINS OF WAR**

### **1. Land (Terrestrial & Walker)**

Combat defined by **Terrain**, **Elevation**, and **Cover**:

* **Cover & Hull-Down Positioning:** Vehicles use buildings, ridges, and wreckage for Cover (`+4` to `+10` Defense bonus). A **Hull-Down** position (only the turret exposed above a ridge) grants **+4 Defense**.
* **Ramming:** A high-impact collision maneuver:
  * *Attack:* The Pilot rolls an opposed **Piloting Check vs. Target Defense / Reflex**.
  * *Damage:* Inflicts **`1d10` Blunt/Concussive damage per 10 feet of current Speed** (multiplied by the ramming vehicle's Scale Multiplier). **Both vehicles take this damage**, though the heavier/larger vehicle takes **half (`1/2`) damage**.
* **Walker Mechanics:** Bipedal and quadrupedal mecha can execute **Melee Stomp** and **Grapple** attacks against infantry or rival walkers (`Piloting` or `Unarmed/Melee` skill) and step over vertical obstacles that block wheeled or tracked vehicles.

### **2. Nautical (Surface & Submerged)**

Combat defined by **Depth** and **Acoustic Detection**:

* **Sonar & Sensors:** Underwater visual range is near zero. Combat relies on **System Ops (`Computers` / `Knowledge [Technology]`)** sensor checks against target `Stealth` to acquire a **Target Lock**. Without an active Lock, all attacks beyond Point Blank are rolled at **Disadvantage**.
* **Depth Bands:**
  * *Surface:* Standard atmospheric and aquatic operation.
  * *Periscope / Shallow Depth:* Grants concealment against surface and aerial observers.
  * *Deep / Abyssal:* Extreme hydrostatic pressure; hull breaches at Deep depth are catastrophic, flooding compartments for `1d6` Crushing/Drowning damage per round until bulkheads are sealed.

### **3. Atmospheric (Aerial Dogfighting)**

Combat defined by **Altitude**, **Airspeed**, and **Energy Management**:

* **The Dogfight (Pilot vs. Pilot):** When two aircraft or aerospace fighters engage at close range, they enter a **Dogfight**:
  * *Mechanic:* Opposed **Piloting Checks (`2d10 + AGI + Piloting + Handling`)** at the start of the round.
  * *Winner:* Gains **Advantage** on all attack rolls against the loser this turn and dictates relative positioning (securing **Tail / Flank** position).
  * *Loser:* Counts as **Flat-Footed** (losing Agility/Active Defense) against the Winner until they break the lock.
* **Stalling:** Non-VTOL/non-grav aircraft flying slower than their minimum **Stall Speed** must pass a **Piloting Check (`CR 20`)** or stall and begin falling in an uncontrolled dive.

### **4. Interstellar (Space & Vector Combat)**

Combat defined by **Newtonian Vectors**, **Thermal Signatures**, and **3D Distance**:

* **Newtonian Drift ("Running Silent"):** In zero-G vacuum, a vessel continues coasting along its last momentum vector without expending fuel. A Pilot can cut main thrusters to drift silently (**Stealth** / "Running Cold") while rotating the hull on reaction thrusters to fire along any vector, imposing **Disadvantage** on enemy sensor lock checks.
* **Heat Signatures:** Firing high-energy weapons, charging jump drives, or lighting main fusion thrusters flares the vessel's thermal signature:
  * *Mechanic:* **Passive Sensors** detect flared ships automatically within line of sight. **Active Sensors (Ping)** are required to lock onto "Cold" drifting ships (whichsimultaneously reveals the pinging ship's location).
* **Starship Proximity Damage (`x40` Enormous Scale & Above):** Capital-ship weaponry is so overwhelmingly powerful that near-misses and point-impact shockwaves deal **1/10th splash/concussive damage** to fighter- or personal-scale targets within a blast radius equal to half the weapon's scale multiplier in feet.

---

## **III. COMBAT INTERACTIONS**

### **1. Pilot vs. Pilot (Vehicle vs. Vehicle)**

The duel of machines:

* **Evasive Maneuvers (Standard Action):** The Pilot trades their offensive Attack action to weave aggressively, imposing **Disadvantage** on all incoming attacks against the vehicle until the Pilot's next turn.
* **Jinking (Reaction):** A Reaction to being fired upon. The Pilot spends 1 Reaction to roll `2d10 + AGI + Piloting + Handling` against the incoming Attack Roll. Success negates the hit, but reduces the vehicle's available movement speed by **50%** on its next turn.
* **Fixed vs. Turret Mounts:**
  * *Fixed Weapons:* Fire in a **45-degree forward arc**; require the Pilot to orient the entire vehicle toward the target.
  * *Turrets:* Fire across a **360-degree arc**; operated by Gunners independently of the vehicle's facing and movement vector.

### **2. Gunner vs. Mecha (Infantry vs. Vehicle)**

The asymmetry of scale:

* **The Armor Threshold:** Vehicles possess heavy **Damage Resistance (DR)**. Small arms (pistols, standard rifles) often cannot penetrate:
  * *Rule:* If an attack's raw damage does not exceed the vehicle's **Armor DR**, the shot ricochets harmlessly (**No effect / Glancing Blow**).
* **Called Shots (Targeting Weak Points — `-5` Strike):** Infantry can bypass heavy hull plating by targeting optical sensors, exposed tracks, knee actuators, or exhaust vents:
  * *Mechanic:* Attack at a **`-5` Strike penalty**. On a hit, **ignore 50% of the vehicle's Armor DR** OR force a targeted subsystem check (e.g., immobilizing a track or blinding a sensor pod).
* **Boarding (Infantry Hull Assault):** A daring operator can clamber onto a slow-moving or stationary vehicle:
  * *Mechanic:* Roll an **Athletics Check vs. Vehicle Speed / Defense CR**. Success places the operator directly *on* the hull—bypassing relative Scale tracking penalties on subsequent attacks and allowing direct placement of breaching/demolition charges against hatches or vents.

### **3. Gunner vs. Structure (Siege Warfare)**

Demolition and fortification breaching:

* **Static Defense (`CR 5`):** Stationary buildings and fortifications have **0 Agility** and an effective **Static Defense of `CR 5`**, making them automatic hits under normal combat conditions.
* **Hardness (DR) & Architectural Modules:** Buildings are constructed in structural **Modules** (e.g., a 10 ft x 10 ft reinforced wall section; `2.00.Architecture.md`).
* **Siege Damage (`2x` Damage):** Heavy Weapons (Explosive, Demolitions, Heavy Energy, and Siege ordnance) deal **Double (`2x`) Damage** against stationary structures.
* **Breaching & Collapse:**
  * **0 SP (Breach):** Reducing an architectural Module to **`0 SP`** blasts open a **Breach** (hole) large enough for infantry or small walkers to pass through.
  * **-50% Max SP (Structural Collapse):** Reducing a Module to **`-50%` of its Maximum SP** triggers a **Collapse** of that section and any unsupported overhead floors.

---

## **IV. DAMAGE, SYSTEM FAILURE & CATASTROPHE**

Vehicles do not simply fall unconscious; they degrade, lose subsystems, burn, and detonate.

### **1. Damage Thresholds**

* **Glancing Blow (`Damage <= DR`):** Incoming damage does not exceed the vehicle's Armor DR. The shot bounces off (**0 SP lost**).
* **Penetrating Hit (`Damage > DR`):** Incoming damage exceeds Armor DR. Subtract DR from the damage and deduct the remainder from the vehicle's **Structure Points (SP)**.
* **Critical Hit (`Natural 20` or `Attack >= Defense + 10`) / `50% SP` Threshold:** Whenever a vehicle suffers a **Critical Hit** (or beat Defense by 10+) OR when its Structure Points drop to **50% of Maximum SP**, roll on the **System Failure Table** below (`1d6` Fast Play Table or `1d10` Expanded Tactical Table).

### **2. Vehicular System Failure Tables (`1d6` Fast & `1d10` Tactical)**

#### **A. Fast Play System Failure Table (`1d6`)**

1. **Motive System:** Maximum Speed is reduced by **50%** (treads thrown, wing clipped, leg actuator sheared).
2. **Weapon System:** One random weapon mount is **Disabled / Jammed** until repaired.
3. **Sensor / Comms:** Optics and radar blinded or silenced; **Disadvantage** on all targeting rolls beyond Point Blank.
4. **Crew Compartment:** Penetrating trauma! Pilot/Crew inside take **half (`1/2`) of the net damage** dealt to the vehicle.
5. **Power Plant:** Vehicle vents smoke and plasma fire, suffering **`1d6` Pyro/Burn damage per turn** (ignoring DR).
6. **Catastrophic Leak:** Fuel cell or reactor core goes critical! The vehicle **explodes in `1d4` rounds** unless an Engineer passes an emergency **Vocation (Mechanic/Engineer) or Knowledge (Technology) Check (`CR 20`)**.

#### **B. Expanded Tactical Subsystem Failure Table (`1d10`)**

| `1d10` Roll | Struck Subsystem | Mechanical Consequence *(Field Repair: Vocation [Mechanic/Engineer] `CR 20`)* |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Reactor / Power Core** | Power fluctuation! Vehicle is **Dazed** (1 Action only) for 1 round; a second Reactor hit triggers a **Core Meltdown in `1d4` rounds**. |
| **2 – 3** | **Propulsion / Thrusters** | Motive systems damaged: **Maximum Speed is halved (`1/2`)** and **Handling suffers `-2`**. |
| **4 – 5** | **Armor / Hull Breach** | Structural plating sheared: **Armor DR is permanently reduced by `-5`** (and cabin decompresses in vacuum or floods at depth). |
| **6 – 7** | **Primary Weapon Mount** | One random weapon hardpoint is **Disabled** until repaired. |
| **8** | **Sensors & Comms Array** | Electronics blinded: All ranged attacks beyond Short Range suffer **Disadvantage** (`-5` Alertness/Sensors). |
| **9** | **Shield / Gyro Stabilizer** | Energy shields collapse to **`0 AP`** (or unshielded vehicle suffers `-4` Handling and must pass a **CR 15 Piloting check** or spin out). |
| **10** | **Cockpit / Crew Compartment** | Penetrating trauma! **Half (`1/2`) of the net damage** bypasses the hull and strikes the Pilot/Crew directly. |

### **3. Destruction & Catastrophic Explosion**

* **0 SP (Disabled):** The vehicle grinds to a halt and all primary systems go offline. The chassis remains intact and can be repaired during downtime.
* **Negative SP `> 50%` of Max SP (Destroyed):** When negative SP exceeds half of the vehicle's maximum SP (i.e., `-50% Max SP`), the chassis is reduced to a total wreck (**Scrap value `10%` only**).
* **Catastrophic Explosion:** If a vehicle is reduced to Destroyed status (`-50% Max SP`) by **Pyro/Fire, Energy, or Explosive/Concussive** damage (or a Reactor Meltdown), its power plant and munitions detonate:
  * **Blast Radius:** **`10 feet` per Size Category** above Miniscule.
  * **Explosion Damage:** **`1d6` Concussive/Pyro damage per `10 SP` of the vehicle's Maximum Structure** (Reflex Save `CR 15` for half damage; splits 50/50 between Vitality and Health).

# **4.00 METAPHYSICS**

> **Module Scope:** Metafocus Levels (ML 0–6), Awakening, Attune vs. CR Casting Engine, Essence Pools, Composite Casting & Toll

## **DOCUMENT HEADER & MECHANICAL AUTHORITY BLOCK**

* **Mechanical Authority (`/game_rules` Wins):** Core Resolution `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`; Advantage/Disadvantage `+1d10` per stack (keep highest 2 / lowest 2); Critical Hit (`Natural 20` / double-10s on `2d10`, or expanded threat range `19, 18, and lower`) = `Rolled Dice + 10` (e.g., `20 -> 30`, `19 -> 29`) + `2x Base Weapon Damage Dice` + Critical Effect; Fumble (`Natural 2` / double-1s on `2d10`, or expanded fumble range `3, 4, and higher`) = `Rolled Dice becomes flat -10` + Situational Complication.
* **Character & Pool Axioms:** `150 CP` starting budget (`80 CP` Archetype Chassis + `70 CP` Customization); `60 SP` free Background skills (`20 SP` Faction + `20 SP` Origin + `20 SP` Occupation + `4 Recommended Features` + `4 Traits` at `0 CP`); Universal Straight Pricing (`+5 CP` per `+1` Attribute, `-5 CP` per `-1`, `1 CP` per `1` Skill Rank); Personal Hindrance Cap `+10 CP` (Species-level disadvantages and Stigmas exempt); `Base 30 Vitality` and `Base 30 Health` (`Base 60 Structure Points [SP]` for Synthetics/Constructs), scaled strictly at `+5 points per 1 CP` spent with **zero Stamina scaling**; Stamina Modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after highest single-domain **Armor DR** (**Armor Layering Cap**: biological, cybernetic, and wearable DR never stack).
* **EUFT & UDU Invariants:** Base 5-CR Valuation `Value (Credits) = 10 * 4^(CR / 5)`; Linear Micro-Modifiers (`+1 CR = x1.30`, `+2 CR = x1.75`, `+3 CR = x2.30`, `+4 CR = x3.00`, `-1 CR Flaw = x0.75`); Pristine Materials = `50%` of Credit Value, Scavenged Scrap = `10%` value (`5x Item Credit Value` in unrefined scrap mass); `10:1` UDU Hierarchy (`10 Nodes = 1 Socket`, `10 Sockets = 1 Mount`, `10 Mounts = 1 Module`); Mecha table SP is pre-calculated (apply Scale Multiplier only to weapon damage, movement speed, and weapon range; Garaging `1 Mount = 1 Scale Multiplier`).

## **PART I: ALIGNMENT & SUMMARY MATRIX**

| Section ID | Module / Sub-System Name | Mechanical Authority & Rule Governance | Restoration Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |

| **Section 12** | **Metafoci Components** | Canonical `/game_rules` 2d10 vs. CR & EUFT Verified | `100% Restored` |

---

## **PART II: COMPLETE UNABRIDGED PROFILES & RULES ENTRIES**

## **The Omni-Codex of Metaphysic Invocations and Reality Manipulation**

The manipulation of reality within the Tangent framework is not merely the recitation of arcane words, but the deliberate restructuring of universal constants through the application of will. This system operates on a distinct triad of mechanics—Attune, Discipline, and Invocation—which collectively allow for the harnessing of powers that defy standard physics. Unlike "Vancian" magic systems where spells are distinct, immutable memory packets that vanish upon use, the Metaphysic system implies a fluid, skill-based manipulation of energy sources, whether they be the Void, the Weave, or the Quantum Field.

  

### **Metafocus Level (ML)**

Comparable to the Technological Level of a society, the Metafocus Level determines the prominence of Metaphysics within a civilization or demographic. Double the ML to determine a starting character’s maximum level in Metafocus Discipline Skills. (Note: The *Attune* skill is not limited by ML).

|  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| **ML** | **CLASSIFICATION** | **DESCRIPTION** | **EXAMPLES** |
| **0** | Null  | No native Meta users. | None |
| **1** | Rare  | Negligible ratio of Meta Users; likely to be harshly judged or highly expected of. | Skeptical / Most races |
| **2** | Selective  | More ‘in tune’ people but in minorities or reclusive. Early stage of Enlightenment.  | Special Ops, Cults |
| **3** | Cultured  | Uncommon but accepted Meta Usage (Adepts of various types). Awakened as a recommended feature of the species. | Aulurans, Dynasty, Impyrium |
| **4** | Standardized  | Common Meta Usage; used by many and evident in society. Awakened as a granted feature of the species. | Alterians, Impyrium Regi, Psion |
| **5** | Advanced  | Very Common Meta Usage; prominent usage by everyone. | Mondi, Shar Knor |
| ***6*** | *Deific*  | *Transcended; casually affecting reality. NOT AVAILABLE TO PCs.* | *Progenitor types* |

  


### **Core Mechanics & Awakening**

Metafocus Disciplines represent the knowledge and ability to consciously alter reality. This covers all metaphysical powers including Studied Arcanists, Transcendental Psychics, Devout Priests, Akashic Channelers, and Latent Abilities.

  

## **Awakening & Disciplines:**

  - Acquisition: Characters must attain Disciplines through Awakening. Skill points must be allotted to Attune and each Discipline’s 2 Metafocus Skills.
  - Expansion: Additional purchases of Awakening are required to attain other Disciplines (gaining access to the 2 skills from each). Note: *Attune* is learned with the initial Awakening and applies to all.
  - Schools of Thought: Many Schools teaching various disciplines will be limited in teaching others of a like school (e.g., Magic & Magic, Psychic & Psychic). Studying from a different School of Thought may be possible but will be more complicated depending on the severity of the difference (see *Basics - Skills, Learning*).

  

## **Skills Breakdown:**

  - Attune Skill: A general multi-purpose skill for drawing and channeling energy. Required for all Disciplines. Attune Abilities listed under each Discipline require no check to use.
  - Metafocus Skills: The specific skills of manipulating patterns (determines efficiency).
      
      - Minor Abilities: Cantrips/tricks listed for each skill require no roll to use; benefits are based on the skill stage.
      - Sensing: Used to sense controlled forces at work and identify effects/sources.
      - Learning: Skill checked to learn Invocations and other similar effects.

  

## **Source Attribute**

The Key Ability is chosen at Awakening and determines the "flavor" of the source.

  - Intellect Based (Reason and Logic): Psychic, Arcane, Akashic.
  - Wisdom Based (Willpower and Intuition): Divine, Nature, Cosmic.
  - Charisma Based (Confidence and Dominance): Bardic, Hereditary, Granted.

  

---
## **The Mechanics of Casting**

### **The Calculation**

The potency of an effect is calculated as follows:

[Key Ability + Discipline Skill Level + Invocation Level + 10 (or 2d10)]

  - Attune Check: Used to determine the Difficulty of the Resistance of an Effect or the Evasion of an Attack.
  - Discipline Check: Used to determine the severity of Effects and/or Damage.

  

### **Free-Casting vs. Invocations**

1.  **## **Free-Casting (Spontaneous):**  
      - Involves a narrative of the effect within the confines of the Discipline’s level.
      - Process: Make an Attune check to draw/channel energy (sets CR/Attack), followed by a Discipline Skill check for severity.
      - Risks: High volatility.
2.  **## **Invocations (Codified):**  
      - Represents rote muscle memory.
      - Bonus: Invocation Levels are added to the Discipline Skill checks they are based on. (Invocations are considered Discipline Specializations).
      - Operational Safety: The user effectively "Takes 10" by default on the Discipline check (Calculation: Key + Skill + Invocation + 10). A roll may still be attempted if a better result is desired.

  

### **Metaphysic Checks & Difficulty**

Base CR for activating a Metafocus Discipline or Invocation:

  - Very Easy (CR 5): Safe Quiet Area, Sanctum, Laboratory, Library.
  - Easy (CR 10): Casual, Non-Hostile Environment, Walking, Passenger in Vehicle.
  - Average (CR 15): Very Active or Hostile Environment, Vigorous Movement, Combat.
  - Difficult (CR 20): Extreme Activity, Crashing, Uncontrolled Fall.

  

### **Criticals & Failure**

  - Critical Success: Adds +10 in addition to the rolled dice value (e.g., 20 -> 30, 19 -> 29) and produces a dramatic improvement of the effect.
  - Critical Mistake (Fumble): Replaces the rolled dice value with a flat -10 (subtracting 10 from the caster's base check score) and triggers a disastrous backfire (GM's call).
  - Energy Surge (Attune <= 0): An Attune check resulting in 0 or less becomes an uncontrolled energy surge (wrong target, area effect, unintended consequence).
  - Fizzle/Transposition (Discipline <= 0): A Discipline check resulting in 0 or less causes a different effect than desired: from a dramatic fizzle to transposed energy.
  - Internalized Strain (Failure): Failing a check deals 1 point of Non-Lethal Damage per 5 points of failure. This is painful strain from Channeling and cannot be absorbed by Stamina or Armor.
  - Fumble: Requires a check to see if the caster suffers the effect themselves (Check based on type of Effect).

  

### **Metafoci Components**

Ranges & Modifiers

|  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| Range | Distance | Check Modifier |
| Melee / Point Blank | 5 ft (Small/Med) | +5 to Check |
| Close | Up to 100 ft | None |
| Medium | Up to 500 ft | -5 to Check |
| Long | Up to 2,500 ft | -10 to Check |
| Extended | Miles+ | -15 to Check |
| Note for Extended: | Target or location must be accurately detected or known well. |   |

  

### **Targeting & Area Effects**

  - Multiple Targets: -5 to Attune check per extra target with full effect for each. Otherwise, damage/effects are divided amongst subjects.
  - Area Effects:
      
      - Blast (10 ft radius sphere): -5 to Focus Skill check.
      - Line (5 ft wide x 60 ft long): -10 to Focus Skill check.
      - Cone (90 ft long x 45 ft wide): -15 to Focus Skill check.

  

### **Damage Calculation**

1d6 per Stage achieved with the check (after all modifiers). *(Note: Some specific Disciplines, like Force, may utilize d8s as a specific exception, but d6 is the standard).*

Meta Combat

  - Attack Roll: Attune is used for the Attack Roll. Target defense is treated as similar attacks.
  - Counter Effect: A defender may attempt to nullify an incoming effect.
      
      - Step 1: Attune is used by Attacker and Defender.
      - Step 2: If the Defender has a higher success, they may make an Opposed Metafocus Skill check.
      - Resolution: If Attacker succeeds the opposed check, the Effect is normal. If Defender wins, the Effect is countered and nullified.
  - Resolution: Damage, Range, and other factors are determined by the level of the Metafocus Skill.

  
  

---
## **Composite Invocations: The Synthesis of Disciplines**

Composite Invocations require ranks in multiple Disciplines. 

Rule: Invocation Level is added to the *lowest* of the requisite Discipline Skills used.

  - Magitech & Cybermancy (Mental + Energy): Machine Spirit (Interface), Construct Intellect (AI).
  - Biostasis & Time Warping (Entropy + Dimension): Temporal Stasis (Freeze time), Accelerated Decay (Rapid aging).
  - Elemental Constructs (Matter + Energy): Living Spell (Minion), Plasma Forging (Energy weapons).
  - Spatial Illusions (Illusion + Dimension): Labyrinth (Infinite maze), Shadow Step Assault (Teleport attacks).
  - Biomancy (Matter + Entropy): Life Transfer (Drain/Heal), Flesh Crafting (Reshaping).

  

---
## **The Essence Pool Calculation**

Your character’s total Essence capacity represents their comprehensive "lodestar"—the intersection of biological/synthetic substrate, channeling precision, and breadth of metaphysical study.

**Essence Pool = (Sum of all 6 Ability Scores) + (Attune Skill Rank) + (Total Ranks in all known Discipline Skills).**

  

  - **Ability Substrate:** Since the average human ability score is zero, the pool begins with the character's natural or engineered aptitudes. Physical attributes (Strength, Agility, Stamina) contribute to the "containment" of energy, while Mental attributes (Intellect, Wisdom, Charisma) determine the "flavor" and depth of the source. Permanent modifications, such as improved with experience, augmentations or a permanent injury, will affect the Essence score but temporary adjustments do not affect it unless specifically stated.

  

  - **The Conduit (Attune):** Adding the **Attune** rank ensures that as a character becomes more precise in opening conduits to their power source, their capacity to hold that energy expands. Again only permanent modifications to Attune will adjust the Essence score.

  

  - **The Breadth (Disciplines):** Total ranks from skills in all known Disciplines (e.g., Energy, Matter, Entropy) represent the character's cumulative understanding of reality's "Code". Ranks from the discipline skills are specifically counted - ranks in Invocations are not counted towards the Essence total, only the ranks from the skills listed under each discipline are used (such as for the Energy Discipline we will use the ranks from Elemental and Force but not from the Fireball or Teleknesis Invocations).

  

### **The Essence Cost Scale**

In this framework, the metabolic or spiritual cost of an invocation is determined by the **Base CR** required to activate the effect based on the current environment and stress levels.

|  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| **Difficulty** | **Base CR** | **Essence**  | **Environmental Context** |
| **Very Easy** | CR 5 | **0**  | Safe areas, Sanctums, Libraries, Laboratories. |
| **Easy** | CR 10 | **0**  | Casual travel, walking, non-hostile environments. |
| **Average** | CR 15 | **1**  | Combat, vigorous movement, active hostility. |
| **Difficult** | CR 20 | **2**  | Extreme activity, uncontrolled falls, crashing. |
| **Very Difficult** | CR 25 | **3**  | High-intensity chaos, environmental catastrophes. |
| **Nearly Impossible** | CR 30 | **4**  | Legendary feats, global reality shifts. |
| **Miraculous** | CR 35 | **5**  | Progenitor-tier interactions (rarely for PCs). |

  

## **Strategic Implications for Invocations**

This cost structure fundamentally changes the economy of **Codified Invocations** and **Free-Casting**:

  

### **1. Operational Safety (Codified Invocations)**

Codified Invocations represent rote muscle memory where a user can effectively **"Take 10"** on their Discipline check.

  - **The "Sanctum" Bonus:** If an Arcanist performs a learned ritual in a laboratory (CR 5), they pay **0 Essence**, as their familiarity and the stable environment minimize the toll on their internal reservoir.
  - **The Combat Tax:** Using the same invocation in a firefight (CR 15) imposes an immediate **1 Essence** cost to stabilize the conduit amidst the chaos.

  

### **2. Free-Casting and Volatility**

**Free-Casting** (spontaneous metaphysics) remains high-risk.

  - If a player attempts a spontaneous effect in a **Difficult** environment (CR 20), they must spend **2 Essence** upfront.
  - **Failure and Feedback:** If the check fails, the Essence is still consumed, and the character suffers **Internalized Strain** (1d6 points of Non-Lethal damage per 5 points of failure).
  - **Energy Surges:** If an **Attune** result is 0 or less, the Essence cost for that increment is doubled as the reservoir "leaks" into the environment during the surge.

  

### **3. Scaling for Higher Tiers**

As characters develop their training and skills, their Essence Pool grows, allowing them to absorb the higher costs of Master and Pinnacle tier effects.

  - **Extreme Range/Area:** Large area effects (Cones/Lines) or Extended ranges often push the CR into the 25–30+ range. A character must have a substantial pool to manifest these legendary feats frequently.

  

### **Essence Recovery and The Toll**

  - **Light Rest:** Allows for the recovery of Essence equal to the character's **Key Ability Modifier** (minimum 1) per hour.
  - **Full Rest (6-8 Hours):** Fully restores the Essence Pool as the body and mind realign with the universal constant.
  - **The Burn:** If a character's Essence Pool is empty, they may "burn" their own life force to power an invocation. Each point of Essence needed deals **2 points of direct Health damage** (not absorbed by armor or Stamina), representing the physical destruction of the body as it acts as an unshielded conduit.

  
  
  

---
---

# **METAPHYSICS INVOCATION DIRECTORY INDEX**

Complete invocation catalogs for all six Metaphysic Disciplines (and their twelve Foci) are organized in the `./metaphysics/` directory:

* **[Entropy Invocations](./metaphysics/4.00.Entropy.md)** — *Chaos Invocations (Cull through Chaotic Blast) and Order Invocations (Vital Sight through Exorcism)*

## **PART II: COMPLETE UNABRIDGED PROFILES & RULES ENTRIES**

### **VISUAL AND SENSORY GUIDELINES FOR METAPHYSICS**

In the Tangent Universe, the "Meta" is not a single uniform force. It is shaped by the mind and culture of the wielder. A *Thermal Lance* cast by a Mekan logic-priest looks fundamentally different from one cast by a Draconian Sorcerer.

This guide expands on the sensory signatures—Visuals, Audio, and Texture—of the various Meta manifestations.

  

## **I. PSYCHIC MANIFESTATIONS (The Mind)**

*Root Discipline: Mental, Dimension, Energy (Force)*

Psychic power is the imposition of Will upon Reality. It often bypasses the "laws" of physics by simply rewriting local probability.

  

### **A. CONTROLLED (Logic / Telekinetic)**

**Archetypes:** The Mekan, The Analyst, The Tactician.

  - **Concept:** The mind as a computer or architect. Energy is efficient, wasted on nothing.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Defined Geometrics:** Effects manifest as perfect shapes—hexagons, fractals, or grids.
      - **Hard Light:** Shields and projectiles look like solid glass or laser-cut crystal. No smoke, no trail.
      - **Manifestation:** A telekinetic shield appears as a honeycomb wall of force; a mental blast is a perfect spear of light.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Electric Cyan:** The color of raw data.
      - **Circuitry Black:** Negative space that looks like printed lines.
      - **Neon Orange:** Warning/Combat mode indicators.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* High-pitched electronic whines, server hums, the sound of glass snapping.
      - *Texture:* Smooth, frictionless, cold static.

  

### **B. FOCUSED (Discipline / Telepathic)**

**Archetypes:** The Impyrium Centurion, The Monk, The Judge.

  - **Concept:** The mind as a lens. Power is gathered and projected in a singular, overwhelming vector.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Lines & Beams:** Energy moves in straight, unwavering lines.
      - **Solid Color:** No gradients. The energy is dense and opaque (e.g., a sword of pure white energy).
      - **Manifestation:** A "Command" spell manifests as a heavy, crushing weight on the air itself; a "Scan" looks like a flat plane of light passing over an object.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Solar White:** Blindingly bright and pure.
      - **Royal Purple:** Deep, regal, associated with high-level gravity manipulation.
      - **Gold:** Used for "Aura" effects and defensive wards.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* A deep, resonating thrum (like a massive bell), absolute silence.
      - *Texture:* Heavy, oppressive, warm (like sunlight).

  

### **C. WILD (Empathic / Raw)**

**Archetypes:** The Wild Talent, The Mondi, The Feral Psychic.

  - **Concept:** The mind as a storm. Power leaks, bleeds, and reacts to emotion rather than calculation.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Smoky Transitions:** Reality looks like watercolor paint bleeding into water. Edges blur.
      - **Melting Colors:** Colors shift rapidly based on the user's emotion (Red=Anger, Blue=Calm).
      - **Distortion:** Heat hazes, oil-slick rainbows, air warping around the user.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Bruised Violet:** The color of raw psychic force.
      - **Magenta:** Intense emotional output.
      - **Pearlescent:** Shifting, undefined colors.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* Whispering voices, static white noise, a heartbeat sound.
      - *Texture:* Viscous, humid, "pins and needles" sensation.

  
  

## **II. MAGIC MANIFESTATIONS (The Weave)**

*Root Discipline: Energy (Elemental), Matter, Illusion*

Magic is the hacking of the universe's source code using ancient formulas, rituals, or tools.

  

### **A. ARCANE (High Magic / Tech-Magic)**

**Archetypes:** The Alterian Arcanist, The Scholar, The Artificer.

  - **Concept:** Magic as Science. It is complex, formulaic, and elegant.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Runes & Sigils:** Glowing equations float in the air around the caster.
      - **Filigree:** Spells manifest as intricate silver or gold wireframes before filling with energy.
      - **Constellations:** Points of light connecting to form the spell structure.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Platinum Silver:** The standard for neutral arcane energy.
      - **Sapphire Blue:** Used for information and transport magic.
      - **Starlight:** Cold, distant white points.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* Crystalline chimes, the sound of turning pages, resonant harmonics.
      - *Texture:* Sharp, metallic, ozone smell (like a lightning strike).

  

### **B. NATURE (Primal / Verdant)**

**Archetypes:** The Thorn, The Auluran Shaman, The Druid.

  - **Concept:** Magic as Life. It grows, consumes, and cycles.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Motes & Spores:** The air fills with glowing dust or pollen.
      - **Haze:** Bioluminescent mists that obscure the caster.
      - **Rapid Growth:** Spectral vines or roots visible within the energy.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Toxic Green:** For acids and poisons.
      - **Amber:** For preservation and shielding.
      - **Sickly Yellow:** For decay and entropy.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* Rustling leaves, snapping branches, the chittering of insects.
      - *Texture:* Humid, sticky, organic, smell of loam and rain.

  

### **C. VOID (Entropic / Eldritch)**

**Archetypes:** The Sha'Nor, The Necromancer, The Warlock.

  - **Concept:** Magic as Absence. It deletes reality.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Negative Space:** Effects look like "holes" in the world where light cannot exist.
      - **Cracks:** Reality fractures like broken glass around the effect.
      - **Shadow Smoke:** Inky, fluid darkness that moves against the wind.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Vantablack:** Absolute absence of light.
      - **Cold Grey:** The color of ash.
      - **Invisible Distortion:** Only visible by how it bends light behind it.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* The sound of ice cracking, a vacuum sucking in air, unnerving silence.
      - *Texture:* Freezing cold, numbing, "wrongness."

  
  

## **III. DIVINE MANIFESTATIONS (The Will)**

*Root Discipline: Entropy (Order/Chaos), Energy (Radiant)*

Divine power is not about figuring out the universe (Arcane) or bending it (Psychic); it is about *commanding* it through conviction.

  

### **A. CELESTIAL (The Light / Order)**

**Archetypes:** The Ascendancy Judge, The Paladin, The Healer.

  - **Concept:** Authority. The power is undeniable and overwhelming.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Ethereal Rays:** Pillars of light descending from above.
      - **Halos:** Rings of energy forming behind the head or around the hands.
      - **Weightlessness:** Objects and debris float gently around the user.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Burnished Gold:** Warm, metallic, heavy.
      - **Blinding White:** Too bright to look at directly.
      - **Sky Blue:** Peaceful, restorative energy.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* Choir-like harmonics, a single clear trumpet note, thunder.
      - *Texture:* Warm, solid, comforting.

  

### **B. INFERNAL (The Flame / Chaos)**

**Archetypes:** The Cultist, The Destroyer, The Anarchist.

  - **Concept:** Corruption. The power burns and taints what it touches.
  - **Visuals:**
      
      - **Shadow Flame:** Fire that produces darkness instead of light.
      - **Jagged Arcs:** Lightning that moves in erratic, aggressive patterns.
      - **Corrosion:** Surfaces touched by the energy instantly rust or rot.
  - **Palette:**
      
      - **Blood Red:** Deep, visceral crimson.
      - **Sulfur Yellow:** Sickly and bright.
      - **Charcoal:** Burnt edges and ash.
  - **Sensory:**
      
      - *Audio:* Screaming metal, roaring fire, discordant screeching.
      - *Texture:* Burning heat, gritty ash, nauseating.

  
  

## **IV. DISCIPLINE-SPECIFIC COLORATIONS**

*Quick reference for standard energy signatures.*

|  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| **DISCIPLINE** | **PRIMARY COLOR** | **SECONDARY COLOR** | **TEXTURE/FORM** |
| **Dimension** | Deep Indigo | Void Black | Warping, folding, portals, rifts. |
| **Energy (Fire)** | Orange/Red | White Hot | Flickering, consuming, plasma-like. |
| **Energy (Force)** | Transparent | Pale Blue | Distortion waves, solid impact walls. |
| **Energy (Elec)** | Blue/White | Violet | Jagged arcs, stroboscopic flashes. |
| **Energy (Cold)** | Glacial Blue | Frost White | Crystalline growth, mist, brittle snapping. |
| **Energy (Sonic)** | Transparent | Silver Ripples | Distortion waves, vibration blur, shattering glass. |
| **Energy (Corrosive)** | Sickly Yellow | Smoking Grey | Bubbling liquid, dissolving matter, toxic fumes. |
| **Entropy (Chaos)** | Sickly Green | Grey/Black | Rusting, decaying, mist, smoke. |
| **Entropy (Order)** | Geometric Gold | Crystal White | Perfect lattices, interlocking shields. |
| **Entropy (Healing)** | Vibrant Life Green | Soft Gold | Rapid cell growth, knitting flesh, warm pulse. |
| **Illusion** | Shimmering | Oil-Slick | Mirrored surfaces, haze, glitches. |
| **Matter** | Earth Tones | Metallic Sheen | Solidification, density, transmutation. |
| **Mental** | Pink/Magenta | Cyan | Ripples, pulses, glowing eyes. |
