### **1. THE ENTITY (Existential / Non-Corporeal Template)**

- **Description:** The designation of "Entity" refers not to a conventional biological species, but to a fundamental template for a consciousness whose existence transcends the material plane—including **Extra-Planar Beings**, **Detached Consciousnesses**, **Fragments of Forgotten Egregores**, and **Ideological or Geographic Embodiments** (*Genius Loci*).
- **Classification:** Entity (`24 CP` Base Chassis) | **Size:** Variable | **Movement:** Flight or Flicker | **Tech / Meta Level:** TL 0–5 / ML 5+
- **Ability Modifiers:** **+10 to Mental Abilities** (`50 CP`)
- **Skills:** **+20 Species Skill Ranks** (`20 CP`)
- **Species Features:** *No Physical Form (or Physical Ability Scores — +75 CP Flaw; requires Manifestation or Possession for a physical body)*, *Awakened (All 6 Disciplines)* (`12 CP`), *Non-Typical Anatomy* (`4 CP`), *Semi-Corporeal* (`4 CP`), *Invisible* (`4 CP`), *Alter Form (Elite)* (`4 CP`), *Telepathic* (`2 CP`).
- **CRISP Visual Synthesis Matrix — The Entity:**
  - **Context:** A non-corporeal, extra-planar intelligence temporarily projecting a non-Euclidean geometric or energetic avatar into physical space.
  - **Style & Palette:** Photorealistic Cinematic Art, Conceptual Abstraction, Transcendent Cosmic Horror; Void Black, Cosmic Indigo, Psionic Violet, Transcendent White.
  - **Guidance Tokens:** Non-Euclidean geometry, light-as-substance, zero-mass, spectral aberration, internal glow, volumetric fog, chiaroscuro.

### **2. THE ILA — "THE ELOHIM" (Sleeping Progenitors — 112 CP)**

- **Pronunciation:** *"E-laa"*
- **Description:** An incredibly ancient and powerful Progenitor species whose name means "Godlike" in several ancient tongues. The Sha'Nor are mysteriously connected to the Ila. The remnants of the Ila have slumbered in stasis for millennia—until now. Ila probes and remote mecha are controlled via long-range telepathic links and forged entirely from thought-reactive **Polymatter**; the Ila never utilize self-aware machines (AIs/Androids) or independent automation.
- **Classification:** Entity (`24 CP`) | **Size:** Large (`2 CP`) | **Movement:** 60 ft Groundspeed, 60 ft Flicker / Telekinetic Flightspeed | **Tech / Meta Level:** TL 5+ / ML 5+
- **Stigma:** Deific (`-6 CP`), Xeno (`-2 CP`)
- **Ability Modifiers:** **+4 Intellect** (`20 CP`)
- **Skills:** **+40 Species Skill Ranks** (`40 CP`)
- **Species Features:** *Awakened (All 6 Disciplines — Intellect-based)* (`12 CP`), *Telepathy* (`2 CP`), *Telekinesis* (`2 CP`), *Corporeal Form at Will* (`4 CP`), *Large Size* (`2 CP`), *Fast Heal* (`2 CP`), *Regeneration* (`2 CP`), *Ageless* (`2 CP`), *Immortal* (`4 CP`), *Flicker Movement* (`4 CP`).
- **Recommended Features:** Any.
- **CRISP Visual Synthesis Matrix — The Ila (Elohim):**
  - **Setting Style:** **Imperial Psionic-Theurgy.** Monumental tiered ziggurats and temples rendered in levitating white ceramic and gold-laced polymatter, fusing sacred Canaanite geometry (hexagons, spirals, stars) with smooth sci-fi curves.
  - **Palette:** Alabaster White, Lapis Lazuli Blue, Burnished Gold/Bronze, with glowing Psionic Violet and Cerulean Cyan energy accents.
  - **Subject Visuals:** Floating, hard-light winged form, featureless gilded mask/helm, ancient robes woven with polymatter circuitry, radiant aura.

### **3. THE U'NONN — "THE ANUNNAKI" (Architects of the Jump Gates — 111 CP)**

- **Description:** An extremely ancient Progenitor lineage who constructed the original **Translux Jump Gate** network and seeded numerous humanoid species across the galaxy. They originally mentored the **Mondi** to guide younger civilizations in intellectual and spiritual advancement—an initiative that fractured when premature technological uplift destabilized several worlds.
- **Classification:** Humanoid Aberration (`1 CP`) | **Size:** Large (`2 CP`) | **Movement:** 60 ft Groundspeed, 60 ft Telekinetic Flightspeed | **Tech / Meta Level:** TL 5+ / ML 5+
- **Stigma:** Deific (`-6 CP`), Xeno (`-2 CP`)
- **Ability Modifiers:** **+4 Intellect** (`20 CP`), **+6 Additional Ability Points** (`30 CP`)
- **Skills:** **+40 Species Skill Ranks** (`40 CP`)
- **Species Features:** *Awakened (All 6 Disciplines — Intellect-based)* (`12 CP`), *Telepathy* (`2 CP`), *Telekinesis* (`2 CP`), *Large Size* (`2 CP`), *Fast Heal* (`2 CP`), *Regeneration* (`2 CP`), *Ageless* (`2 CP`), *Immortal* (`4 CP`).
- **Recommended Features:** Any.
- **CRISP Visual Synthesis Matrix — The U'Nonn (Anunnaki):**
  - **Setting Style:** **Celestial Neo-Sumerian Supertechnology.** Towering stepped pyramids and citadels of polished lapis lazuli and dark basalt connected by anti-gravity bridges, with glowing cuneiform holographic interfaces.
  - **Materiality & Subject Visuals:** Polished Lapis Blue, Obsidian Basalt, Aurum Gold, Burnished Bronze; towering regal humanoids (or hybrid avatars) with stylized beards, horned neural-amplifier crowns, high-collared force-field vestments, and metallic feathered flight wings.

# **99. MODULAR SPECIES MATRIX (SPECIES FRAMEWORK & BUILD SYSTEM)**

### **The Tangent Codex: Source of Truth**

## **Introduction: The Xenological Blueprint**

In the Tangent universe, a "Species" is more than a cosmetic skin for a character; it is a fundamental chassis that defines their interaction with the physical, technological, and metaphysical laws of the galaxy (`operator/1.03 SPECIES.md`).

This framework acts as the Source of Truth for designing sentient lifeforms. It synthesizes the narrative architecture of the Tangent setting with the mathematical rigor of the Character Point (CP) system. When creating a species, you are engineering a biological or mechanical survivor.

## **I. The Component Hierarchy (Standardized Entry Template)**

Every species entry in the Tangent Codex must contain the following components to be considered complete. This hierarchy ensures that every lifeform is defined not just by its stats, but by its place in the galactic ecosystem.

### **1. Species Overview**

- **Species Name:** The formal designation (scientific/bureaucratic) and the common trade tongue name.
- **Homeworld / Plane of Origin:** The specific planet, system, or dimensional plane where the species originated.
- **Sentience Level:** The cognitive classification (e.g., Sapient, Hive Mind, God-like, Pre-Sentient).
- **General Description:** A concise one-paragraph summary of the species, establishing its visual identity and primary narrative role.
- **Core Concept / Archetype:** The "high-concept" elevator pitch (e.g., "Honor-bound Lizard Warriors," "Telepathic Gas Clouds," "Corporate Insectoids").

### **2. Biology & Physiology**

- **General Appearance:** Overall body shape, posture (bipedal, quadruped, amorphous), and average size/weight.
- **Physical Composition:** The fundamental matter of the being (Carbon-based, Silicon-based, Energy, Polymatter).
- **Skeletal Structure:** Support system (Internal Skeleton, Exoskeleton, Hydrostatic, Energy Lattice).
- **Limbs & Appendages:** Number and type of arms, legs, tentacles, wings, or manipulators.
- **Integument:** The outer covering (Skin, Scales, Chitin, Fur, Feathers, Energy Field).
- **Coloration & Markings:** Typical skin tones, camouflage patterns, bioluminescence, or display colors.
- **Head & Facial Features:** Sensory clusters, eye type (compound/binocular), mouth structure (mandibles/beak/jaw), and decorative features (horns/antennae).
- **Diet & Metabolism:** What they consume (Omnivore, Photosynthetic, Lithovore) and how they process energy.
- **Senses:** Standard sensory input (Sight, Sound) and unique capabilities (Echolocation, Thermal, Electroreception).
- **Reproduction:** Methods of propagation (Sexual, Asexual, Budding, Construction) and associated rituals.
- **Life Cycle & Maturation:** Stages of life (Larva, Pupa, Adult), growth rates, and average lifespan.
- **Sleep/Rest Patterns:** Biological downtime requirements (Nocturnal, Diurnal, Hibernation, Sleepless).
- **Vulnerabilities & Resistances:** Natural immunities (Poison, Radiation) or environmental weaknesses (Cold, Fire).

### **3. Psychology & Cognition**

- **Intellect & Problem-Solving:** Cognitive style (Logical/Linear, Intuitive/Creative, Collective/Hive).
- **Primary Method of Communication:** How information is exchanged (Verbal, Telepathy, Pheromones, Radio-Frequency).
- **Dominant Instincts & Drives:** Core biological urges (Survival, Expansion, Hoarding, Protection).
- **Temperament & Disposition:** General personality baseline (Aggressive, Passive, Curious, Xenophobic).
- **Emotional Range:** Capacity for emotion (Human-like, Dampened, Alien/Incomprehensible).
- **Memory & Learning:** Retention methods (Genetic Memory, Oral Tradition, Data Upload).
- **Concept of Self:** Identity structure (Individualistic, Collectivist, Caste-based).

### **4. Culture & Society**

- **Social Structure:** Organization of the population (Clans, Nations, Hives, Corporations).
- **Government & Politics:** Ruling systems (Democracy, Magocracy, Tyranny, Anarchy).
- **Laws & Ethics:** Moral compass and legal frameworks (Honor Codes, Survival of the Fittest, Profit-driven).
- **Social Hierarchy:** Systems of rank and status (Caste System, Meritocracy, Hereditary).
- **Gender Roles & Family Structure:** Definitions of family units and gender roles (if applicable).
- **Language(s):** Spoken and written forms of communication.
- **Technology Level:** Current advancement tier (Primitive, Industrial, Spacefaring, Transcendent).
- **Arts & Aesthetics:** Cultural expressions in music, visual arts, and architectural style.
- **Religion, Spirituality, & Mythology:** Belief systems, deities, and cosmological views.
- **Traditions & Rituals:** Key cultural events, holidays, and rites of passage.
- **Diet & Cuisine:** Preparation and consumption habits (Ritualistic feasting, nutrient paste, energy absorption).

### **5. Ecology & Habitat**

- **Homeworld Description:** Climate, geography, and atmospheric conditions of the origin world.
- **Habitat/Niche:** The specific ecosystem role they fill (Apex Predator, Scavenger, Symbiote).
- **Relationship with Other Species:** Interactions with local fauna and other sapient races (Predatory, Trade, Isolationist).
- **Resource Needs:** Critical environmental requirements for survival (Water, Sunlight, specific radiation).
- **Architecture & Habitations:** Construction style and settlement patterns (Underground hives, orbital rings, tree-cities).

### **6. Abilities & Traits (Game Mechanics)**

- **Inherent Abilities:** Natural powers defined by biology (Flight, Venom, Natural Armor).
- **Species-Specific Strengths:** Mechanical bonuses to Attributes or Skills.
- **Species-Specific Weaknesses:** Mechanical penalties or vulnerabilities.
- **Unique Biological Features:** Distinct mechanics that defy standard categorization (Shapeshifting, Regeneration).

### **7. Notes & Concepts**

- **General Notes:** Plot hooks, naming conventions, and roleplaying tips.
- **Inspiration Gallery & CRISP Guidance:** Visual references and thematic touchstones for visualization.

## **II. Construction Guide (Step-by-Step)**

Follow this protocol to build a species from concept to completion:

1. **Concept & Type Selection:** Select the Type from the Master Catalog (`./species/99.Species.ChassisAndMovement.md`). This sets the base CP cost and fundamental physiology.
2. **Sizing & Movement:**
   - **Size:** Medium is the baseline (`0 CP`). Smaller or Larger sizes cost CP due to combat and scaling advantages.
   - **Movement:** Standard is 30 ft Ground (`0 CP`). Special modes (Fly/Swim/Climb/Burrow) cost extra.
3. **Attributes & Skills (Universal Straight CP Pricing — Zero Package Discount):**
   - **Positive Attributes:** Cost **5 CP per +1** bonus inside a Species Package and during Character Customization.
   - **Negative Attributes:** Penalties refund **-5 CP per -1** penalty inside a Species Package.
   - **Species Skill Packages:** Cost **1 CP per 1 Skill Rank** (**5 CP per +5 Ranks**, 10 CP for +10 Ranks, 20 CP for +20 Ranks — straight values with no package discount).
4. **Features, Traits & Disadvantages:**
   - Select special abilities from the Trait Catalog (`./species/99.Species.TraitsAndDisadvantages.md`):
     - **Basic Trait:** `1 CP`.
     - **Advanced Trait:** `2 CP`.
     - **Elite Trait:** `4 CP`.
     - **Species Disadvantages & Stigmas:** Reduce total Species Package CP cost and are **exempt from the +10 CP Personal Hindrance Cap** during character creation.
5. **The Character Point (CP) Tally:** Sum all costs:
   - **Standard Species:** `12 – 25 CP` (Humans, Alterians).
   - **Advanced Species:** `25 – 47 CP` (Dragonkin, Kitin Expressions, High-Tier Synthetics).
   - **Monster / Progenitor / True Dragon:** `50+ CP` (Full-Blooded Dragons [112 CP], Progenitors [111–112 CP]).

# **MODULAR SPECIES MATRIX DIRECTORY INDEX**

Part III (The Master Catalog: Source of Truth) and the Dragons Codex are organized in the `./species/` directory:

- **[Species Chassis Types, Size & Movement](./species/99.Species.ChassisAndMovement.md)** — *Part III.1–4: Species Types (The Chassis), Size Categories, Movement Modes, and Straight Attribute/Skill Pricing*
- **[Species Traits Catalog & Disadvantages](./species/99.Species.TraitsAndDisadvantages.md)** — *Part III.5–6: Master Catalog of Basic (1 CP), Advanced (2 CP), and Elite (4 CP) Species Traits and CP-reducing Disadvantages*
- **[Dragons Codex (True Dragons & Dragonkin)](./species/04.03.01.DragonsCodex.md)** — *Six Great Dragon Lineages, 112 CP Full-Blooded Dragon Build, Playable Age Categories, Wyrms/Drakes/Wyverns, Dragon Flight Paces, and Apotheosis Masteries*

## **MECHANICAL AUTHORITY & CANONICAL RULES BLOCK**

- **Core Resolution Engine:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`. Critical Hit (Natural 20 / double-10s) = `Rolled Dice + 10 (20 -> 30) + 2x Base Weapon Damage Dice + Critical Effect`. Fumble (Natural 2 / double-1s) = `Flat -10 + Complication`. Advantage/Disadvantage rolls `+1d10` per stack and keeps the highest or lowest 2 dice.
- **Character Point (CP) Economy & 80-CP Archetype Chassis:** Starting Operator budget is **150 CP**, partitioned into the **80-CP Archetype Chassis** (`15 CP` Primary Attribute at `+3`, `10 CP` Secondary Attribute at `+2`, `24 CP` for 4 Essential Skills at Rank 6, `18 CP` for 6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3, and `13 CP` for 2 Signature Traits at 1 CP each + 3 Recommended Core Features at 9 CP) plus **70 CP Customization**.
- **60-SP Sociological Background Allocation:** **Faction (20 SP) + Origin (20 SP) + Occupation (20 SP) = 60 Skill Ranks, 4 Features, and 4 Traits at 0 CP** (additional traits cost 1 CP each).
- **Universal Straight CP Pricing:** Attributes cost **5 CP per +1** (and refund **-5 CP per -1 penalty**); Skills cost **1 CP per 1 Skill Rank** (**5 CP per 5 Ranks**) across all character, species, companion, and adversary builds with zero package discounts. Standard Features cost **3 CP** (**2 CP** when listed under **Recommended Features**, minimum 1 CP).
- **Vitality, Health & Structure (Zero Stamina Scaling):** Biological characters begin with **Base 30 Vitality** and **Base 30 Health** (Synthetics/Constructs combine both into **Base 60 Structure Points [SP]**), scaled strictly at **+5 points per 1 CP** spent. **Stamina (STA) never increases Vitality or Health**; Stamina modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after highest single-domain Armor DR (`Stability Points = STA + 5`).
- **Personal Hindrance Cap:** Maximum **+10 CP** gained from personal Hindrances at character creation; **Species-level disadvantages and Stigmas are exempt** from this cap.

## **III. UNIFIED SPECIES & SUBSPECIES MASTER TEMPLATE (`Species Template`)**

Every canonical species document in `operator/species/` and `architect/species/` adheres to this 9-part structural schema:

### **I. System Metadata Block**

| Parameter | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Classification** | Humanoid / Beast / Aberration / Synthetic / Ooze / Verdant / Entity / Planar / Fey / Dragon |
| **Base CP Cost** | Total CP Package Cost (or *"Varies by Subspecies"*) calculated via Universal Straight CP Pricing |
| **Average Size** | Small (`x0.66`), Medium (`x1`), or Large (`x2`) with typical height/weight ranges |
| **Base Movement** | Ground Speed (`ft`), plus Swim, Climb, Fly, or Teleport speeds where applicable |
| **Tech Level (TL) & Meta Level (ML)** | Baseline Civilization Tech Level (`TL 0–5`) and Metafocus Level (`ML 0–5`) |
| **Homeworld** | Sovereign System / Galactic Sector / Dimensional Plane of Origin |
| **Base Stigma** | Minor (`-1 CP`), Typical (`-2 CP`), or Severe (`-4 CP`) social/physiological Stigma tags (*Xeno, Beast, Synthetic, Mutant*) |

### **II. Faction Identity & Lore Summary**

- **Identity & Official Designation:** Common galactic alias and formal scientific/bureaucratic classification.
- **Colloquialisms & Archetype:** Slang terms used by outsiders and 2–3 core defining themes (e.g., *Biomorphic Solarpunk / Eco-Militants*).
- **Driving Mandate, Affiliation & Symbolic Sigil:** Core philosophical quote, primary faction alignment, and visual heraldry.

### **III. Galactic Relationships**

- Itemized diplomatic statuses (*Allied, Neutral, Rival, Hostile*) and historical tensions with major galactic polities.

### **IV. Culture & Philosophy**

- Core philosophical framework, ethical principles, and any overarching biological, spiritual, or digital network (*The Chorus*, *Hive Mind*, *Consensus Link*).

### **V. Social Structure & Internal Divisions**

- Breakdown of societal castes, military orders, or specialist divisions with **Focus**, **Visual Identifiers**, and **Signature Technology**.

### **VI. Species Biology (The Biological Chassis)**

- Detailed anatomical profile and subspecies variants (**Physical Anatomy**, **Visual Motif**, and **Specialized Adaptations**).

### **VII. Mechanics & Game Data (Universal Straight CP Pricing)**

1. **Species Skill Package (`1 CP` per Skill Rank / `5 CP` per 5 Ranks):** Lists innate cultural or biological skill ranks at straight 1:1 CP cost with zero package discount.
2. **Universal Species Traits:** Baseline chassis traits shared across all members before subspecies adjustments.

### **VIII. Subspecies / Variant Stat Blocks**

- **Total CP Cost:** Exact mathematical sum of Chassis Type + Size + Movement + Attributes + Skills + Traits minus Species Disadvantages/Stigmas.
- **Core Attributes & Size:** Classification, Size Category, and Base Movement Speeds.
- **Ability Modifiers:** Positive Attribute modifiers cost **5 CP per +1**; negative Attribute modifiers grant a **-5 CP refund per -1**.
- **Base Species Features & Traits:** Basic Traits (`1 CP`), Advanced Traits (`2 CP`), Elite Traits (`4 CP`), and Recommended Features (`2 CP`, discounted by `1 CP` from standard `3 CP`).
- **Stigmas & Disadvantages:** Species-level Disadvantages and Stigmas reduce the Species Package CP cost directly and are **exempt from the +10 CP Personal Hindrance Cap**.
- **Recommended Features:** Thematic features eligible for the `1 CP` Recommended Feature discount during Operator creation.

### **IX. AI Image Synthesis Framework (CRISP & Rendering Protocols)**

1. **Content Prompt Structure:** `SUBJECT` (Subspecies + Caste + Location), `VISUALS` (Anatomy + Attire + Signature Tech), `ACTION` (Dynamic pose), and `BACKGROUND` (Environment).
2. **Guidance Prompt:** `SETTING STYLE`, `CONTEXT`, `ARCHITECTURE/GEAR`, `ATMOSPHERE`, and `PALETTE`.
3. **Standard Rendering Protocols:**
   - **HI-FI CHROMA (Photorealistic Cinematic Art):** 4k raw imagery, lineless rendering, volumetric form, painterly realism, hyper-realistic texture, realistic anatomy, heavy fabric physics, chiaroscuro, low key lighting, volumetric fog, deep color blocking, rich blacks, indigo shadows, colored rim lighting, subsurface scattering, rule of thirds, anamorphic bokeh. *Negative Tokens:* outlines, black lines, ink strokes, line art, cartoon, sketch, 3d render, watermark, text, anime, cel shaded, plastic skin, doll-like.
   - **HI-FI INK (Lineless Graphic Novel Aesthetic):** High-definition digital ink, hyper-detailed digital painting, volumetric form, deep color blocking, stark chiaroscuro, pure black merged shadows, internal stipple shading, halftone shadow transitions, dramatic low key lighting, intense rim lighting, vivid ink colors, sharp planar forms. *Negative Tokens:* photorealism, raw photo, film grain, bokeh, 3d render, black outlines, contour lines, flat cel shading, watermark, text.
   - **HI-FI SKETCH (Technical & Fine Line Art):** Hyper-detailed ink sketch, micron pen illustration, precise contour lines, intricate cross-hatching, stipple shading, dynamic line weight, black ink on clean paper with selective color accents, architectural draftsmanship. *Negative Tokens:* photorealism, 3d render, oil painting, lineless, airbrushed, blurred, smudged, watermark, text.

## **DISCREPANCY & RESTORATION LEDGER (DISC-507)**

- **File Target:** `architect/99. MODULAR SPECIES MATRIX.md`
- **Restoration Pass (Three-Way Merge):**
  - Restored 100% of Part I (Standardized Entry Template), Part II (Step-by-Step Construction Guide), and the 3-file `./species/` Directory Index including `04.03.01.DragonsCodex.md`.
- **Mechanical Normalization Pass (12 Global Rules):**
  - Enforced Rule 9 (Universal Straight CP Pricing: +1 Attribute = 5 CP, -1 Attribute penalty = -5 CP refund, +5 Skill Ranks = 5 CP / 1 CP per Skill Rank, with zero package discount) and Rule 10 (Species Disadvantages/Stigmas exempt from the +10 CP Personal Hindrance Cap).

# **99.Species.ChassisAndMovement.md**

## **MECHANICAL AUTHORITY & CANONICAL RULES BLOCK**

- **Core Resolution Engine:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`. Critical Hit (Natural 20 / double-10s) = `Rolled Dice + 10 (20 -> 30) + 2x Base Weapon Damage Dice + Critical Effect`. Fumble (Natural 2 / double-1s) = `Flat -10 + Complication`. Advantage/Disadvantage rolls `+1d10` per stack and keeps the highest or lowest 2 dice.
- **Character Point (CP) Economy & 80-CP Archetype Chassis:** Starting Operator budget is **150 CP**, partitioned into the **80-CP Archetype Chassis** (`15 CP` Primary Attribute at `+3`, `10 CP` Secondary Attribute at `+2`, `24 CP` for 4 Essential Skills at Rank 6, `18 CP` for 6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3, and `13 CP` for 2 Signature Traits at 1 CP each + 3 Recommended Core Features at 9 CP) plus **70 CP Customization**.
- **60-SP Sociological Background Allocation:** **Faction (20 SP) + Origin (20 SP) + Occupation (20 SP) = 60 Skill Ranks, 4 Features, and 4 Traits at 0 CP** (additional traits cost 1 CP each).
- **Universal Straight CP Pricing:** Attributes cost **5 CP per +1** (and refund **-5 CP per -1 penalty**); Skills cost **1 CP per 1 Skill Rank** (**5 CP per 5 Ranks**) across all character, species, companion, and adversary builds with zero package discounts. Standard Features cost **3 CP** (**2 CP** when listed under **Recommended Features**, minimum 1 CP).
- **Vitality, Health & Structure (Zero Stamina Scaling):** Biological characters begin with **Base 30 Vitality** and **Base 30 Health** (Synthetics/Constructs combine both into **Base 60 Structure Points [SP]**), scaled strictly at **+5 points per 1 CP** spent. **Stamina (STA) never increases Vitality or Health**; Stamina modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after highest single-domain Armor DR (`Stability Points = STA + 5`).
- **Personal Hindrance Cap:** Maximum **+10 CP** gained from personal Hindrances at character creation; **Species-level disadvantages and Stigmas are exempt** from this cap.

## **III. The Master Catalog (Source of Truth)**

### **1. Species Types (The Chassis)**

Listed below are the common traits of any species of that type, along with itemized Character Point (CP) values. Individual species add specialized abilities and traits depending on developmental, environmental, and cultural factors.

#### **Aberration (1 CP)**
Aberrations have a bizarre anatomy, strange abilities, an alien mindset, or any combination of the three.
- **Senses:** **Darksight** out to 60 feet \[1 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Aberrations breathe, eat, and sleep.

#### **Beast (1 CP)**
A living, nonhuman creature, usually perceived as an animal or non-humanoid fauna. **Beastkin** are hybrids of the Beast type and have similar traits added to another corporeal type.
- **Senses:** **Low-Light Vision** \[1 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Beasts breathe, eat, and sleep.

#### **Dragon (5 CP)**
Dragons are intelligent reptilian creatures with innate metaphysical abilities. **Dragonkin** are hybrids of the Dragon type and have similar traits added to another corporeal type.
- **Senses:** **Darksight** 60 feet \[1 CP\], **Low-Light Vision** \[1 CP\].
- **Immunities:** Immune to magical sleep effects and paralysis effects \[3 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Dragons breathe, eat, and sleep.

#### **Elemental (13 CP)**
Beings composed of primordial elemental matter or energy. **Elementalkin** are hybrids of the Elemental type and have similar traits added to another corporeal type.
- **Senses:** **Darksight** out to 60 feet \[1 CP\].
- **Immunities:** Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, and stunning \[6 CP\].
- **Fortification:** Immune to Critical Hits and Flanking \[3 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Elementals do not breathe, eat, or sleep \[3 CP\].

#### **Entity (24 CP)**
A non-corporeal being which may have never been biologically alive—such as embodiments, pure essence, avatars, and extradimensional intelligences.
- **Incorporeal:** Immune to all physical conditional effects due to their incorporeal form \[3 CP\].
- **Fortification:** Immune to Critical Hits and Flanking \[3 CP\].
- **Immunities:** Immune to all mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, morale effects, patterns, and phantasms) \[3 CP\]; bleed damage, death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, and stunning \[3 CP\]; non-lethal damage, ability drain, energy drain, damage to physical ability scores (STA, AGI, STR), exhaustion, and fatigue effects \[3 CP\].
- **Senses:** **Darksight** and **Ethersight** out to 60 feet \[3 CP\].
- **Planar:** Not a creature of the material plane and immune to effects which pertain exclusively to material creatures \[3 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Entities do not breathe, eat, or sleep \[3 CP\].

#### **Fey (3 CP)**
A fey is a creature with supernatural abilities and connections to nature or to some other force or twilight place. **Feykin** are hybrids of the Fey type and have similar traits added to another corporeal type.
- **Senses:** **Low-Light Vision** \[1 CP\].
- **Traits:** **Sleepless** \[2 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Fey breathe and eat.

#### **Humanoid (0 CP)**
Humanoid species have no special innate supernatural chassis abilities, but most can speak and have well-developed societies. Humanoids are usually Medium, though Small and Large varieties exist.
- **Physiology:** Humanoids breathe, eat, and sleep.

#### **Mythical (5 CP)**
Beings that resemble beasts (or other creature types), typically possessing high sapience and special abilities or supernatural powers.
- **Senses:** **Darksight** out to 60 feet \[1 CP\] and **Low-Light Vision** \[1 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Mythicals do not breathe, eat, or sleep \[3 CP\].

#### **Ooze (6 CP)**
Oozes are gelatinous / semi-solid amorphous creatures (also used to describe coherent swarms of diminutive creatures). Many oozes use blindsight or other non-visual senses to navigate.
- **Amorphous:** Immune to all physical conditional effects due to their slippery form or base components, and able to compress through narrow gaps \[3 CP\].
- **Fortification:** Immune to Critical Hits and Flanking \[3 CP\].

#### **Planar (4 CP)**
A Planar is at least partially composed of the essence (though not necessarily the matter) of a plane other than the Material Plane.
- **Senses:** **Darksight** 60 feet \[1 CP\].
- **Planar Origin:** Extradimensional physiology \[3 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Planars breathe, eat, and sleep.

#### **Synthetic (15 CP)**
Animated objects or artificially engineered mechanical, android, or bio-synthetic creatures.
- **Senses:** **Low-Light Vision** \[1 CP\] and **Darksight** 60 feet \[1 CP\].
- **Mental Immunity:** Digitized Mind — immune to all standard biological mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, morale effects, patterns, and phantasms) \[3 CP\].
- **Repair Required:** Cannot heal damage naturally on their own; Synthetics combine **Base 30 Vitality + Base 30 Health into Base 60 Structure Points (SP)** and must be repaired via physical maintenance (`Vocation: Mechanic` / `Knowledge: Engineering`), *Matter* invocations, or an auto-repair augmentation \[-3 CP\].
- **Metabolic Immunity:** Not subject to biological ability damage, ability drain, fatigue, exhaustion, energy drain, starvation, asphyxiation, or non-lethal damage \[3 CP\].
- **Fortitude Immunity:** Immune to any effect that requires a biological Fortitude save (unless the effect also works on objects or is harmless) \[3 CP\].
- **Hardened Frame / Resilient Design:** Synthetics are hard to destroy, gaining base **DR 5/-** and bonus Structure Points based on their size: *Tiny:* — | *Small:* +10 SP | *Medium:* +20 SP | *Large:* +40 SP | *Huge:* +80 SP \[2 CP\].
- **Synthetic Strength:** For lifting, carrying capacity, and Grappling, counts as **1 Size Category larger** (e.g., a Medium Synthetic counts as Large) \[2 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Synthetics do not breathe, eat, or sleep, unless they choose to gain a beneficial effect from one of these activities \[3 CP\].

#### **Undead (20 CP)**
Undead species are once-living corporeal creatures animated by spiritual or entropic forces.
- **Senses:** **Darksight** 60 feet \[1 CP\].
- **Mental Immunity:** Immune to all mind-affecting effects \[3 CP\].
- **Physical Immunity:** Immune to bleed damage, death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, and stunning \[3 CP\].
- **Metabolic Immunity:** Not subject to non-lethal damage, ability drain, energy drain, or damage to physical ability scores (STA, AGI, STR), as well as exhaustion and fatigue effects \[3 CP\].
- **Negative Energy Affinity:** Harmed by positive energy (*Entropy: Order*) and healed by negative energy (*Entropy: Chaos*). *(Note: Deathless are a variant Undead type with inverted energy traits)* \[2 CP\].
- **Fortitude Immunity:** Immune to any effect that requires a Fortitude save (unless the effect also works on objects or is harmless) \[3 CP\].
- **Resurrection Limits:** Affected only by high-tier *Revivify / True Resurrection* \[2 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Undead do not breathe, eat, or sleep \[3 CP\].

#### **Verdant (9 CP)**
This type encompasses sapient botanical and fungal creatures.
- **Senses:** **Low-Light Vision** \[1 CP\].
- **Mental Immunity:** Immune to all standard mind-affecting effects \[3 CP\].
- **Physical Immunity:** Immune to paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep effects, and stunning \[3 CP\].
- **Physiology:** Verdants breathe and eat (or photosynthesize), but do not sleep (unless for beneficial effects/Essence regain) \[2 CP\].

### **2. Species Size Categories**

| Size Category | CP Cost | Attribute, Combat & Scaling Modifiers | Dimensions / Examples |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Medium** | **0 CP** | Baseline (+0 Attributes, +0 Combat Mod, `x1` Damage/Speed, +0 Stability) | 4 to 8 ft / 60 to 500 lbs *(Human, Alterian, Rottweiler, Motorcycle)* |
| **Large** | **2 CP** | **Stats:** +2 STR, -2 AGI \| **Combat Mod:** -2 \| **Dmg/Speed:** `x2` \| **Stability:** +4 | 8 to 16 ft / 500 to 4,000 lbs *(Kongi, Vassoth, Horse, Lion, Small Car)* |
| **Huge** | **4 CP** | **Stats:** +4 STR, -4 AGI \| **Combat Mod:** -4 \| **Dmg/Speed:** `x5` \| **Stability:** +8 | 16 to 32 ft / > 4,000 lbs *(Adult Dragon, Elephant, Delivery Truck)* |
| **Small** | **2 CP** | **Stats:** +2 AGI, -2 STR \| **Combat Mod:** +2 \| **Dmg:** -1 die size \| **Speed:** -5 ft \| **Stability:** -4 | 2 to 4 ft / 8 to 60 lbs *(Koban, Chimpanzee, Lynx, Scooter)* |
| **Tiny** | **4 CP** | **Stats:** +4 AGI, -4 STR \| **Combat Mod:** +4 \| **Dmg:** -2 die size \| **Speed:** -10 ft \| **Stability:** -8 | 1 to 2 ft / 1 to 8 lbs *(Asi Fey, House Cat, Hawk, Skateboard)* |
| **Diminutive** | **6 CP** | **Stats:** +8 AGI, -8 STR \| **Combat Mod:** +8 \| **Dmg:** -3 die size \| **Speed:** -10 ft \| **Stability:** -16 | 6 to 12 in / < 1 lb *(Micro-Swarm, Rat, Sparrow, Mini-Drone)* |

### **3. Species Movement Modes**

All speeds listed are calibrated for Medium-sized species (apply Size Category multipliers if larger). A species may select at most **one** base speed modifier trait (marked with `*`):

| Movement Mode | CP Cost | Mechanical Effect |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Normal Speed** | **0 CP** | Base ground walk speed of **30 feet**. Determines speed of other modes. |
| **Fast** `*` | **2 CP** | Base Ground Speed **+10 feet** (40 ft). |
| **Very Fast** `*` | **4 CP** | Base Ground Speed **+20 feet** (50 ft). |
| **Slow** `*` | **-2 CP** | Base Ground Speed **-10 feet** (20 ft — refunds 2 CP). |
| **Ponderous** `*` | **-4 CP** | Base Ground Speed **-20 feet** (10 ft — refunds 4 CP). |
| **Climber** | **2 CP** | Base Climb Speed **30 feet**, plus +5 species bonus on Climbing checks. |
| **Gliding Wings** | **1 CP** | Move 5 ft horizontally per 1 ft of descent. Speed 30 ft/rnd (60 ft diving). |
| **Leaper** | **1 CP** | Always considered to have a running start when making Athletics (Jump) checks. |
| **Mountaineer** | **1 CP** | Immune to altitude sickness; retains full Defense on narrow or slippery ledges. |
| **Sprinter** | **1 CP** | Gain **+10 foot** species bonus to total movement distance when running/sprinting (Ranked). |
| **Swimmer** | **2 CP** | Base Swim Speed **30 feet**, plus +5 species bonus on Swim checks. |
| **Terrain Movement** | **1 CP** | Move through one chosen natural Difficult Terrain type at normal speed. |
| **Burrow** | **2 CP** | Base Burrow Speed **20 feet**. |
| **Basic Flight** | **2 CP** | Base Fly Speed **30 feet** (Poor Maneuverability). |
| **Improved Flight Speed** | **1 CP** | Increases Base Fly Speed by **+10 feet** (Ranked). |
| **Improved Maneuverability** | **1 CP** | Flight maneuverability improves by 1 step (*Clumsy -> Poor -> Average -> Good -> Perfect*, Ranked). |
| **Strong Flyer** | **2 CP** | Increases the Size Category multiplier by +1 for Flying Speed. |
| **Hauler** | **1 CP** | Not encumbered by carrying a Heavy Load. |
| **Marcher** | **1 CP** | Accumulates half fatigue when moving overland at a regular forced-march pace. |

### **4. Species Attributes & Skill Packages (Rule 9 Universal Straight Pricing)**

Both inside a **Species Package** (`operator/1.03 SPECIES.md` and `architect/99. MODULAR SPECIES MATRIX.md`) and during **Character Creation Customization** (`operator/1.01 CHARACTER CREATION.md`), biological Attribute adjustments and Skill allocations use straight, undiscounted Character Point values:

| Species Modifier | Species Package Cost | Post-Species Customization Cost | Mechanical Effect |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Improved Strength (STR)** | **5 CP per +1** | 5 CP per +1 | **+1** species bonus to Strength (Might). |
| **Improved Agility (AGI)** | **5 CP per +1** | 5 CP per +1 | **+1** species bonus to Agility (Reflex). |
| **Improved Stamina (STA)** | **5 CP per +1** | 5 CP per +1 | **+1** species bonus to Stamina (Fortitude / Base Toughness). |
| **Improved Intellect (INT)** | **5 CP per +1** | 5 CP per +1 | **+1** species bonus to Intellect (Reason). |
| **Improved Wisdom (WIS)** | **5 CP per +1** | 5 CP per +1 | **+1** species bonus to Wisdom (Willpower). |
| **Improved Charisma (CHA)** | **5 CP per +1** | 5 CP per +1 | **+1** species bonus to Charisma (Etiquette). |
| **Reduced Attribute (Penalty)** | **-5 CP per -1** | -5 CP per -1 | **-1** species penalty to an Attribute Score (refunds 5 CP). |
| **Species Skill Package** | **5 CP per 5 Ranks (1 CP/Rank)** | 1 CP per 1 Rank (5 CP for 5) | **+5 Species Skill Ranks** in a specified skill set or group (10 CP for +10 Ranks, 20 CP for +20 Ranks; zero package discount). |

- **File Target:** `architect/species/99.Species.ChassisAndMovement.md`

  - Restored 100% of Part III.1–4 (13 Species Chassis Types, 6 Size Categories, 19 Movement Modes, and Species Attributes & Skill Packages).
- **Mechanical Normalization Pass (12 Global Rules):**
  - Enforced Rule 9 in Section 4: Universal straight CP pricing everywhere (+1 Attribute = 5 CP, -1 Attribute Penalty = -5 CP refund, 1 Skill Rank = 1 CP / 5 CP per 5 Ranks, with zero package discount).

description:
# **99.Species.TraitsAndDisadvantages.md**

## **MECHANICAL AUTHORITY & CANONICAL RULES BLOCK**

- **Core Resolution Engine:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`. Critical Hit (Natural 20 / double-10s) = `Rolled Dice + 10 (20 -> 30) + 2x Base Weapon Damage Dice + Critical Effect`. Fumble (Natural 2 / double-1s) = `Flat -10 + Complication`. Advantage/Disadvantage rolls `+1d10` per stack and keeps the highest or lowest 2 dice.
- **Character Point (CP) Economy & 80-CP Archetype Chassis:** Starting Operator budget is **150 CP**, partitioned into the **80-CP Archetype Chassis** (`15 CP` Primary Attribute at `+3`, `10 CP` Secondary Attribute at `+2`, `24 CP` for 4 Essential Skills at Rank 6, `18 CP` for 6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3, and `13 CP` for 2 Signature Traits at 1 CP each + 3 Recommended Core Features at 9 CP) plus **70 CP Customization**.
- **60-SP Sociological Background Allocation:** **Faction (20 SP) + Origin (20 SP) + Occupation (20 SP) = 60 Skill Ranks, 4 Features, and 4 Traits at 0 CP** (additional traits cost 1 CP each).
- **Universal Straight CP Pricing:** Attributes cost **5 CP per +1** (and refund **-5 CP per -1 penalty**); Skills cost **1 CP per 1 Skill Rank** (**5 CP per 5 Ranks**) across all character, species, companion, and adversary builds with zero package discounts. Standard Features cost **3 CP** (**2 CP** when listed under **Recommended Features**, minimum 1 CP).
- **Vitality, Health & Structure (Zero Stamina Scaling):** Biological characters begin with **Base 30 Vitality** and **Base 30 Health** (Synthetics/Constructs combine both into **Base 60 Structure Points [SP]**), scaled strictly at **+5 points per 1 CP** spent. **Stamina (STA) never increases Vitality or Health**; Stamina modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after highest single-domain Armor DR (`Stability Points = STA + 5`).
- **Personal Hindrance Cap:** Maximum **+10 CP** gained from personal Hindrances at character creation; **Species-level disadvantages and Stigmas are exempt** from this cap.

## **5. Species Traits Catalog**

Species traits are categorized into **Basic (`1 CP`)**, **Advanced (`2 CP`)**, and **Elite (`4 CP`)** tiers. Any Feature listed as **Recommended** for the Species costs **1 CP less** than standard (2 CP instead of 3 CP, minimum 1 CP) when purchased by a member of that species. *(Skills always cost a straight 1 CP per Rank / 5 CP per 5 Ranks with no discount).*

### **BASIC TRAITS [1 CP]**

*General Bonuses & Base Abilities*

| Trait Name | Mechanical Description | Category |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Adapted** | No environmental penalties or damage from one chosen biome/environment type (Multiple). | Physical |
| **Alter Form (Basic)** | Minor cosmetic shapechange (+5 to Disguise checks). | Physical |
| **Amphibious** | Breathe air and water equally well; +10 ft to Swim Speed. | Physical |
| **Bonded Terrain** | +2 Dodge bonus to Defense while in a specific natural terrain type. | Defensive |
| **Bonus / Granted Feature** | Members of this species select one extra feature (or gain a specified static feature with no prerequisites). | Trained |
| **Camouflage** | Choose a favored terrain type; gain +4 bonus on Stealth checks within that terrain. | Physical |
| **Cat's Luck** | Once per Full Rest, roll a Reflex Save at **Advantage**. | Defensive |
| **Cave Dweller** | +4 bonus on Knowledge (Survival) checks made underground. | Trained |
| **Craftsman** | +2 species bonus to one chosen Vocation skill. | Trained |
| **Digitigrade / Ungulated** | +10 ft Movement Speed and +4 Stability (special legwear and boots required). | Movement |
| **Draconic** | Unlocks access to purchase *Dragonkin* racial traits. | Physical |
| **Emissary** | Once per day, roll a **Bluff** or **Diplomacy** check at **Advantage**. | Social |
| **Exoskeleton (Partial)** | Concealable leathery or scaled dermis granting `DR = Strength Score + 2` (or `(Strength + 2) * 2` on Heavy chassis; Req: STR 1–2). | Physical |
| **Focused Study** | Gain *Skill Focus* (+2) in one skill of choice. | Trained |
| **Frenzy** | 1/day upon taking damage, enter a frenzy for 1 minute (+2 STR, +2 STA, -2 Defense). | Physical |
| **Greedy Eye** | +4 bonus on all Appraisal / Mercantile valuation checks. | Trained |
| **Hardy** | +2 species bonus on saving throws against poison, invocations, and metaphysical abilities. | Defensive |
| **Healthy** | +4 species bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison. | Defensive |
| **Integrated** | +1 bonus on Bluff, Disguise, and Knowledge (Culture) checks. | Social |
| **Low-Light Vision** | See twice as far in dim light; Improved Spectrum Vision (lower IR and UV). | Sensory |
| **Lucky, Lesser** | +1 species bonus on all saving throws. | Defensive |
| **Natural Armor** | +2 Natural Armor DR. | Defensive |
| **Patagia** | Gliding membranes granting gliding speed of `2x Ground Speed` using Acrobatics (requires modified upper garments). | Physical |
| **Reach** | Natural melee reach of **10 feet**. | Physical |
| **Reduced Sustenance** | Eat and drink half the typical daily requirement. | Physical |
| **Relentless** | +2 bonus on Might/Athletics checks made to Shove, Bull Rush, or Overrun an opponent. | Physical |
| **Runner** | +4 species bonus on saves to avoid fatigue/exhaustion from running (increases run multiplier). | Movement |
| **Scent** | Identify and track by smell (+4 to Track and Medical Diagnosis by olfaction). | Sensory |
| **Shadow Affinity** | Gain +5 to Stealth checks when in shadowy or dim areas. | Meta |
| **Shadow Blending** | Attacks made against members in dim light suffer a **30% Miss Chance**. | Meta |
| **Shards of the Past** | Ancestral/past-life memory granting a +2 species bonus to two chosen Knowledge skills. | Meta |
| **Silent Hunter** | Reduce Stealth penalty for moving by 5. | Movement |
| **Silver Tongued** | +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks; can shift NPC attitude up to three steps. | Social |
| **Skill Bonus** | Gain +2 species bonus divided among noted skills. | Trained |
| **Sneaky** | +2 species bonus on Stealth checks. | Trained |
| **Sociable** | If a Diplomacy check to shift attitude fails by 5 or more, may retry within 24 hours. | Social |
| **Stable Footed** | +4 species Stability bonus while standing on solid ground. | Defensive |
| **Stalker** | Gain +2 bonus to Alertness and Stealth checks versus one designated quarry. | Trained |
| **Tail** | +2 to Trip and Acrobatics (Balance) checks; usable as a `1d6` Blunt natural weapon. | Physical |
| **Urbanite** | +2 species bonus on Diplomacy and Insight checks. | Social |
| **Water-Sense** | **Blindsense 30 feet** against creatures touching the same body of water. | Sensory |

### **ADVANCED TRAITS [2 CP]**

*Rule Variants & Special Abilities*

| Trait Name | Mechanical Description | Category |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Adaptive Features** | May change between specific features during a **Light Rest** (Ranked). | Physical |
| **Adaptive Skill Set** | 4 Skill Points in a floating pool that can be reassigned during a Light Rest (Ranked). | Trained |
| **Additional Limbs** | Another pair of prehensile limbs (arms, tentacles, or manipulators). | Physical |
| **Ageless** | Does not suffer physical aging penalties nor show visible signs of senescence. | Physical |
| **All-Around Vision** | +4 species bonus on Alertness checks and **immune to Flanking**. | Sensory |
| **Alter Form (Advanced)** | Change appearance (+5 Disguise), gender, vocal cords, and minor biological traits. | Physical |
| **Alternate Form** | Possesses an additional natural biological form (does not involuntarily revert). | Physical |
| **Aquatic** | +4 species bonus on Swim checks and may **Take 10** on Swim checks under stress. | Movement |
| **Aquatic Strength** | Counts as **1 Size Category larger** for Combat, Strength, and maneuver checks while in water. | Physical |
| **Autotroph** | Does not require solid food/drink (sustains on ambient light/radiation; may still digest elixirs). | Physical |
| **Blindsense** | Sense unseen objects within a **30 ft Radius** or **60 ft Cone**. | Sensory |
| **Bodyform Appendages** | Shapechange to gain additional limbs (2 arms, legs, tentacles, wings, or fins). | Physical |
| **Bodyform Armor** | Shapechange to gain a protective dermal layer (`Bodyform Armor Opts` adds +1 option slot per rank). | Physical |
| **Bodyform Adaptation** | Physiology shifts to become compatible with a new environment. | Physical |
| **Bodyform Mutation** | Shift into any Species Trait whose prerequisites are met (Ranked). | Physical |
| **Bodyform Sizing** | Shapechange to alter Size Category **1 step up or down**. | Physical |
| **Bodyform Structure** | Reallocate Physical Ability scores (STR/AGI/STA) in equal trade once per day for the entire day (Ranked). | Physical |
| **Bodyform Weapons** | Shapechange to gain Natural Weaponry scaled to Size (`Bodyform Weapon Opts` adds +1 option slot per rank). | Physical |
| **Brutal** | Bone spurs/talons **double Strength damage bonus** on natural attacks (Lethal). | Physical |
| **Chameleon** | Active color shift grants +5 Stealth and allows **Taking 10** on Stealth checks. | Physical |
| **Chloroplast** | Gain sustenance from and **double natural healing rate** while in daylight-equivalent light. | Physical |
| **Constriction** | Grants Improved/Greater Grapple; crushing grapple deals **2x Unarmed damage**. | Physical |
| **Curiosity** | +4 bonus on Diplomacy (Gather Information) and Knowledge checks. | Trained |
| **Darksight** | Clear vision in all levels of light or total darkness (including UV and bioluminescence). | Sensory |
| **Defensive Training** | +2 Dodge bonus to Defense. | Defensive |
| **Dragon Eyes** | Choose from the *Low-Light Vision* line (*Darksight, Ethersight, Thermal Sight* — Multiple). | Sensory |
| **Dragon Form** | Alternate Form of a **Large-sized Dragon**. | Meta |
| **Dragon Might** | Lift objects and Grapple as if **1 Size Category larger** (*Req: Dragonkin, STR 4*). | Physical |
| **Dragon Mind** | Roll all Mental Resistance / Willpower saves with **Advantage** (*Req: Dragonkin, WIS 2*). | Meta |
| **Dragon Senses** | Roll all **Alertness** checks with **Advantage** (*Req: Dragonkin, Alertness 11*). | Sensory |
| **Energy Resist** | **DR 10** vs. chosen Energy Type (*Pyro, Cryo, Sonic, Voltic, Corrosive* — Multiple/Ranked). | Physical |
| **Exoskeleton (Light)** | Heavy scales/chitin granting `DR = Strength Score * 2` (or `(Strength + 2) * 3`; *Req: STR 2–3, Exoskeleton [Partial]*). | Physical |
| **Fast Heal** | Daily recovery of Health and Vitality during a single **Light Rest** (repeatable). | Physical |
| **Fey Affinity** | Wild animals treat the character as Trusting, Neutral, and Friendly. | Meta |
| **Fiend Affinity** | Wild animals treat the character as an apex Predator (Dangerous and Wary). | Meta |
| **Gifted Linguist** | +4 species bonus on **Knowledge (Language)** checks. | Trained |
| **Hive Connection** | Allows linked members to mentally share sensory and tactical information across the collective. | Meta |
| **Longevity** | Effectively doubles lifespan across all age categories. | Physical |
| **Lucky, Greater** | +2 species bonus on all saving throws. | Meta |
| **Master Tinker** | +2 bonus on **Vocation (Mechanic)** and **Knowledge (Engineering)** checks. | Trained |
| **Mind Speech** | Telepathic communication to one subject within **500 ft** (Ranked). | Meta |
| **Natural Weapons** | Claws, fangs, horns, or tail stinger (`1d6` Lethal damage). | Combat |
| **Powerful Charge** | Charge attack deals **2x damage dice** plus `1.5 * Strength` bonus. | Combat |
| **Prehensile Tail** | +2 to Climbing and Acrobatics (Balance) checks and usable as an off-hand (requires tailored legwear). | Physical |
| **Prehensile Limbs** | Fully prehensile tentacles/off-hands; make manipulation/grapple checks with **Advantage**. | Physical |
| **Quadruped** | Four-legged chassis: +4 Stability, +10 ft movement speed (requires custom armor/accommodations). | Movement |
| **Quick Reactions** | Use **double Agility score** to calculate base Initiative (*Req: Species Agility +1*). | Physical |
| **Resistant** | +2 species bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and poison. | Defensive |
| **Rock Throwing** | Range increment 60 ft; Damage `2d6 + (1.5 * STR)` Blunt (*Req: Large*). | Combat |
| **Sleepless** | Does not require unconscious sleep; may rest to regain metaphysical Essence. | Physical |
| **Swarming** | Two small/tiny members can share the same 5 ft square; if attacking the same foe, both are considered Flanking. | Combat |
| **Synthetic Armor Opts** | Armor and Armor Upgrades available directly as internal Augmentations (*Req: Synthetic, TL 2*). | Physical |
| **Synthetic Weapon Opts** | Weapons and Weapon Upgrades available directly as internal Augmentations (*Req: Synthetic, TL 2*). | Physical |
| **Thermal Sight** | See Infrared/heat patterns in total darkness; track passage of warm targets. | Sensory |
| **Treespeech** | Ability to converse empathetically with plants. | Meta |
| **Venom** | Natural attack delivers **Hemotoxic** (STR/STA), **Neurotoxic** (AGI/Sensory), or **Cytotoxic** (Tissue Corrosive) venom. | Physical |

### **ELITE TRAITS [4 CP]**

*Immunities & Powerful Abilities*

| Trait Name | Mechanical Description | Category |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Alter Form (Elite)** | Full cellular shapeshifting (+10 Disguise), gender shift, and trait adjustment. | Physical |
| **Blindsight** | Accurately pinpoint and target unseen objects within a **30 ft Radius** or **60 ft Cone**. | Sensory |
| **Bodyform Heavy Armor** | Shapechange to gain a heavy protective layer (**doubles Bodyform Armor bonus to DR**). | Physical |
| **Dragon Apotheosis** | Gain Lineage-Specific Apotheosis Mastery and access to Advanced Dragon Abilities (*Req: Dragon Form*). | Meta |
| **Dragon Breath** | Breath Weapon — **30 ft Cone** or **50–60 ft Line** of lineage energy dealing `(Strength Score)d8` damage. | Meta |
| **Dragon Wings** | Grow leathery draconic wings — **Fly Speed = `3x Ground Speed`** (*Req: Dragonkin, Exoskeleton*). | Movement |
| **Energized Breath** | Focus resonance into breath weapon to roll damage at **Advantage**; half damage is pure metaphysical energy. | Meta |
| **Energy Absorption** | Heals **20% of damage ignored** by *Energy Immunity* (Ranked; *Req: Energy Immunity*). | Meta |
| **Energy Immunity** | Completely **Immune** to one chosen Energy Damage type (*Req: STA 2, DR 20 vs. specific Energy*). | Physical |
| **Ethersight** | See Invisible, Phased (other-dimensional energies), and Bioluminescent Auras. | Meta |
| **Exoskeleton (Heavy)** | Heavy carapace granting `DR = Strength Score * 3` (or `(Strength + 2) * 4`; *Req: STR 4, Exoskeleton [Light]*). | Physical |
| **Flight** | True Flight at **`2x Ground Speed`** with Average Maneuverability (uses Acrobatics skill). | Movement |
| **Hexapedal** | Six-legged chassis: +8 Stability, +20 ft movement speed (requires custom accommodations). | Movement |
| **Immortal** | Cannot die of natural causes, nor suffer damage from mundane poisons/diseases (*Req: Ageless*). | Meta |
| **Nimble Appendages** | Extra limbs/tail usable as a primary hand with zero off-hand penalties (*Req: Additional Limbs/Tail*). | Physical |
| **Non-Living** | Undead, Elementals, and Constructs not classified as biologically living. | Meta |

| **Synthetic Exotic Opt** | Synthetic engineering version of any biological Species Trait or Special Feature (*Req: Synthetic*). | Physical |
| **Synthetic Tech Assimilation** | Able to absorb, power, and interface directly with technological devices (*Req: Synthetic, TL 5*). | Physical |
| **Vampiric Power** | Gain +1 temporary Physical Ability point per 2 points of Stamina/Vitality drained. | Meta |
| **Wyrm Senses** | Take Features from any *Acute Sense* line (*Req: Dragon Apotheosis*). | Sensory |

## **6. Disadvantages (CP Reduction)**

*(Note: Under Rule 10, Species-level Disadvantages and Stigmas reduce the net CP cost of the Species Package and are **exempt** from the +10 CP Personal Hindrance Cap during character creation.)*

| :--- | :---: | :--- |

| **Elemental Vulnerability** | **-4 CP** | Vulnerability (**+2 damage per die**) to one chosen energy type (*Corrosive, Cryo, Voltic, or Pyro*). |
| **Light Blindness** | **-4 CP** | Abrupt exposure to bright light **Blinds** for 1 round, then **Dazzles** (-1) thereafter (*Req: Darksight*). |
| **Light Sensitivity** | **-2 CP** | **Dazzled** (-1 to Strike and visual Alertness checks) in bright sunlight (*Req: Darksight*). |
| **Negative Energy Affinity** | **-4 CP** | Biologically alive, but harmed by Positive Energy (*Order*) and healed by Negative Energy (*Chaos*). |
| **Sunlight Powerlessness** | **-6 CP** | **Staggered / Helpless** in direct natural sunlight (*Req: Undead / Half-Undead / Shadow*). |
| **Vulnerable to Sunlight** | **-4 CP** | Suffers **1 point of Stamina drain per hour** in direct sunlight (*Req: Native to Darklands/Shadow*). |

## **DISCREPANCY & RESTORATION LEDGER (DISC-530)**

- **File Target:** `architect/species/99.Species.TraitsAndDisadvantages.md`

  - Restored 100% of Part III.5–6 (41 Basic Traits [1 CP], 57 Advanced Traits [2 CP], 24 Elite Traits [4 CP], and 7 Species Disadvantages).

description:
# **04.03.01 DRAGONS CODEX (TRUE DRAGONS, DRAGONKIN & DRACONIC FLIGHT)**

## **MECHANICAL AUTHORITY & CANONICAL RULES BLOCK**

- **Core Resolution Engine:** `2d10 + Skill Rank + Attribute Modifier + Situational Modifiers vs. Challenge Rating (CR)`. Critical Hit (Natural 20 / double-10s) = `Rolled Dice + 10 (20 -> 30) + 2x Base Weapon Damage Dice + Critical Effect`. Fumble (Natural 2 / double-1s) = `Flat -10 + Complication`. Advantage/Disadvantage rolls `+1d10` per stack and keeps the highest or lowest 2 dice.
- **Character Point (CP) Economy & 80-CP Archetype Chassis:** Starting Operator budget is **150 CP**, partitioned into the **80-CP Archetype Chassis** (`15 CP` Primary Attribute at `+3`, `10 CP` Secondary Attribute at `+2`, `24 CP` for 4 Essential Skills at Rank 6, `18 CP` for 6 Supporting Skills at Rank 3, and `13 CP` for 2 Signature Traits at 1 CP each + 3 Recommended Core Features at 9 CP) plus **70 CP Customization**.
- **60-SP Sociological Background Allocation:** **Faction (20 SP) + Origin (20 SP) + Occupation (20 SP) = 60 Skill Ranks, 4 Features, and 4 Traits at 0 CP** (additional traits cost 1 CP each).
- **Universal Straight CP Pricing:** Attributes cost **5 CP per +1** (and refund **-5 CP per -1 penalty**); Skills cost **1 CP per 1 Skill Rank** (**5 CP per 5 Ranks**) across all character, species, companion, and adversary builds with zero package discounts. Standard Features cost **3 CP** (**2 CP** when listed under **Recommended Features**, minimum 1 CP).
- **Vitality, Health & Structure (Zero Stamina Scaling):** Biological characters begin with **Base 30 Vitality** and **Base 30 Health** (Synthetics/Constructs combine both into **Base 60 Structure Points [SP]**), scaled strictly at **+5 points per 1 CP** spent. **Stamina (STA) never increases Vitality or Health**; Stamina modifier subtracts point-for-point from incoming damage as **Base Toughness** after highest single-domain Armor DR (`Stability Points = STA + 5`).
- **Personal Hindrance Cap:** Maximum **+10 CP** gained from personal Hindrances at character creation; **Species-level disadvantages and Stigmas are exempt** from this cap.

## **I. OVERVIEW: THE ANCIENT PROGENITORS OF THE DYNASTY**

In the Tangent universe, **Dragons** are not mindless beasts of myth; they are an ancient, hyper-intelligent, long-lived sapient species possessing innate mastery over the **Resonance Field** and cellular shapechanging. Over seventeen centuries ago, True Dragons established the **Dracon Dynasty**, uplifting and interbreeding with humanity to create the **Draconic (Dragon-Blooded)** noble houses and the **Draconian** martial/arcane order.

True Dragons possess two natural biological forms—their true **Dragon Form** and an innate humanoid **Alternate Form**—and are classified into six primary elemental/metaphysical lineages (**Aurum, Argent, Cuprum, Obsidian, Verdant, and Lapis**) plus rare **Variants**.

## **II. THE SIX GREAT DRAGON LINEAGES & VARIANTS**

Each Dragon lineage governs a primary **Attribute Score (`+2`)**, an innate **Energy Type** (dictating its *Energy Immunity* and *Dragon Breath*), a **20-Point Lineage Skill Package**, an innate **Awakened Metaphysic Discipline**, and a specialized **Sensory Mode**:

| Lineage | Known As | Attribute (`+2`) | Energy Type & Breath Shape | Lineage Skills (20 SP) | Awakened Discipline | Signature Sensory Mode |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **AURUM** | Gold / Bronze | **Charisma** | **Pyro** *(Fire Spit [Line] or Flaming Spray [Cone])* | Bluff, Intimidate, Diplomacy, Knowledge (Any) | **Energy** | **Thermal Sight** *(Heat-Based)* |
| **ARGENT** | Silver / White | **Intellect** | **Cryo** *(Ice Shards [Line] or Freezing Mist [Cone])* | Academics, Knowledge (Culture), Alertness, Knowledge (Any) | **Mental** | **Ethersight** *(Psionic-Based)* |
| **CUPRUM** | Copper / Red | **Wisdom** | **Voltic** *(Lightning Arc [Line] or Cascade [Cone])* | Knowledge (Culture), Diplomacy, Alertness, Vocation (Any) | **Illusion** | **Blindsense** *(Electroreception)* |
| **OBSIDIAN** | Night / Black | **Agility** | **Any One Energy** *(Chosen at creation)* | Acrobatics, Alertness, Stealth, Combat (Any) | **Dimension** | **Ethersight** *(Dimensional-Based)* |
| **VERDANT** | Forest / Green | **Stamina** | **Corrosive** *(Acidic Gas [Cone] or Caustic Spray [Line])* | Knowledge (Medicine), Alertness, Knowledge (Survival), Expression | **Entropy** | **Scent** *(Biological-Based)* |
| **LAPIS** | Earth / Blue | **Strength** | **Sonic** *(Shattering Bark [Cone] or Roaring Shockwave [Line])* | Athletics, Alertness, Knowledge (Survival), Combat (Any) | **Matter** | **Blindsense** *(Echolocation)* |
| **VARIANTS** | Mixed / Offshoots | **Any One (`+2`)** | **Any One Energy** *(Chosen at creation)* | Any 4 Chosen Skills | **Any 1 Discipline** | Lineage-dependent |

## **III. FULL-BLOODED DRAGON SPECIES PACKAGE & PREREQUISITES (112 CP MINIMUM)**

While **Draconic Humans** (15 CP) and **Draconians** (23–28 CP) are standard playable species packages, constructing a **Full-Blooded Adolescent Dragon** requires the **46 CP Advanced Species Base** plus the purchase of all **12 Dragonkin Features** and their Attribute prerequisites (**Minimum Strength 4 and Stamina 2**), totaling a minimum of **112 CP**:

### **1. Mandatory Prerequisites & Core Package Breakdown (112 CP Total)**

- **Required Minimum Attributes (30 CP):**
  - **Strength 4** (20 CP at 5 CP per +1)
  - **Stamina 2** (10 CP at 5 CP per +1)
- **Base Dragon Species Chassis (46 CP):**
  - **Dragon Type Chassis (5 CP):** *Darksight 60 ft*, *Low-Light Vision*, and **Immunity to magical sleep and paralysis effects**.
  - **Lineage Attribute Bonus (10 CP):** **+2** to the lineage's primary Attribute Score (*Aurum: CHA, Argent: INT, Cuprum: WIS, Obsidian: AGI, Verdant: STA, Lapis: STR* — 5 CP per +1).
  - **Lineage Skill Package (20 CP):** **20 Skill Points** distributed across the lineage's 4 signature skill groups (5 CP per 5 Ranks / 1 CP per Rank).
  - **Innate Awakening (2 CP Recommended):** **Awakened** in the lineage's signature Metaphysic Discipline.
  - **Lineage Sensory Trait (2 CP):** *Thermal Sight*, *Ethersight*, *Blindsense*, or *Scent*.
  - **Exoskeleton (Partial + Light) (3 CP):** Scales granting `DR = Strength Score * 2` (`DR 8` at STR 4).
  - **Energy Resistance x2 (4 CP):** **DR 20** against the lineage's Energy Type (prerequisite for *Energy Immunity*).
- **Complete Dragonkin Feature Suite (36 CP — 12 Features at Recommended/Elite Costs):**
  1. **Alternate Form (2 CP):** Innate humanoid form; does not involuntarily revert if shapechange effects are disrupted.
  2. **Brutal (2 CP):** Claws, fangs, and horns **double the Strength damage bonus** on natural attacks (Lethal Slashing, Piercing, or Blunt).
  3. **Energy Immunity (4 CP Elite):** Complete **Immunity** to the lineage's Energy Type (*Req: Stamina 2, DR 20 vs. Energy*).
  4. **Natural Weapons (2 CP):** Bite (`1d8`), Claws (`1d6`), Tail Slap (`1d6`), and Gore (`1d8`), scaled by Size Category.
  5. **Tail (1 CP):** Grants +2 to Trip and Acrobatics (Balance) checks and functions as a natural weapon.
  6. **Dragon Eyes (2 CP):** Enhanced spectrum vision (*Low-Light, Darksight, Thermal/Ethersight*).
  7. **Dragon Senses (2 CP):** Rolls all **Alertness checks with Advantage** (*Req: Alertness 11*).
  8. **Dragon Mind (2 CP):** Rolls all **Mental Resistance / Willpower Saves with Advantage** (*Req: Wisdom 2*).
  9. **Dragon Might (2 CP):** Lifts, carries, and grapples as **1 Size Category larger** (doubled weight capacity and +4 Stability; *Req: Strength 4*).
  10. **Dragon Wings (4 CP Elite):** Leathery draconic wings granting **Fly Speed = `3x Ground Speed`** (*Req: Exoskeleton*).
  11. **Dragon Breath (4 CP Elite):** **30 ft Cone (10 ft wide)** or **50–60 ft Line** of lineage energy dealing **`(Strength Score)d8` damage** (**Reflex Save CR = `10 + Stamina + Stage`** for half).
  12. **Dragon Form (2 CP) + Ageless / Longevity (4 CP) + Exoskeleton (Heavy) (3 CP):** Assumes **Large-sized Dragon Form** (+2 STR, -2 AGI, -2 Combat Mod, `x2` Damage Dice, `x2` Speed, +4 Stability) with Heavy Scales (`DR = Strength * 3`).

## **IV. PLAYABLE DRAGON AGE CATEGORIES**

Operators and Architects can scale a Full-Blooded Dragon across three playable maturation stages (plus NPC Ancient Wyrms):

| Age Category | CP Adjustment | Dragon Form Size | Alternate Form Size | Attribute & Trait Adjustments |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Hatchling** | **-20 CP** *(92 CP Min)* | **Medium (`x1`)** | **Small** | -1 to three Ability Scores (Minimum **Strength 3**, **Stamina 1**); *New to the 'Verse — Impulsive / Curious / Immature* behavioral quirk. |
| **Adolescent** | **+0 CP** *(112 CP Base)* | **Large (`x2`)** | **Medium** | Baseline Full-Blooded Dragon statistics (+2 Lineage Attribute; Large Dragon Form). |
| **Adult** | **+20 CP** *(132 CP Min)* | **Huge (`x5`)** | **Medium** | **+3** to Lineage Attribute; Huge Dragon Form (+4 STR, -4 AGI, `x5` Damage/Speed); **Fear Aura** (Constant radiant aura — **double Charisma score for Intimidate checks**); centuries old and stoic. |
| **Ancient Wyrm (NPC)** | **Tier 15–19** *(400–500+ CP)* | **Gargantuan (`x10`) / Colossal (`x20`)** | **Medium / Large** | Unlocks **Dragon Apotheosis**, **Energized Breath**, **Energy Absorption**, **Stone Blood**, and **Wyrm Senses**. |

## **V. DRAGONKIN HYBRIDS & DRACONIC SUB-SPECIES**

*\* Wyrms, Drakes, and Wyverns may also be bonded via the **Companion** feature (`99. MODULAR COMPANION MATRIX.md`)—serving as both a loyal cohort and a flying/ground mount if Large or Huge.*

- **Draconic (Human Hybrid — 15 CP):** Legendary Champion Knights and noble houses of the Dracon Dynasty (`operator/species/Humans/1.03.Humans.Draconic.md`).
- **Draconian (Alterian Hybrid — 23–28 CP):** Philosophers, arcane researchers, and martial scholars of the Draconian Order (`operator/species/Aeld/1.03.Aeld.Draconian.md`).
- **Sa Sa Si (Vassoth Hybrid):** Serpentine-draconic defenders of the Garden (*"Silver Creche"* of Entari Prime).
- **Wyrms `*` (Small or Medium Non-Shifting Dragons):**
  - **Size:** Medium or Small (non-shifting).
  - **Intellect:** Mid to High sapience (`0` to `+4` Intellect).
  - **Movement:** Winged Flight (`3x Ground Speed`), strong climbers and swimmers. Frequently mistaken for young True Dragons.
- **Drakes `*` (Large Bestial Non-Shifting Dragons):**
  - **Size:** Large (`x2` base speed and damage dice; non-shifting).
  - **Intellect:** Mid to Low animal/semi-sapient intelligence (`0` to `-4` Intellect).
  - **Movement:** Quick (`+10 ft` base ground speed) and Full-Speed Vertical Climbing, **OR** Winged Flight (`3x Ground Speed`).
- **Wyverns `*` (Large Pseudo-Drakes with Venomous Stinger):**
  - **Physiology:** Bipedal pseudo-drakes with no separate forelimbs, utilizing semi-manipulative bat-like wings and a **Stinger-Tipped Tail (Paralytic Neurotoxic Venom)**.
  - **Size:** Large (`x2` base speed and damage dice; non-shifting).
  - **Intellect:** Mid to Low intelligence (`0` to `-4` Intellect).
  - **Movement:** Quick (`+10 ft` base speed) and Climbing, **OR** Winged Flight (`3x Ground Speed`).

## **VI. DRACONIC FLIGHT MECHANICS & AERIAL PACES**

Draconic wings are significantly larger than typical avian wings, supported by dense thoracic musculature, solid mineralized bones, and reinforced patagia—making Dragons and their winged kin apex aerial flyers.

- **Base Ground Speed:** Medium = `30 ft/round` (`6 ft/sec` or `3.41 mph`); Large (`x2`) = `60 ft/round`; Huge (`x5`) = `150 ft/round`.
- **Dragon Wings Multiplier (`3x Ground Speed`):** Triples base ground speed to **90 ft** (Medium), **180 ft** (Large), and **450 ft** (Huge).

### **1. Master Draconic Flight Speed Table (`Speed * 0.1136 = mph`)**

| Aerial Pace | Speed Multiplier | Medium (`x1`) | Large (`x2`) | Huge (`x5`) | Stealth / Precision Mod* | Required Acrobatics Check |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Hover / Controlled Descent** | `0.5x Base` or less | 45 ft (~5 mph) | 90 ft (~10 mph) | 225 ft (~25 mph) | +0 | **Acrobatics CR 15** |
| **Gliding** *(Slowest Descent)* | Optimal Glide | 90 ft (10 mph) | 180 ft (20 mph) | 450 ft (50 mph) | **+2 Bonus** | **Acrobatics CR 10** |
| **Flight** *(Standard Cruise)* | `1x Fly Speed` (`3x Ground`) | **90 ft (10 mph)** | **180 ft (20 mph)** | **450 ft (50 mph)** | +0 | None |
| **Sail** *(Hurried Pace)* | `4x Fly Speed` (`5x` w/ *Soar*) | **360 ft (40 mph)** | **720 ft (80 mph)** | **1,800 ft (200 mph)** | **-2 Penalty** | Sustained check / min |
| **Soar** *(Fast Overland Pace)* | `8x Fly Speed` (`9x` w/ *Soar*) | **720 ft (80 mph)** | **1,440 ft (160 mph)** | **3,600 ft (400 mph)** | **-4 Penalty** | **Acrobatics CR 10** / min |
| **Diving** *(Requires Altitude)* | `2x Current Speed` | **up to 1,440 ft (160 mph)** | **up to 2,880 ft (320 mph)** | **up to 7,200 ft (800 mph)** | **-4 Penalty** *(cumulative)* | **Acrobatics CR (Base - 10)** |

### **2. Aerial Fatigue, High Ground & Diving Ram Rules**

- **Aerial Stamina & Fatigue Checks:** Acrobatics checks during sustained high-speed flight (Sail, Soar, Dive, Hover) are rolled once per minute (or per round in extreme turbulence) to ward off muscle strain. On a failure, the flyer suffers **1 point of non-lethal Vitality damage per 5 points missed**, followed by a **Willpower Save** against the same CR. If flight cannot be maintained, the flyer must execute a **Controlled Descent (CR 15)** or begin an uncontrolled plummet from current altitude with a cumulative `-1` penalty per subsequent recovery check.
- * **Precision & Stealth Modifiers:** Apply to all checks involving subtlety, Stealth, fine manipulation, or ranged precision while flying at that pace.
- **The *Soar* Feature:** Increases the speed multiplier of Sail and Soar by `+1` (to `5x` and `9x` Flight Speed) without increasing the precision penalty.
- **High Ground Advantage:** Any airborne combatant attacking a ground-bound target from superior altitude gains the **High Ground Bonus (`+2 Strike / +2 Critical Confirmation`)**.
- **Aerial Diving Rams:** A Ram executed by a flying Dragon or creature inflicts **+`1d` bonus damage per active Flight Stage** (*Flight +1d, Sail +2d, Soar +3d, Dive +4d*) **plus `+1 Impact Damage per 10 ft of current Speed`** to all participants (Attacker and Target[s]; vehicular Crash rules apply on structural failure).

## **VII. COMPLETE DRAGONKIN & APOTHEOSIS TRAIT REFERENCE**

| Trait Name | CP Cost | Prerequisites & Mechanical Effect |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Alternate Form** | **2 CP** | A natural secondary humanoid form; will not involuntarily revert if shapechange effects are disrupted or suppressed. |
| **Brutal** | **2 CP** | Keratinized talons, fangs, and horns **double Strength damage bonus** on natural attacks as Lethal Slashing, Piercing, or Blunt damage. |
| **Energy Resist** | **2 CP** *(Ranked)* | Grants **DR 10** per rank vs. chosen Energy Type (*Pyro, Cryo, Sonic, Voltic, Corrosive*). Two ranks (DR 20) required for *Energy Immunity*. |
| **Energy Immunity** | **4 CP** *(Elite)* | Complete **Immunity** to the lineage's Energy Type (*Req: Stamina 2, Energy Resist DR 20*). |
| **Energy Absorption** | **4 CP** *(Elite, Ranked)* | Heals **20% of all damage ignored** by the Dragon's *Energy Immunity* (*Req: Energy Immunity*). |
| **Dragon Breath** | **4 CP** *(Elite)* | **30 ft Cone (10 ft wide)** or **50–60 ft Line** dealing `(Strength Score)d8` lineage energy damage (*Req: Dragonkin, Energy Immunity*). |
| **Energized Breath** | **4 CP** *(Elite)* | Roll *Dragon Breath* damage at **Advantage**; **1/2 of total damage is pure metaphysical energy** (*Req: Dragon Breath, Energy Discipline*). |
| **Dragon Form** | **2 CP** | Assumes **Large-sized Dragon Form** (+2 STR, -2 AGI, -2 Combat Mod, `x2` Damage Dice, `x2` Speed, +4 Stability; *Req: Breath, Might, Senses, Wings, Exoskeleton [Light]*). |
| **Dragon Might** | **2 CP** | Lift objects and Grapple as **1 Size Category larger** (doubled weight and +4 Stability; *Req: Dragonkin, STR 4*). |
| **Dragon Mind** | **2 CP** | Roll all Mental Resistance / Willpower Saves with **Advantage** (*Req: Dragonkin, WIS 2*). |
| **Dragon Senses** | **2 CP** | Roll all **Alertness** checks with **Advantage** (*Req: Dragonkin, Alertness 11 or Acute Sense*). |
| **Dragon Wings** | **4 CP** *(Elite)* | Grow leathery wings at will — **Fly Speed = `3x Ground Speed`** (*Req: Draconic, Exoskeleton [Any]*). |
| **Exoskeleton (Partial / Light / Heavy)** | **1 / 2 / 4 CP** | Partial (`Req: STR 1`): `DR = STR + 2` | Light (`Req: STR 2`): `DR = STR * 2` | Heavy (`Req: STR 4`): `DR = STR * 3`. |
| **Fast Heal** | **2 CP** | Recovers a full day's natural Health and Vitality rest total in the time of a single **Light Rest** (repeatable). |
| **Regeneration** | **4 CP** *(Elite)* | Regrows lost limbs and organs with recovery of Health (*Req: Fast Heal*). |
| **Stone Blood** | **2 CP** | Complete **Immunity to conventional diseases and biological toxins** (*Req: Regeneration*). |
| **Mind Speech** | **2 CP** *(Ranked)* | Telepathic communication to one subject within **500 ft** (*Req: Dragon Mind*; WIS adds to target count and range). |
| **Wyrm Senses** | **4 CP** *(Elite)* | Take Features from any *Acute Sense* line (*Req: Dragon Senses, Dragon Eyes [Dark, Ether, Thermal]*). |
| **Dragon Apotheosis** | **4 CP** *(Elite)* | Unlocks Lineage-Specific Apotheosis Mastery and Advanced Dragon Abilities (*Req: Dragon Form*): |

### **Lineage Apotheosis Masteries**

- **Aurum Apotheosis (Solar Majesty):** Radiates a 30 ft *Aura of Command & Awe*; allies gain +2 morale bonus to attacks and saves, while enemies suffer Disadvantage on attacks against the Aurum Dragon unless they pass a Willpower Save.
- **Argent Apotheosis (Cryo-Psionic Sovereign):** Telepathic range expands to planetary scale; *Cryo* breath weapon additionally forces a **Willpower Save** or freezes the target's mental action economy (**Stunned / Slowed**).
- **Cuprum Apotheosis (Living Storm Conduit):** Can transform into a bolt of living lightning to teleport up to its Fly Speed as a Move Action, dealing `3d8` Voltic damage to all creatures along the line.
- **Obsidian Apotheosis (Void-Phase Wyrm):** Can shift **Semi-Corporeal (`DR 30` vs. physical)** as a Swift Action and step through dimensional shadows (*Blink / Long Step*) at will.
- **Verdant Apotheosis (Bio-Regenerative Progenitor):** Gains true **Regeneration** (5 Health per round) and can exhale a restorative *Order* mist that heals allies for `(Stamina)d8` Health instead of dealing Corrosive damage.
- **Lapis Apotheosis (Tectonic Titan):** Immune to all forced movement, petrification, and physical stunning; *Sonic* breath weapon shatters fortifications (**double Siege damage** to structures and armor DR).

## **DISCREPANCY & RESTORATION LEDGER (DISC-531)**

- **File Target:** `architect/species/04.03.01.DragonsCodex.md`
- **Restoration Pass (Three-Way Merge):**
  - Merged the Nov 2 Dragons Codex with 100% of `05. DRAGONS` (`1VKS69NdkYw709l-5VQ53tSeeqPyNNHGLm9mRn4UcllY`), restoring *Stone Blood*, *Sa Sa Si*, *Wyrms*, *Drakes*, *Wyverns*, and the complete Section VI Draconic Flight Mechanics & Aerial Paces table (Hover, Gliding, Flight, Sail, Soar, Diving, Aerial Fatigue, and Diving Rams).
- **Mechanical Normalization Pass (12 Global Rules):**
  - Normalized all legacy `CP` -> `CP`, `Agility/DEX` -> `Agility/AGI`, `Stamina/CON` -> `Stamina/STA`, `Perception` -> `Alertness`, and Acrobatics check targets to `CR 10 / CR 15`.
